            d.dev_temp_norm_p95,
            d.dev_vpd_norm_median_day,
            d.dev_vpd_norm_median_night,
            d.dev_vpd_norm_p95,
            d.runtime_grow_light_main_min,
            d.runtime_grow_light_grow_min,
            w.quality_filtered_meter_gal,
            w.climate_wetting_gal,
            COALESCE(w.available_for_scoring, false) AS water_ok,
            e.modeled_kwh,
            COALESCE(e.available_for_scoring, false) AS energy_ok,
            dl.crop_dli_mol_m2_day,
            dl.availability AS dli_availability,
            dl.unavailable_reason AS dli_unavailable_reason,
            dl.provenance AS dli_provenance,
            dl.validity_revision AS dli_validity_revision,
            dl.valid_from AS dli_valid_from,
            dl.valid_to AS dli_valid_to
           FROM daily_summary d
             LEFT JOIN v_water_attribution_daily w ON w.date = d.date AND w.greenhouse_id = d.greenhouse_id
             LEFT JOIN v_runtime_energy_daily e ON e.date = d.date AND e.greenhouse_id = d.greenhouse_id
             LEFT JOIN v_dli_daily dl ON dl.date = d.date AND dl.greenhouse_id = COALESCE(d.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)
          WHERE d.date IS NOT NULL
        ), normalized AS (
         SELECT e.date,
            e.cycles_fan1,
            e.cycles_fan2,
            e.cycles_heat1,
            e.cycles_heat2,
            e.cycles_fog,
            e.cycles_vent,
            e.cycles_dehum,
            e.cycles_safety_dehum,
            e.runtime_fan1_min,
            e.runtime_fan2_min,
            e.runtime_heat1_min,
            e.runtime_heat2_min,
            e.runtime_fog_min,
            e.runtime_vent_min,
            e.runtime_mister_south_h,
            e.runtime_mister_west_h,
            e.runtime_mister_center_h,
            e.water_used_gal,
            e.mister_water_gal,
            e.dli_final,
            e.captured_at,
            e.kwh_total,
            e.kwh_heat,
            e.kwh_fans,
            e.kwh_other,
            e.peak_kw,
            e.gas_used_therms,
            e.runtime_grow_light_min,
            e.cycles_grow_light,
            e.runtime_drip_wall_h,
            e.runtime_drip_center_h,
            e.kwh_estimated,
            e.therms_estimated,
            e.cost_electric,
            e.cost_gas,
            e.cost_water,
            e.cost_total,
            e.temp_min,
            e.temp_max,
            e.temp_avg,
            e.rh_min,
            e.rh_max,
            e.rh_avg,
            e.vpd_min,
            e.vpd_max,
            e.vpd_avg,
            e.co2_avg,
            e.outdoor_temp_min,
            e.outdoor_temp_max,
            e.stress_hours_heat,
            e.stress_hours_cold,
            e.stress_hours_vpd_high,
            e.stress_hours_vpd_low,
            e.notes,
            e.greenhouse_id,
            e.min_dp_margin_f,
            e.dp_risk_hours,
            e.compliance_pct,
            e.temp_compliance_pct,
            e.vpd_compliance_pct,
            e.mister_fairness_overrides_today,
            e.cycles_mister_south,
            e.cycles_mister_west,
            e.cycles_mister_center,
            e.cycles_drip_wall,
            e.cycles_drip_center,
            e.runtime_drip_wall_fert_h,
            e.runtime_drip_center_fert_h,
            e.runtime_mister_south_fert_h,
            e.runtime_mister_west_fert_h,
            e.runtime_fert_master_h,
            e.runtime_irrigation_clean_h,
            e.runtime_irrigation_fert_h,
            e.runtime_irrigation_total_h,
            e.cycles_drip_wall_fert,
            e.cycles_drip_center_fert,
            e.cycles_mister_south_fert,
            e.cycles_mister_west_fert,
            e.cycles_fert_master,
            e.irrigation_water_gal,
            e.fertigation_water_gal,
            e.compliance_v2_raw_pct,
            e.compliance_v2_attributable_pct,
            e.compliance_v2_unachievable_frac,
            e.graded_temp_compliance_pct,
            e.graded_vpd_compliance_pct,
            e.graded_stress_hours_heat,
            e.graded_stress_hours_cold,
            e.graded_stress_hours_vpd_high,
            e.graded_stress_hours_vpd_low,
            e.feasibility_unknown_min,
            e.dev_temp_norm_median_day,
            e.dev_temp_norm_median_night,
            e.dev_temp_norm_p95,
            e.dev_vpd_norm_median_day,
            e.dev_vpd_norm_median_night,
            e.dev_vpd_norm_p95,
            e.runtime_grow_light_main_min,
            e.runtime_grow_light_grow_min,
            e.quality_filtered_meter_gal,
            e.climate_wetting_gal,
            e.water_ok,
            e.modeled_kwh,
            e.energy_ok,
            e.crop_dli_mol_m2_day,
            e.dli_availability,
            e.dli_unavailable_reason,
            e.dli_provenance,
            e.dli_validity_revision,
            e.dli_valid_from,
            e.dli_valid_to,
            COALESCE(e.compliance_v2_attributable_pct, e.compliance_pct, 0::double precision) AS score_compliance,
            e.water_ok AND e.energy_ok AND e.cost_total IS NOT NULL AS resource_ok,
                CASE
                    WHEN e.water_ok THEN e.quality_filtered_meter_gal
                    WHEN e.date < CURRENT_DATE THEN e.water_used_gal
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS water_gal_source
           FROM evidence e
        )
 SELECT date,
    round(compliance_pct::numeric, 1) AS compliance_pct,
    round(temp_compliance_pct::numeric, 1) AS temp_compliance_pct,
    round(vpd_compliance_pct::numeric, 1) AS vpd_compliance_pct,
    round(stress_hours_heat::numeric, 2) AS heat_stress_h,
    round(stress_hours_cold::numeric, 2) AS cold_stress_h,
    round(stress_hours_vpd_high::numeric, 2) AS vpd_high_stress_h,
    round(stress_hours_vpd_low::numeric, 2) AS vpd_low_stress_h,
    round((stress_hours_heat + stress_hours_cold + stress_hours_vpd_high + stress_hours_vpd_low)::numeric, 2) AS total_stress_h,
        CASE
            WHEN energy_ok THEN round(modeled_kwh::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS kwh,
        CASE
            WHEN resource_ok THEN round(COALESCE(therms_estimated, gas_used_therms)::numeric, 3)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS therms,
        CASE
            WHEN water_ok THEN round(quality_filtered_meter_gal::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS water_gal,
        CASE
            WHEN water_ok THEN round(climate_wetting_gal::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS mister_water_gal,
        CASE
            WHEN energy_ok THEN round(cost_electric::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cost_electric,
        CASE
            WHEN resource_ok THEN round(cost_gas::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cost_gas,
        CASE
            WHEN water_ok THEN round(cost_water::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cost_water,
        CASE
            WHEN resource_ok THEN round(cost_total::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cost_total,
    round(temp_min::numeric, 1) AS temp_min,
    round(temp_max::numeric, 1) AS temp_max,
    round(temp_avg::numeric, 1) AS temp_avg,
    round(vpd_min::numeric, 2) AS vpd_min,
    round(vpd_max::numeric, 2) AS vpd_max,
    round(vpd_avg::numeric, 2) AS vpd_avg,
    round(crop_dli_mol_m2_day::numeric, 1) AS dli,
    round(min_dp_margin_f::numeric, 1) AS dp_margin_min_f,
    round(COALESCE(dp_risk_hours, 0::double precision)::numeric, 1) AS dp_risk_hours,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN resource_ok THEN score_compliance / 100.0::double precision * 80::double precision + GREATEST(0::double precision, 1.0::double precision - LEAST(cost_total / 15.0::double precision, 1.0::double precision)) * 20::double precision
            ELSE score_compliance
        END::numeric, 1) AS planner_score,
        CASE
            WHEN resource_ok THEN 20::numeric
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS planner_score_resource_weight_pct,
    resource_ok AS resource_terms_available,
    dli_availability,
    dli_unavailable_reason,
    dli_provenance,
    dli_validity_revision,
    dli_valid_from,
    dli_valid_to,
    round(modeled_kwh::numeric, 2) AS kwh_modeled,
    round(COALESCE(therms_estimated, gas_used_therms)::numeric, 3) AS therms_modeled,
    round(water_gal_source::numeric, 0) AS water_gal_est,
    COALESCE(round((modeled_kwh * 0.111::double precision)::numeric, 2), round(cost_electric::numeric, 2)) AS cost_electric_est,
    COALESCE(round((COALESCE(therms_estimated, gas_used_therms) * 0.83::double precision)::numeric, 2), round(cost_gas::numeric, 2)) AS cost_gas_est,
    COALESCE(round((water_gal_source * 0.00484::double precision)::numeric, 2), round(cost_water::numeric, 2)) AS cost_water_est,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(modeled_kwh * 0.111::double precision, cost_electric) IS NOT NULL THEN round((COALESCE(modeled_kwh * 0.111::double precision, cost_electric) + COALESCE(COALESCE(therms_estimated, gas_used_therms) * 0.83::double precision, cost_gas, 0::double precision) + COALESCE(water_gal_source * 0.00484::double precision, cost_water, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cost_total_est
   FROM normalized
  ORDER BY date;
v_daily_kpi.name: v_daily_kpi

v_daily_oscillation.definition:
WITH hourly AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, equipment_state.ts) AS date,
            date_trunc('hour'::text, equipment_state.ts) AS hour,
            equipment_state.equipment,
            count(*) AS transitions
           FROM equipment_state
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('day'::text, equipment_state.ts)), (date_trunc('hour'::text, equipment_state.ts)), equipment_state.equipment
        )
 SELECT date::date AS date,
    equipment,
    max(transitions) AS peak_transitions_per_hour,
    (array_agg(hour ORDER BY transitions DESC))[1] AS peak_hour,
    round(avg(transitions), 1) AS avg_transitions_per_hour,
    count(*) AS active_hours
   FROM hourly
  GROUP BY (date::date), equipment
  ORDER BY (date::date) DESC, equipment;
v_daily_oscillation.name: v_daily_oscillation

v_daily_oscillation_summary.definition:
SELECT date,
    sum(peak_transitions_per_hour) AS total_peak_per_hour,
    max(peak_transitions_per_hour) AS worst_equipment_peak,
    (array_agg(equipment ORDER BY peak_transitions_per_hour DESC))[1] AS worst_equipment,
    (array_agg(peak_hour ORDER BY peak_transitions_per_hour DESC))[1] AS worst_hour,
    round(avg(avg_transitions_per_hour), 1) AS avg_across_equipment
   FROM v_daily_oscillation
  GROUP BY date
  ORDER BY date DESC;
v_daily_oscillation_summary.name: v_daily_oscillation_summary

v_daily_plan_archive_self_check.definition:
WITH db_counts AS (
         SELECT "substring"(plan_journal.plan_id, 'iris-(\d{8})'::text)::date AS date,
            count(*) AS db_plan_count
           FROM plan_journal
          WHERE plan_journal.plan_id !~~ 'iris-reactive%'::text AND plan_journal.plan_id !~~ 'iris-fix%'::text AND "substring"(plan_journal.plan_id, 'iris-(\d{8})'::text) IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY ("substring"(plan_journal.plan_id, 'iris-(\d{8})'::text)::date)
        )
 SELECT ds.date,
    a.generated_at,
    a.page_path,
    COALESCE(a.generated_plan_count, 0) AS generated_plan_count,
    COALESCE(a.db_plan_count::bigint, dbc.db_plan_count, 0::bigint) AS db_plan_count,
    a.generated_cost_total,
    ds.cost_total AS db_cost_total,
    a.generated_water_gal,
    ds.water_used_gal AS db_water_gal,
    a.content_checksum,
        CASE
            WHEN a.date IS NULL THEN true
            WHEN a.generated_plan_count <> COALESCE(dbc.db_plan_count, 0::bigint) THEN true
            WHEN abs(COALESCE(a.generated_cost_total, ds.cost_total, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(ds.cost_total, 0::double precision)) > 0.01::double precision THEN true
            WHEN abs(COALESCE(a.generated_water_gal, ds.water_used_gal, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(ds.water_used_gal, 0::double precision)) > 0.1::double precision THEN true
            WHEN ds.captured_at IS NOT NULL AND a.generated_at < ds.captured_at THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS stale,
        CASE
            WHEN a.date IS NULL THEN 'missing_archive_audit'::text
            WHEN a.generated_plan_count <> COALESCE(dbc.db_plan_count, 0::bigint) THEN 'plan_count_mismatch'::text
            WHEN abs(COALESCE(a.generated_cost_total, ds.cost_total, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(ds.cost_total, 0::double precision)) > 0.01::double precision THEN 'cost_mismatch'::text
            WHEN abs(COALESCE(a.generated_water_gal, ds.water_used_gal, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(ds.water_used_gal, 0::double precision)) > 0.1::double precision THEN 'water_mismatch'::text
            WHEN ds.captured_at IS NOT NULL AND a.generated_at < ds.captured_at THEN 'archive_older_than_summary'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS status
   FROM daily_summary ds
     LEFT JOIN daily_plan_archive_audit a USING (date)
     LEFT JOIN db_counts dbc USING (date)
  WHERE ds.date >= '2026-03-24'::date;
v_daily_plan_archive_self_check.name: v_daily_plan_archive_self_check

v_data_pipeline_health.definition:
SELECT 'climate'::text AS source,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_1h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_24h,
    GREATEST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - max(climate.ts))::integer, 0) AS age_s,
    100.0::double precision * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval) AND (climate.temp_avg IS NULL OR climate.rh_avg IS NULL OR climate.vpd_avg IS NULL OR climate.dew_point IS NULL))::double precision / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)), 0)::double precision) AS null_pct_1h
   FROM climate
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'hydro'::text AS source,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval) AND (climate.hydro_ph IS NOT NULL OR climate.hydro_ec_us_cm IS NOT NULL)) AS rows_1h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND (climate.hydro_ph IS NOT NULL OR climate.hydro_ec_us_cm IS NOT NULL)) AS rows_24h,
    GREATEST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - max(climate.ts) FILTER (WHERE climate.hydro_ph IS NOT NULL OR climate.hydro_ec_us_cm IS NOT NULL))::integer, 0) AS age_s,
    100.0::double precision * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval) AND (climate.hydro_ph IS NULL OR climate.hydro_ec_us_cm IS NULL) AND (climate.hydro_ph IS NOT NULL OR climate.hydro_ec_us_cm IS NOT NULL))::double precision / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval) AND (climate.hydro_ph IS NOT NULL OR climate.hydro_ec_us_cm IS NOT NULL)), 0)::double precision) AS null_pct_1h
   FROM climate
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'equipment'::text AS source,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE equipment_state.ts > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_1h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE equipment_state.ts > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_24h,
    GREATEST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - max(equipment_state.ts))::integer, 0) AS age_s,
    NULL::double precision AS null_pct_1h
   FROM equipment_state
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'diagnostics'::text AS source,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnostics.ts > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_1h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnostics.ts > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_24h,
    GREATEST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - max(diagnostics.ts))::integer, 0) AS age_s,
    100.0::double precision * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnostics.ts > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval) AND (diagnostics.wifi_rssi IS NULL OR diagnostics.heap_bytes IS NULL OR diagnostics.uptime_s IS NULL OR diagnostics.active_probe_count IS NULL))::double precision / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnostics.ts > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)), 0)::double precision) AS null_pct_1h
   FROM diagnostics
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'energy'::text AS source,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE energy.ts > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_1h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE energy.ts > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_24h,
    GREATEST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - max(energy.ts))::integer, 0) AS age_s,
    NULL::double precision AS null_pct_1h
   FROM energy
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'setpoints'::text AS source,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE setpoint_changes.ts > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_1h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE setpoint_changes.ts > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_24h,
    GREATEST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - max(setpoint_changes.ts))::integer, 0) AS age_s,
    NULL::double precision AS null_pct_1h
   FROM setpoint_changes
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'forecast'::text AS source,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE weather_forecast.fetched_at > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_1h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE weather_forecast.fetched_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_24h,
    GREATEST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - max(weather_forecast.fetched_at))::integer, 0) AS age_s,
    100.0::double precision * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE weather_forecast.fetched_at = (( SELECT max(weather_forecast_1.fetched_at) AS max
           FROM weather_forecast weather_forecast_1)) AND (weather_forecast.temp_f IS NULL OR weather_forecast.rh_pct IS NULL OR weather_forecast.solar_w_m2 IS NULL))::double precision / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE weather_forecast.fetched_at = (( SELECT max(weather_forecast_1.fetched_at) AS max
           FROM weather_forecast weather_forecast_1))), 0)::double precision) AS null_pct_1h
   FROM weather_forecast
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'daily_summary'::text AS source,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE daily_summary.captured_at > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_1h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE daily_summary.captured_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS rows_24h,
    GREATEST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - max(daily_summary.captured_at))::integer, 0) AS age_s,
    100.0::double precision * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE daily_summary.date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date - 1) AND (daily_summary.temp_avg IS NULL OR daily_summary.rh_avg IS NULL OR daily_summary.vpd_avg IS NULL OR daily_summary.compliance_pct IS NULL))::double precision / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE daily_summary.date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date - 1)), 0)::double precision) AS null_pct_1h
   FROM daily_summary;
v_data_pipeline_health.name: v_data_pipeline_health

v_data_trust_ledger.definition:
SELECT 'climate_freshness'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN v_data_pipeline_health.age_s <= 300 THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'fail'::text
        END AS status,
    v_data_pipeline_health.age_s::numeric AS metric_value,
    300::numeric AS threshold_value,
    v_data_pipeline_health.source || ' age seconds'::text AS details
   FROM v_data_pipeline_health
  WHERE v_data_pipeline_health.source = 'climate'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'forecast_freshness'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN v_data_pipeline_health.age_s <= 21600 THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'fail'::text
        END AS status,
    v_data_pipeline_health.age_s::numeric AS metric_value,
    21600::numeric AS threshold_value,
    'weather_forecast fetched_at age seconds'::text AS details
   FROM v_data_pipeline_health
  WHERE v_data_pipeline_health.source = 'forecast'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'required_sensor_coverage'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_required_sensor_coverage.coverage_status <> 'ok'::text) = 0 THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'warn'::text
        END AS status,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_required_sensor_coverage.coverage_status <> 'ok'::text)::numeric AS metric_value,
    0::numeric AS threshold_value,
    'required configured sensors not ok'::text AS details
   FROM v_required_sensor_coverage
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'alert_lifecycle_mismatch'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'warn'::text
        END AS status,
    count(*)::numeric AS metric_value,
    0::numeric AS threshold_value,
    'alerts with resolved_at set but disposition not resolved'::text AS details
   FROM alert_log
  WHERE alert_log.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND alert_log.disposition <> 'resolved'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'open_critical_or_high_alerts'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'fail'::text
        END AS status,
    count(*)::numeric AS metric_value,
    0::numeric AS threshold_value,
    'open critical/high alerts'::text AS details
   FROM alert_log
  WHERE alert_log.disposition = 'open'::text AND (alert_log.severity = ANY (ARRAY['critical'::text, 'high'::text]))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'planner_trigger_sla_36h'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN v_planner_trigger_health.required_failure_count > 0 THEN 'fail'::text
            WHEN v_planner_trigger_health.missed_expected_count > 0 OR v_planner_trigger_health.overdue_delivered_count > 0 THEN 'warn'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS status,
    (v_planner_trigger_health.required_failure_count + v_planner_trigger_health.missed_expected_count + v_planner_trigger_health.overdue_delivered_count)::numeric AS metric_value,
    0::numeric AS threshold_value,
    'unrecovered required planner trigger failures or currently overdue expected/delivered triggers in last 36h'::text AS details
   FROM v_planner_trigger_health
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'data_gap_hours_24h'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(sum(data_gaps.duration_s), 0::double precision) = 0::double precision THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'warn'::text
        END AS status,
    round((COALESCE(sum(data_gaps.duration_s), 0::double precision) / 3600.0::double precision)::numeric, 2) AS metric_value,
    0::numeric AS threshold_value,
    'telemetry gap hours ending in the last 24h'::text AS details
   FROM data_gaps
  WHERE data_gaps.end_ts > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'water_accounting_14d'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_water_accountability.quality_flag = ANY (ARRAY['missing_total'::text, 'negative_total'::text, 'mister_exceeds_total'::text, 'negative_unaccounted'::text])) = 0 THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'warn'::text
        END AS status,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_water_accountability.quality_flag = ANY (ARRAY['missing_total'::text, 'negative_total'::text, 'mister_exceeds_total'::text, 'negative_unaccounted'::text]))::numeric AS metric_value,
    0::numeric AS threshold_value,
    'hard water-accounting failures in last 14 local days; unattributed water remains an instrumentation limitation'::text AS details
   FROM v_water_accountability
  WHERE v_water_accountability.date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date - 14)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'irrigation_logging_14d'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN expected.starts_14d = 0 OR logged.logs_14d >= expected.starts_14d THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'warn'::text
        END AS status,
    GREATEST(expected.starts_14d - logged.logs_14d, 0::bigint)::numeric AS metric_value,
    0::numeric AS threshold_value,
    'fertigation starts in equipment_state without canonical run rows in last 14 days'::text AS details
   FROM ( WITH ordered AS (
                 SELECT equipment_state.ts,
                    equipment_state.equipment,
                    equipment_state.state,
                    lag(equipment_state.state) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_state.equipment ORDER BY equipment_state.ts) AS prev_state
                   FROM equipment_state
                  WHERE (equipment_state.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['drip_wall_fert'::text, 'mister_south_fert'::text, 'mister_west_fert'::text, 'drip_center_fert'::text])) AND equipment_state.ts >= (now() - '14 days'::interval)
                )
         SELECT count(*) AS starts_14d
           FROM ordered
          WHERE ordered.state = true AND COALESCE(ordered.prev_state, false) = false) expected
     CROSS JOIN ( SELECT count(DISTINCT v_irrigation_fertigation_runs.run_id) AS logs_14d
           FROM v_irrigation_fertigation_runs
          WHERE v_irrigation_fertigation_runs.run_start >= (now() - '14 days'::interval)) logged
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'energy_reconciliation_14d'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_energy_estimate_reconciliation.quality_flag <> 'ok'::text) = 0 THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'warn'::text
        END AS status,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_energy_estimate_reconciliation.quality_flag <> 'ok'::text)::numeric AS metric_value,
    0::numeric AS threshold_value,
    'daily_summary measured kWh sync mismatches in last 14 local days'::text AS details
   FROM v_energy_estimate_reconciliation
  WHERE v_energy_estimate_reconciliation.date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date - 14)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'forecast_action_outcomes_7d'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE forecast_action_log.outcome IS NULL OR forecast_action_log.outcome = 'pending'::text) = 0 THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'warn'::text
        END AS status,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE forecast_action_log.outcome IS NULL OR forecast_action_log.outcome = 'pending'::text)::numeric AS metric_value,
    0::numeric AS threshold_value,
    'forecast action rows past follow-up window without evaluated outcome in last 7 days'::text AS details
   FROM forecast_action_log
  WHERE forecast_action_log.triggered_at > (now() - '7 days'::interval) AND forecast_action_log.triggered_at <= (now() - '06:00:00'::interval) AND forecast_action_log.action_taken <> 'evaluated_ok'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'crop_lifecycle_completeness'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN sum(v_crop_lifecycle_completeness.missing_count) FILTER (WHERE v_crop_lifecycle_completeness.is_active) = 0 THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'warn'::text
        END AS status,
    COALESCE(sum(v_crop_lifecycle_completeness.missing_count) FILTER (WHERE v_crop_lifecycle_completeness.is_active), 0::bigint)::numeric AS metric_value,
    0::numeric AS threshold_value,
    'missing active crop lifecycle fields'::text AS details
   FROM v_crop_lifecycle_completeness
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'daily_plan_archive_self_check'::text AS check_name,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_daily_plan_archive_self_check.stale) = 0 THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'warn'::text
        END AS status,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_daily_plan_archive_self_check.stale)::numeric AS metric_value,
    0::numeric AS threshold_value,
    'completed generated daily plan pages stale or unaudited'::text AS details
   FROM v_daily_plan_archive_self_check
  WHERE v_daily_plan_archive_self_check.date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date - 14) AND v_daily_plan_archive_self_check.date < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date;
v_data_trust_ledger.name: v_data_trust_ledger

v_dew_point_risk.definition:
WITH raw AS (
         SELECT climate.ts,
            (climate.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS local_date,
            climate.temp_avg - climate.dew_point AS margin_f
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.temp_avg IS NOT NULL AND climate.dew_point IS NOT NULL
        ), samples AS (
         SELECT raw.ts,
            raw.local_date,
            raw.margin_f,
            lead(raw.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY raw.local_date ORDER BY raw.ts) AS next_ts
           FROM raw
        ), durations AS (
         SELECT samples.local_date AS date,
            samples.margin_f,
            LEAST(GREATEST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(samples.next_ts, LEAST(now(), ((samples.local_date + 1)::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text))) - samples.ts), 0::numeric), 300::numeric) / 3600.0 AS hours_observed
           FROM samples
        )
 SELECT date,
    round(min(margin_f)::numeric, 1) AS min_margin_f,
    round(avg(margin_f)::numeric, 1) AS avg_margin_f,
    round(COALESCE(sum(hours_observed) FILTER (WHERE margin_f < 5::double precision), 0::numeric), 1) AS risk_hours,
    round(COALESCE(sum(hours_observed) FILTER (WHERE margin_f < 3::double precision), 0::numeric), 1) AS critical_hours
   FROM durations
  GROUP BY date
  ORDER BY date;
v_dew_point_risk.name: v_dew_point_risk

v_dif.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) AS date,
    round(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) >= 7::numeric AND EXTRACT(hour FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) <= 18::numeric THEN temp_avg
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END)::numeric, 2) AS day_avg_temp,
    round(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) < 7::numeric OR EXTRACT(hour FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) > 18::numeric THEN temp_avg
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END)::numeric, 2) AS night_avg_temp,
    round((avg(
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) >= 7::numeric AND EXTRACT(hour FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) <= 18::numeric THEN temp_avg
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END) - avg(
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) < 7::numeric OR EXTRACT(hour FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) > 18::numeric THEN temp_avg
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END))::numeric, 2) AS dif
   FROM climate
  WHERE temp_avg IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('day'::text, (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)))
  ORDER BY (date_trunc('day'::text, (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)));
v_dif.name: v_dif

v_disease_risk.definition:
WITH recent AS (
         SELECT climate.ts,
            climate.rh_avg,
            climate.temp_avg,
            climate.vpd_avg
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND climate.rh_avg IS NOT NULL AND climate.temp_avg IS NOT NULL
        ), botrytis_windows AS (
         SELECT recent.ts,
                CASE
                    WHEN recent.rh_avg > 85::double precision AND recent.temp_avg >= 60::double precision AND recent.temp_avg <= 80::double precision THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS botrytis_flag,
                CASE
                    WHEN recent.vpd_avg < 0.4::double precision THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS condensation_flag
           FROM recent
        )
 SELECT date_trunc('hour'::text, ts) AS hour,
    round(avg(botrytis_flag) * 100::numeric, 1) AS botrytis_risk_pct,
    round(avg(condensation_flag) * 100::numeric, 1) AS condensation_risk_pct,
    round(sum(botrytis_flag)::numeric * 2.0 / 60.0, 2) AS botrytis_consecutive_hours,
    round(sum(condensation_flag)::numeric * 2.0 / 60.0, 2) AS condensation_consecutive_hours
   FROM botrytis_windows
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, ts))
  ORDER BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, ts));
v_disease_risk.name: v_disease_risk

v_dli_current.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON ((COALESCE(c.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text))) c.ts,
            COALESCE(c.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) AS greenhouse_id,
            c.dli_today AS forensic_proxy_dli_mol_m2_day
           FROM climate c
          ORDER BY (COALESCE(c.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)), c.ts DESC
        )
 SELECT l.ts,
    l.greenhouse_id,
    NULL::double precision AS crop_dli_mol_m2_day,
    'unavailable'::text AS availability,
        CASE
            WHEN fn_dli_source_invalid_reason(l.forensic_proxy_dli_mol_m2_day) IS NOT NULL THEN fn_dli_source_invalid_reason(l.forensic_proxy_dli_mol_m2_day)
            ELSE COALESCE(v.unavailable_reason, 'validity_contract_missing'::text)
        END AS unavailable_reason,
    COALESCE(v.provenance, 'unknown_unvalidated_source'::text) AS provenance,
    COALESCE(v.validity_revision, 'missing'::text) AS validity_revision,
    v.valid_from,
    v.valid_to,
    l.forensic_proxy_dli_mol_m2_day IS NOT NULL AS forensic_proxy_present
   FROM latest l
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL fn_dli_validity(l.ts, l.greenhouse_id) v(availability, unavailable_reason, provenance, validity_revision, valid_from, valid_to, operator_validated) ON true;
v_dli_current.name: v_dli_current

v_dli_daily.definition:
WITH day_bounds AS (
         SELECT ds.date,
            COALESCE(ds.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) AS greenhouse_id,
            ds.dli_final AS forensic_proxy_dli_mol_m2_day,
            (ds.date::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS day_start,
            ((ds.date + 1)::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS day_end
           FROM daily_summary ds
          WHERE ds.date IS NOT NULL
        )
 SELECT d.date,
    d.greenhouse_id,
    NULL::double precision AS crop_dli_mol_m2_day,
    'unavailable'::text AS availability,
        CASE
            WHEN d.day_end > now() THEN 'source_day_incomplete'::text
            WHEN fn_dli_source_invalid_reason(d.forensic_proxy_dli_mol_m2_day) IS NOT NULL THEN fn_dli_source_invalid_reason(d.forensic_proxy_dli_mol_m2_day)
            ELSE COALESCE(v.unavailable_reason, 'validity_contract_missing'::text)
        END AS unavailable_reason,
    COALESCE(v.provenance, 'unknown_unvalidated_source'::text) AS provenance,
    COALESCE(v.validity_revision, 'missing'::text) AS validity_revision,
    v.valid_from,
    v.valid_to,
    d.forensic_proxy_dli_mol_m2_day IS NOT NULL AS forensic_proxy_present
   FROM day_bounds d
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL fn_dli_validity(d.day_start + '12:00:00'::interval, d.greenhouse_id) v(availability, unavailable_reason, provenance, validity_revision, valid_from, valid_to, operator_validated) ON true;
v_dli_daily.name: v_dli_daily

v_dli_forensic_history.definition:
SELECT c.ts,
    COALESCE(c.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) AS greenhouse_id,
    c.dli_today AS forensic_proxy_dli_mol_m2_day,
    'forensic_invalid_proxy'::text AS evidence_class,
    COALESCE(v.availability, 'unavailable'::text) AS availability,
    COALESCE(v.unavailable_reason, 'validity_contract_missing'::text) AS unavailable_reason,
    COALESCE(v.provenance, 'unknown_unvalidated_source'::text) AS provenance,
    COALESCE(v.validity_revision, 'missing'::text) AS validity_revision,
    v.valid_from,
    v.valid_to
   FROM climate c
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL fn_dli_validity(c.ts, COALESCE(c.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)) v(availability, unavailable_reason, provenance, validity_revision, valid_from, valid_to, operator_validated) ON true
  WHERE c.dli_today IS NOT NULL;
v_dli_forensic_history.name: v_dli_forensic_history

v_energy_daily.definition:
WITH intervals AS (
         WITH checked AS (
                 SELECT e.ts,
                    e.greenhouse_id,
                    e.watts_total,
                    e.ch0_source_ts,
                    e.ch1_source_ts,
                    COALESCE(e.measurement_revision = 'ha_shelly_power_v1'::text AND e.ch0_quality = 'ok'::text AND e.ch1_quality = 'ok'::text AND e.ch0_entity_id = 'sensor.shellyproem50_ac15186daafc_energy_meter_0_power'::text AND e.ch1_entity_id = 'sensor.shellyproem50_ac15186daafc_energy_meter_1_power'::text AND e.ch0_source_ts <= e.ts AND e.ch1_source_ts <= e.ts AND e.ch0_source_ts > (e.ts - '00:05:00'::interval) AND e.ch1_source_ts > (e.ts - '00:05:00'::interval) AND e.watts_total > '-Infinity'::double precision AND e.watts_total < 'Infinity'::double precision AND e.ch0_power_w > '-Infinity'::double precision AND e.ch0_power_w < 'Infinity'::double precision AND e.ch1_power_w > '-Infinity'::double precision AND e.ch1_power_w < 'Infinity'::double precision AND abs(e.watts_total::numeric - e.ch0_power_w::numeric - e.ch1_power_w::numeric) <= (GREATEST(abs(e.watts_total::numeric), abs(e.ch0_power_w::numeric), abs(e.ch1_power_w::numeric), 1::numeric) * 0.00000000000001), false) AS qualified
                   FROM energy e
                  WHERE isfinite(e.ts)
                ), grouped AS (
                 SELECT COALESCE(checked.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) AS greenhouse_id,
                    checked.ts,
                    count(*) = 1 AND bool_and(checked.qualified) AS qualified,
                    min(checked.watts_total) AS watts_total,
                    min(LEAST(checked.ch0_source_ts, checked.ch1_source_ts)) AS source_through_ts
                   FROM checked
                  GROUP BY (COALESCE(checked.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)), checked.ts
                ), sequenced AS (
                 SELECT grouped.greenhouse_id,
                    grouped.ts,
                    grouped.qualified,
                    grouped.watts_total,
                    grouped.source_through_ts,
                    lead(grouped.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY grouped.greenhouse_id ORDER BY grouped.ts) AS next_ts
                   FROM grouped
                )
         SELECT sequenced.greenhouse_id,
            sequenced.ts,
            sequenced.qualified,
            sequenced.watts_total,
            sequenced.source_through_ts,
                CASE
                    WHEN sequenced.qualified THEN GREATEST(sequenced.ts, LEAST(COALESCE(sequenced.next_ts, sequenced.ts), sequenced.ts + '00:05:00'::interval, sequenced.source_through_ts + '00:05:00'::interval))
                    ELSE sequenced.ts
                END AS end_ts
           FROM sequenced
        ), split AS (
         SELECT i.greenhouse_id,
            i.ts,
            i.qualified,
            i.watts_total,
            i.source_through_ts,
            i.end_ts,
            d.local_day::date AS local_date,
            (d.local_day AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS day_start,
            ((d.local_day + '1 day'::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS day_end
           FROM intervals i
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series((i.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date::timestamp without time zone, (i.end_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date::timestamp without time zone, '1 day'::interval) d(local_day)
        ), durations AS (
         SELECT split.greenhouse_id,
            split.ts,
            split.qualified,
            split.watts_total,
            split.source_through_ts,
            split.end_ts,
            split.local_date,
            split.day_start,
            split.day_end,
            GREATEST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(split.end_ts, split.day_end) - GREATEST(split.ts, split.day_start)), 0::numeric) AS observed_seconds
           FROM split
          WHERE split.ts < split.day_end AND (split.end_ts > split.day_start OR split.ts = split.end_ts)
        )
 SELECT local_date AS date,
    round(sum(watts_total::numeric * observed_seconds / 3600000::numeric) FILTER (WHERE observed_seconds > 0::numeric), 3) AS measured_kwh,
    round(sum(watts_total::numeric * observed_seconds) FILTER (WHERE observed_seconds > 0::numeric) / NULLIF(sum(observed_seconds), 0::numeric), 1) AS avg_watts,
    round(max(watts_total::numeric) FILTER (WHERE observed_seconds > 0::numeric), 1) AS peak_watts,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE observed_seconds > 0::numeric) AS sample_count,
    round(sum(observed_seconds) / 3600::numeric, 3)::double precision AS observed_hours,
    round(100::numeric * sum(observed_seconds) / EXTRACT(epoch FROM day_end - day_start), 1)::double precision AS meter_coverage_pct,
    'partial_shelly_two_channels'::text AS measured_scope,
        CASE
            WHEN sum(observed_seconds) = 0::numeric THEN 'unverified_source'::text
            WHEN local_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date THEN 'partial_day'::text
            WHEN (sum(observed_seconds) / EXTRACT(epoch FROM day_end - day_start)) < 0.9 THEN 'low_coverage'::text
            ELSE 'uncommissioned'::text
        END AS measured_quality,
    false AS available_for_scoring,
    greenhouse_id
   FROM durations
  GROUP BY local_date, day_start, day_end, greenhouse_id
  ORDER BY local_date;
v_energy_daily.name: v_energy_daily

v_energy_estimate_reconciliation.definition:
WITH days AS (
         SELECT v_runtime_energy_daily.date,
            v_runtime_energy_daily.greenhouse_id
           FROM v_runtime_energy_daily
        UNION
         SELECT v_energy_daily.date,
            v_energy_daily.greenhouse_id
           FROM v_energy_daily
        )
 SELECT d.date,
    r.modeled_kwh AS kwh_estimated,
    e.measured_kwh,
    NULL::numeric AS estimate_delta_kwh,
        CASE
            WHEN r.modeled_kwh IS NULL AND e.measured_kwh IS NULL THEN 'unavailable'::text
            WHEN r.modeled_kwh IS NULL THEN 'missing_runtime_model'::text
            WHEN e.measured_kwh IS NULL THEN 'missing_partial_measurement'::text
            ELSE 'scope_separated'::text
        END AS quality_flag,
    d.greenhouse_id,
    r.modeled_kwh_low,
    r.modeled_kwh_high,
    r.coefficient_revisions,
    r.modeled_scope,
    e.measured_scope,
    e.meter_coverage_pct,
    r.runtime_coverage_pct,
    r.model_quality,
    e.measured_quality,
    COALESCE(r.available_for_scoring, false) AS modeled_available_for_scoring,
    COALESCE(e.available_for_scoring, false) AS measured_available_for_scoring,
    r.runtime_evidence
   FROM days d
     LEFT JOIN v_runtime_energy_daily r ON r.date = d.date AND r.greenhouse_id = d.greenhouse_id
     LEFT JOIN v_energy_daily e ON e.date = d.date AND e.greenhouse_id = d.greenhouse_id;
v_energy_estimate_reconciliation.name: v_energy_estimate_reconciliation

v_energy_meter_health.definition:
SELECT greenhouse_id,
    observed_through AS latest_ts,
    (detail ->> 'sample_age_seconds'::text)::numeric AS sample_age_seconds,
    (detail ->> 'recent_sample_count'::text)::bigint AS recent_sample_count,
    detail ->> 'current_meter_status'::text AS meter_status,
    COALESCE((detail ->> 'current_meter_status'::text) = 'fresh'::text, false) AS fresh_for_observation,
    detail ->> 'scope'::text AS measured_scope
   FROM v_resource_accounting_health
  WHERE resource = 'energy_partial_meter'::text;
v_energy_meter_health.name: v_energy_meter_health

v_equipment_alias_resolution.definition:
SELECT e.greenhouse_id,
    e.slug AS input_slug,
    e.id AS equipment_id,
    e.slug AS canonical_slug,
    e.kind,
    e.name,
    'canonical'::text AS resolution_kind,
    'equipment'::text AS source,
    e.is_active
   FROM equipment e
  WHERE e.is_active
UNION ALL
 SELECT a.greenhouse_id,
    a.alias_slug AS input_slug,
    e.id AS equipment_id,
    e.slug AS canonical_slug,
    e.kind,
    e.name,
    a.alias_kind AS resolution_kind,
    a.source,
    e.is_active
   FROM equipment_aliases a
     JOIN equipment e ON e.id = a.equipment_id
  WHERE a.valid_to IS NULL AND e.is_active AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM equipment canonical
          WHERE canonical.greenhouse_id = a.greenhouse_id AND canonical.slug = a.alias_slug AND canonical.is_active));
v_equipment_alias_resolution.name: v_equipment_alias_resolution

v_equipment_assets_compat.definition:
SELECT e.id,
    e.slug AS equipment,
    e.name AS description,
    e.model,
    NULL::text AS serial_no,
    e.install_date,
    NULL::date AS warranty_exp,
    electric.coefficient_nominal AS wattage,
    gas.coefficient_nominal AS btu_rating,
    concat_ws(' '::text, e.notes, 'Canonical compatibility projection; maintenance_log remains on legacy equipment_assets.') AS notes
   FROM equipment e
     LEFT JOIN v_equipment_resource_catalog electric ON electric.equipment_id = e.id AND electric.resource_kind = 'electric_watts'::text
     LEFT JOIN v_equipment_resource_catalog gas ON gas.equipment_id = e.id AND gas.resource_kind = 'gas_btu_per_hour'::text
  WHERE e.is_active;
v_equipment_assets_compat.name: v_equipment_assets_compat

v_equipment_now.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipment) equipment,
    state,
    ts AS since,
    round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - ts)) AS seconds_ago
   FROM equipment_state
  ORDER BY equipment, ts DESC, state;
v_equipment_now.name: v_equipment_now

v_equipment_relay_map.definition:
SELECT sw.greenhouse_id,
    sw.board,
    sw.pin,
    sw.slug AS switch_slug,
    e.slug AS equipment_slug,
    e.name AS equipment_name,
    e.kind AS equipment_kind,
    e.model,
    z.slug AS zone_slug,
    z.name AS zone_name,
    sw.purpose,
    sw.state_source_column,
    sw.is_active
   FROM switches sw
     LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.id = sw.equipment_id
     LEFT JOIN zones z ON z.id = e.zone_id
  ORDER BY sw.board, sw.pin;
v_equipment_relay_map.name: v_equipment_relay_map

v_equipment_resource_catalog.definition:
SELECT e.greenhouse_id,
    e.id AS equipment_id,
    e.slug AS equipment_slug,
    e.kind AS equipment_kind,
    e.name AS equipment_name,
    c.resource_kind,
    c.unit,
    c.nominal_value AS coefficient_nominal,
    c.lower_bound AS coefficient_low,
    c.upper_bound AS coefficient_high,
    c.coefficient_source,
    c.revision AS coefficient_revision,
    c.evidence_ref,
    c.valid_from,
    c.valid_to,
    c.lower_bound <> c.upper_bound AS has_uncertainty,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('revision', h.revision, 'source', h.coefficient_source, 'nominal', h.nominal_value, 'low', h.lower_bound, 'high', h.upper_bound, 'unit', h.unit, 'evidence_ref', h.evidence_ref, 'valid_from', h.valid_from, 'valid_to', h.valid_to) ORDER BY h.valid_from, h.revision) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM resource_coefficients h
          WHERE h.equipment_id = c.equipment_id AND h.resource_kind = c.resource_kind AND h.id <> c.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS alternative_revisions
   FROM resource_coefficients c
     JOIN equipment e ON e.id = c.equipment_id
  WHERE c.is_model_default AND c.valid_to IS NULL AND e.is_active;
v_equipment_resource_catalog.name: v_equipment_resource_catalog

v_equipment_runtime_daily.definition:
WITH relevant AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(equipment_state.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) AS greenhouse_id,
            equipment_state.equipment,
            equipment_state.ts,
            bool_or(equipment_state.state) AS state,
            count(*) AS raw_rows,
            count(DISTINCT equipment_state.state) > 1 AS conflicting_state
           FROM equipment_state
          WHERE equipment_state.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['fan1'::text, 'fan2'::text, 'heat1'::text, 'heat2'::text, 'fog'::text, 'vent'::text, 'mister_south'::text, 'mister_west'::text, 'mister_center'::text, 'grow_light_main'::text, 'grow_light_grow'::text, 'drip_wall'::text, 'drip_center'::text, 'drip_wall_fert'::text, 'drip_center_fert'::text, 'mister_south_fert'::text, 'mister_west_fert'::text, 'fert_master_valve'::text])
          GROUP BY (COALESCE(equipment_state.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)), equipment_state.equipment, equipment_state.ts
        ), ordered AS (
         SELECT r.greenhouse_id,
            r.equipment,
            r.ts,
            r.state,
            r.raw_rows,
            r.conflicting_state,
            lag(r.state) OVER (PARTITION BY r.greenhouse_id, r.equipment ORDER BY r.ts) AS previous_state,
            lag(r.conflicting_state) OVER (PARTITION BY r.greenhouse_id, r.equipment ORDER BY r.ts) AS previous_conflicting_state
           FROM relevant r
        ), transition_events AS (
         SELECT ordered.greenhouse_id,
            ordered.equipment,
            ordered.ts,
            ordered.state,
            ordered.raw_rows,
            ordered.conflicting_state,
            ordered.previous_state,
            ordered.previous_conflicting_state
           FROM ordered
          WHERE ordered.previous_state IS DISTINCT FROM ordered.state OR ordered.previous_state IS NULL OR ordered.conflicting_state OR COALESCE(ordered.previous_conflicting_state, false)
        ), transitions AS (
         SELECT e.greenhouse_id,
            e.equipment,
            e.ts,
            e.state,
            e.raw_rows,
            e.conflicting_state,
            e.previous_state,
            e.previous_conflicting_state,
            lead(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY e.greenhouse_id, e.equipment ORDER BY e.ts) AS next_transition_ts
           FROM transition_events e
        ), equipment_bounds AS (
         SELECT relevant.greenhouse_id,
            relevant.equipment,
            GREATEST(min((relevant.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date - 45) AS first_day,
            (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS last_day
           FROM relevant
          GROUP BY relevant.greenhouse_id, relevant.equipment
        ), days AS (
         SELECT b.greenhouse_id,
            b.equipment,
            gs.gs::date AS day
           FROM equipment_bounds b
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(b.first_day::timestamp without time zone, b.last_day::timestamp without time zone, '1 day'::interval) gs(gs)
          WHERE b.first_day <= b.last_day
        ), day_bounds AS (
         SELECT d_1.greenhouse_id,
            d_1.equipment,
            d_1.day,
            (d_1.day::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS start_ts,
            ((d_1.day + 1)::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS end_ts,
            LEAST(((d_1.day + 1)::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text), now()) AS effective_end_ts,
            d_1.day < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS is_complete_day
           FROM days d_1
        ), day_context AS (
         SELECT b.greenhouse_id,
            b.equipment,
            b.day,
            b.start_ts,
            b.end_ts,
            b.effective_end_ts,
            b.is_complete_day,
            start_event.state AS start_state,
            start_event.ts AS start_state_ts,
            start_event.conflicting_state AS start_state_conflicting
           FROM day_bounds b
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.state,
                    t.ts,
                    t.conflicting_state
                   FROM transitions t
                  WHERE t.greenhouse_id = b.greenhouse_id AND t.equipment = b.equipment AND t.ts < b.start_ts
                  ORDER BY t.ts DESC
                 LIMIT 1) start_event ON true
        ), points AS (
         SELECT d_1.greenhouse_id,
            d_1.equipment,
            d_1.day,
            d_1.start_ts,
            d_1.end_ts,
            d_1.effective_end_ts,
            d_1.is_complete_day,
            d_1.start_state,
            d_1.start_state_ts,
            d_1.start_state_conflicting,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS next_transition_ts,
            d_1.start_ts AS ts,
            d_1.start_state AS state,
            false AS is_event
           FROM day_context d_1
          WHERE d_1.start_state IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT d_1.greenhouse_id,
            d_1.equipment,
            d_1.day,
            d_1.start_ts,
            d_1.end_ts,
            d_1.effective_end_ts,
            d_1.is_complete_day,
            d_1.start_state,
            d_1.start_state_ts,
            d_1.start_state_conflicting,
            t.next_transition_ts,
            t.ts,
            t.state,
            true AS is_event
           FROM day_context d_1
             JOIN transitions t ON t.greenhouse_id = d_1.greenhouse_id AND t.equipment = d_1.equipment AND t.ts >= d_1.start_ts AND t.ts < d_1.effective_end_ts
        ), sequenced_points AS (
         SELECT p_1.greenhouse_id,
            p_1.equipment,
            p_1.day,
            p_1.start_ts,
            p_1.end_ts,
            p_1.effective_end_ts,
            p_1.is_complete_day,
            p_1.start_state,
            p_1.start_state_ts,
            p_1.start_state_conflicting,
            p_1.next_transition_ts,
            p_1.ts,
            p_1.state,
            p_1.is_event,
            lag(p_1.state) OVER (PARTITION BY p_1.greenhouse_id, p_1.equipment, p_1.day ORDER BY p_1.ts, p_1.is_event) AS prior_state,
            lead(p_1.ts, 1, p_1.effective_end_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY p_1.greenhouse_id, p_1.equipment, p_1.day ORDER BY p_1.ts, p_1.is_event) AS next_ts
           FROM points p_1
        ), segment_metrics AS (
         SELECT sequenced_points.greenhouse_id,
            sequenced_points.equipment,
            sequenced_points.day,
            round(sum(EXTRACT(epoch FROM sequenced_points.next_ts - sequenced_points.ts) / 60.0) FILTER (WHERE sequenced_points.state IS TRUE AND sequenced_points.next_ts > sequenced_points.ts), 1) AS on_minutes,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sequenced_points.is_event AND sequenced_points.state IS TRUE AND sequenced_points.prior_state IS FALSE) AS starts,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sequenced_points.is_event AND sequenced_points.state IS TRUE AND sequenced_points.prior_state IS NULL) AS starts_with_unknown_prior_state,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sequenced_points.is_event AND sequenced_points.state IS TRUE AND sequenced_points.prior_state IS FALSE AND EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(COALESCE(sequenced_points.next_transition_ts, now()), now()) - sequenced_points.ts) < 60::numeric) AS cycles_under_1m,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sequenced_points.is_event AND sequenced_points.state IS TRUE AND sequenced_points.prior_state IS FALSE AND EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(COALESCE(sequenced_points.next_transition_ts, now()), now()) - sequenced_points.ts) >= 60::numeric AND EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(COALESCE(sequenced_points.next_transition_ts, now()), now()) - sequenced_points.ts) < 300::numeric) AS cycles_1m_to_5m,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sequenced_points.is_event AND sequenced_points.state IS TRUE AND sequenced_points.prior_state IS FALSE AND EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(COALESCE(sequenced_points.next_transition_ts, now()), now()) - sequenced_points.ts) >= 300::numeric AND EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(COALESCE(sequenced_points.next_transition_ts, now()), now()) - sequenced_points.ts) < 900::numeric) AS cycles_5m_to_15m,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sequenced_points.is_event AND sequenced_points.state IS TRUE AND sequenced_points.prior_state IS FALSE AND EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(COALESCE(sequenced_points.next_transition_ts, now()), now()) - sequenced_points.ts) >= 900::numeric) AS cycles_15m_plus,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sequenced_points.is_event AND sequenced_points.state IS TRUE AND (sequenced_points.next_transition_ts IS NULL OR sequenced_points.next_transition_ts > sequenced_points.effective_end_ts)) AS open_pulses_at_cutoff,
            (array_agg(sequenced_points.state ORDER BY sequenced_points.ts DESC, sequenced_points.is_event DESC))[1] AS end_state
           FROM sequenced_points
          GROUP BY sequenced_points.greenhouse_id, sequenced_points.equipment, sequenced_points.day
        ), day_event_quality AS (
         SELECT d_1.greenhouse_id,
            d_1.equipment,
            d_1.day,
            COALESCE(sum(o.raw_rows), 0::numeric)::bigint AS raw_event_rows,
            COALESCE(sum(o.raw_rows - 1), 0::numeric)::bigint AS same_timestamp_duplicate_rows,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT o.previous_state IS DISTINCT FROM o.state) AS redundant_state_rows,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.conflicting_state) AS conflicting_timestamp_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.previous_state IS NOT NULL AND o.previous_state IS DISTINCT FROM o.state) AS normalized_transition_count
           FROM day_context d_1
             LEFT JOIN ordered o ON o.greenhouse_id = d_1.greenhouse_id AND o.equipment = d_1.equipment AND o.ts >= d_1.start_ts AND o.ts < d_1.effective_end_ts
          GROUP BY d_1.greenhouse_id, d_1.equipment, d_1.day
        ), hourly_transitions AS (
         SELECT d_1.greenhouse_id,
            d_1.equipment,
            d_1.day,
            date_trunc('hour'::text, o.ts) AS hour_bucket,
            count(*)::integer AS transitions_in_hour
           FROM day_context d_1
             JOIN ordered o ON o.greenhouse_id = d_1.greenhouse_id AND o.equipment = d_1.equipment AND o.ts >= d_1.start_ts AND o.ts < d_1.effective_end_ts AND o.previous_state IS NOT NULL AND o.previous_state IS DISTINCT FROM o.state
          GROUP BY d_1.greenhouse_id, d_1.equipment, d_1.day, (date_trunc('hour'::text, o.ts))
        ), peak_transitions AS (
         SELECT hourly_transitions.greenhouse_id,
            hourly_transitions.equipment,
            hourly_transitions.day,
            max(hourly_transitions.transitions_in_hour) AS peak_transitions_per_hour
           FROM hourly_transitions
          GROUP BY hourly_transitions.greenhouse_id, hourly_transitions.equipment, hourly_transitions.day
        )
 SELECT d.day,
    d.equipment,
    COALESCE(s.on_minutes, 0.0) AS on_minutes,
    COALESCE(s.starts, 0::bigint) AS cycles,
    d.greenhouse_id,
    d.start_ts AS day_started_at,
    d.effective_end_ts AS observed_through,
    d.is_complete_day,
    d.start_state IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(d.start_state_conflicting, false) AS start_state_known,
    d.start_state,
    s.end_state,
    COALESCE(s.end_state, d.start_state, false) AS open_at_end,
    d.is_complete_day AND d.start_state IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(d.start_state_conflicting, false) AND COALESCE(q.conflicting_timestamp_count, 0::bigint) = 0 AS is_deploy_gate_eligible,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT d.is_complete_day THEN 'partial_day'::text
            WHEN d.start_state IS NULL THEN 'unknown_start_state'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(d.start_state_conflicting, false) THEN 'conflicting_carry_state'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(q.conflicting_timestamp_count, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'conflicting_events'::text
            ELSE 'complete'::text
        END AS quality,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN NOT d.is_complete_day THEN 'partial_day'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN d.start_state IS NULL THEN 'unknown_start_state'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(d.start_state_conflicting, false) THEN 'conflicting_carry_state'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(q.conflicting_timestamp_count, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'conflicting_same_timestamp'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(s.open_pulses_at_cutoff, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'open_pulse_at_cutoff'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(q.same_timestamp_duplicate_rows, 0::bigint) > 0 OR COALESCE(q.redundant_state_rows, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'duplicates_collapsed'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END], NULL::text) AS quality_flags,
    COALESCE(s.starts, 0::bigint) AS starts,
    COALESCE(s.cycles_under_1m, 0::bigint) AS cycles_under_1m,
    COALESCE(s.cycles_1m_to_5m, 0::bigint) AS cycles_1m_to_5m,
    COALESCE(s.cycles_under_1m, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(s.cycles_1m_to_5m, 0::bigint) AS short_cycles_under_5m,
    COALESCE(s.cycles_5m_to_15m, 0::bigint) AS cycles_5m_to_15m,
    COALESCE(s.cycles_15m_plus, 0::bigint) AS cycles_15m_plus,
    COALESCE(s.open_pulses_at_cutoff, 0::bigint) AS open_pulses_at_cutoff,
    COALESCE(p.peak_transitions_per_hour, 0) AS peak_transitions_per_hour,
    COALESCE(q.raw_event_rows, 0::bigint) AS raw_event_rows,
    COALESCE(q.normalized_transition_count, 0::bigint) AS normalized_transition_count,
    COALESCE(q.same_timestamp_duplicate_rows, 0::bigint) AS same_timestamp_duplicate_rows,
    COALESCE(q.redundant_state_rows, 0::bigint) AS redundant_state_rows,
    COALESCE(q.conflicting_timestamp_count, 0::bigint) AS conflicting_timestamp_count,
    COALESCE(s.starts_with_unknown_prior_state, 0::bigint) AS starts_with_unknown_prior_state
   FROM day_context d
     LEFT JOIN segment_metrics s USING (greenhouse_id, equipment, day)
     LEFT JOIN day_event_quality q USING (greenhouse_id, equipment, day)
     LEFT JOIN peak_transitions p USING (greenhouse_id, equipment, day);
v_equipment_runtime_daily.name: v_equipment_runtime_daily

v_equipment_runtime_today.definition:
SELECT equipment,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN state = true THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS on_events,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN state = false THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS off_events
   FROM equipment_state
  WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day'::text, now())
  GROUP BY equipment;
v_equipment_runtime_today.name: v_equipment_runtime_today

v_estimated_dli.definition:
WITH readings AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, (c.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text))::date AS date,
            COALESCE(EXTRACT(epoch FROM lead(c.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY (date_trunc('day'::text, (c.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text))::date) ORDER BY c.ts) - c.ts), 300::numeric) AS dt_sec
           FROM climate c
          WHERE c.outdoor_lux > 0::double precision AND c.solar_azimuth_deg IS NOT NULL AND c.solar_altitude_deg > 0::double precision
        )
 SELECT date,
    NULL::numeric AS est_natural_dli,
    count(*) AS readings,
    'unavailable'::text AS availability,
    'interior_light_sensor_broken'::text AS unavailable_reason,
    'outdoor_lux_glazing_model_not_interior_crop_dli'::text AS provenance,
    'dli-validity-v1'::text AS validity_revision,
    '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AS valid_from,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS valid_to
   FROM readings r
  WHERE dt_sec > 0::numeric AND dt_sec < 900::numeric
  GROUP BY date
  ORDER BY date;
v_estimated_dli.name: v_estimated_dli

v_estimated_indoor_light.definition:
SELECT time_bucket('00:15:00'::interval, ts) AS bucket,
    round(avg(outdoor_lux * fn_glazing_transmission(solar_azimuth_deg))::numeric, 0) AS est_indoor_lux,
    round(avg(outdoor_lux * fn_glazing_transmission(solar_azimuth_deg) * 0.0185::double precision)::numeric, 1) AS est_ppfd,
    round(avg(solar_altitude_deg)::numeric, 1) AS sun_altitude,
    round(avg(outdoor_lux)::numeric, 0) AS outdoor_lux,
    round(avg(fn_glazing_transmission(solar_azimuth_deg) * 100::double precision)::numeric, 1) AS transmission_pct
   FROM climate
  WHERE outdoor_lux > 0::double precision AND solar_azimuth_deg IS NOT NULL AND solar_altitude_deg > 0::double precision
  GROUP BY (time_bucket('00:15:00'::interval, ts))
  ORDER BY (time_bucket('00:15:00'::interval, ts));
v_estimated_indoor_light.name: v_estimated_indoor_light

v_estimated_plant_dli.definition:
SELECT ds.date,
    NULL::numeric AS sensor_dli,
    NULL::numeric AS corrected_solar_dli,
    round((COALESCE(ds.runtime_grow_light_min, 0::double precision) / 60.0::double precision)::numeric, 1) AS grow_light_hours,
    NULL::numeric AS grow_light_dli,
    NULL::numeric AS estimated_plant_dli,
    'UNAVAILABLE'::text AS dli_status,
    d.availability,
    d.unavailable_reason,
    d.provenance,
    d.validity_revision,
    d.valid_from,
    d.valid_to
   FROM daily_summary ds
     LEFT JOIN v_dli_daily d ON d.date = ds.date AND d.greenhouse_id = COALESCE(ds.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)
  ORDER BY ds.date DESC;
v_estimated_plant_dli.name: v_estimated_plant_dli

v_experiment_v2_blinded_assigned_day_out.definition:
SELECT o.experiment_id,
    o.assignment_id,
    o.pair_index,
    o.day_index,
    o.blinded_arm,
    o.assigned_local_date,
    o.itt_range,
    f.outcome_payload,
    f.delivery_failed,
    f.fallback_used,
    f.facility_rescue,
    f.zero_value_retained,
    f.null_value_retained,
    f.outcome_sha256,
    f.exposure_seconds,
    f.expected_seconds,
    f.exposure_seconds::numeric / f.expected_seconds::numeric AS exposure_coverage_sensitivity,
    d.deviation_payload,
    d.deviation_sha256,
    d.fidelity_payload,
    d.fidelity_sha256,
    d.environment_payload,
    d.environment_sha256,
    d.integrity_payload,
    d.integrity_sha256,
    d.evidence_bundle_sha256,
    d.integrity_passed,
    f.frozen_at AS outcome_frozen_at,
    d.frozen_at AS evidence_frozen_at
   FROM experiment_v2_outcomes o
     JOIN experiment_v2_outcome_freezes f USING (assignment_id)
     LEFT JOIN experiment_v2_day_evidence d USING (assignment_id);
v_experiment_v2_blinded_assigned_day_out.name: v_experiment_v2_blinded_assigned_day_outcomes

v_experiment_v2_frozen_analyzer_input.definition:
SELECT experiment_id,
    export_sha256,
    evidence_bundle_sha256,
    analyzer_environment_sha256,
    export_payload,
    frozen_at
   FROM experiment_v2_exports e;
v_experiment_v2_frozen_analyzer_input.name: v_experiment_v2_frozen_analyzer_input

v_experiment_v2_revealed_analyzer_input.definition:
SELECT o.experiment_id,
    o.assignment_id,
    o.pair_index,
    o.day_index,
    o.blinded_arm,
    reveal.mapping_payload ->> o.blinded_arm AS physical_arm,
    o.assigned_local_date,
    o.itt_range,
    frozen.outcome_payload,
    frozen.outcome_sha256,
    frozen.delivery_failed,
    frozen.fallback_used,
    frozen.facility_rescue,
    frozen.zero_value_retained,
    frozen.null_value_retained,
    evidence.deviation_payload,
    evidence.deviation_sha256,
    evidence.fidelity_payload,
    evidence.fidelity_sha256,
    evidence.environment_payload,
    evidence.environment_sha256,
    evidence.integrity_payload,
    evidence.integrity_sha256,
    evidence.evidence_bundle_sha256,
    evidence.integrity_passed,
    export.export_sha256,
    export.analyzer_environment_sha256,
    reveal.mapping_payload_sha256,
    reveal.reveal_receipt_sha256,
    reveal.revealed_at
   FROM experiment_v2_reveals reveal
     JOIN experiment_v2_exports export USING (experiment_id, export_sha256)
     JOIN experiment_v2_outcomes o USING (experiment_id)
     JOIN experiment_v2_outcome_freezes frozen USING (assignment_id)
     JOIN experiment_v2_day_evidence evidence USING (assignment_id, experiment_id)
  WHERE evidence.integrity_passed AND ((reveal.mapping_payload ->> o.blinded_arm) = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text]));

v_fan_balance_7d.definition:
WITH bounds AS (
         SELECT now() - '7 days'::interval AS start_ts,
            now() AS end_ts
        ), fan_set AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT es.greenhouse_id,
            es.equipment
           FROM equipment_state es
          WHERE es.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['fan1'::text, 'fan2'::text])
        ), seed AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (fs.greenhouse_id, fs.equipment) fs.greenhouse_id,
            fs.equipment,
            b_1.start_ts AS ts,
            COALESCE(es.state, false) AS state
           FROM fan_set fs
             CROSS JOIN bounds b_1
             LEFT JOIN equipment_state es ON es.greenhouse_id = fs.greenhouse_id AND es.equipment = fs.equipment AND es.ts <= b_1.start_ts
          ORDER BY fs.greenhouse_id, fs.equipment, es.ts DESC NULLS LAST
        ), events AS (
         SELECT seed.greenhouse_id,
            seed.equipment,
            seed.ts,
            seed.state
           FROM seed
        UNION ALL
         SELECT es.greenhouse_id,
            es.equipment,
            es.ts,
            es.state
           FROM equipment_state es
             CROSS JOIN bounds b_1
          WHERE (es.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['fan1'::text, 'fan2'::text])) AND es.ts > b_1.start_ts AND es.ts <= b_1.end_ts
        ), ordered AS (
         SELECT e.greenhouse_id,
            e.equipment,
            e.ts,
            e.state,
            lag(e.state) OVER (PARTITION BY e.greenhouse_id, e.equipment ORDER BY e.ts) AS prev_state,
            lead(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY e.greenhouse_id, e.equipment ORDER BY e.ts) AS next_ts
           FROM events e
        ), rollup AS (
         SELECT o.greenhouse_id,
            o.equipment,
            sum(EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(COALESCE(o.next_ts, b_1.end_ts), b_1.end_ts) - GREATEST(o.ts, b_1.start_ts)) / 60.0) FILTER (WHERE o.state IS TRUE) AS on_minutes,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.state IS TRUE AND COALESCE(o.prev_state, false) IS FALSE AND o.ts > b_1.start_ts) AS cycles
           FROM ordered o
             CROSS JOIN bounds b_1
          WHERE o.ts < b_1.end_ts AND COALESCE(o.next_ts, b_1.end_ts) > b_1.start_ts
          GROUP BY o.greenhouse_id, o.equipment
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(f1.greenhouse_id, f2.greenhouse_id) AS greenhouse_id,
    b.start_ts AS window_start,
    b.end_ts AS window_end,
    round(COALESCE(f1.on_minutes, 0::numeric), 1) AS fan1_minutes,
    round(COALESCE(f2.on_minutes, 0::numeric), 1) AS fan2_minutes,
    COALESCE(f1.cycles, 0::bigint) AS fan1_cycles,
    COALESCE(f2.cycles, 0::bigint) AS fan2_cycles,
    round(abs(COALESCE(f1.on_minutes, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(f2.on_minutes, 0::numeric)), 1) AS imbalance_minutes,
    round(100.0 * abs(COALESCE(f1.on_minutes, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(f2.on_minutes, 0::numeric)) / NULLIF(GREATEST(COALESCE(f1.on_minutes, 0::numeric), COALESCE(f2.on_minutes, 0::numeric)), 0::numeric), 1) AS imbalance_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(f1.on_minutes, 0::numeric) <= COALESCE(f2.on_minutes, 0::numeric) THEN 'fan1'::text
            ELSE 'fan2'::text
        END AS lower_runtime_fan,
    abs(COALESCE(f1.on_minutes, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(f2.on_minutes, 0::numeric)) > 10.0 AS rebalance_needed
   FROM bounds b
     LEFT JOIN rollup f1 ON f1.equipment = 'fan1'::text
     LEFT JOIN rollup f2 ON f2.equipment = 'fan2'::text AND f2.greenhouse_id = f1.greenhouse_id;
v_fan_balance_7d.name: v_fan_balance_7d

v_forecast_accuracy.definition:
WITH weather AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_hour) v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_hour,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.fetched_at,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.lead_hours,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_temp,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_rh,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_vpd,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_solar,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.actual_temp,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.actual_rh,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.actual_vpd,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.actual_solar,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.temp_minutes,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.rh_minutes,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.vpd_minutes,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.solar_minutes,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.vintage_rows,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.vintage_conflict,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.lead_bucket,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.temp_error_f,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.rh_error_pct,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.vpd_error_kpa,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.solar_error_w,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.verification_contract_version
           FROM v_forecast_outdoor_pairs
          ORDER BY v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_hour, v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.fetched_at DESC
        ), solar AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_hour) v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_hour,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.fetched_at,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.lead_hours,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_temp,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_rh,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_vpd,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_solar,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.actual_temp,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.actual_rh,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.actual_vpd,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.actual_solar,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.temp_minutes,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.rh_minutes,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.vpd_minutes,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.solar_minutes,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.vintage_rows,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.vintage_conflict,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.lead_bucket,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.temp_error_f,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.rh_error_pct,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.vpd_error_kpa,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.solar_error_w,
            v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.verification_contract_version
           FROM v_forecast_outdoor_pairs
          WHERE v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.lead_hours >= 1::numeric
          ORDER BY v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.forecast_hour, v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.fetched_at DESC
        )
 SELECT w.forecast_hour,
    w.fetched_at,
    round(w.lead_hours, 1) AS lead_hours,
    w.forecast_temp,
    w.actual_temp,
    round(w.temp_error_f::numeric, 1) AS temp_error_f,
    w.forecast_vpd,
    w.actual_vpd,
    round(w.vpd_error_kpa::numeric, 2) AS vpd_error_kpa,
    s.forecast_solar,
    s.actual_solar,
    round(s.solar_error_w::numeric, 1) AS solar_error_w,
    w.forecast_rh,
    w.actual_rh,
    w.rh_error_pct,
    w.temp_minutes,
    w.rh_minutes,
    w.vpd_minutes,
    s.solar_minutes,
    w.vintage_rows,
    w.vintage_conflict,
    w.verification_contract_version,
    s.fetched_at AS solar_fetched_at,
    s.lead_hours AS solar_lead_hours,
    s.vintage_conflict AS solar_vintage_conflict
   FROM weather w
     LEFT JOIN solar s USING (forecast_hour);
v_forecast_accuracy.name: v_forecast_accuracy

v_forecast_accuracy_daily.definition:
SELECT (f.forecast_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS date,
    p.param,
    avg(p.forecast) FILTER (WHERE p.actual IS NOT NULL) AS forecast_avg,
    avg(p.actual) FILTER (WHERE p.forecast IS NOT NULL) AS observed_avg,
    avg(p.forecast - p.actual) AS bias,
    avg(abs(p.forecast - p.actual)) AS abs_error,
    round(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN p.param = 'solar_w_m2'::text THEN f.solar_lead_hours
            ELSE f.lead_hours
        END) FILTER (WHERE p.forecast IS NOT NULL AND p.actual IS NOT NULL), 1) AS horizon_hours,
    count(p.forecast - p.actual) AS samples,
    sum(p.observed_minutes) FILTER (WHERE p.forecast IS NOT NULL AND p.actual IS NOT NULL) AS observed_minutes,
    2 AS verification_contract_version
   FROM v_forecast_accuracy f
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES ('temp_f'::text,f.forecast_temp,f.actual_temp,f.temp_minutes), ('rh_pct'::text,f.forecast_rh,f.actual_rh,f.rh_minutes), ('vpd_kpa'::text,f.forecast_vpd,f.actual_vpd,f.vpd_minutes), ('solar_w_m2'::text,f.forecast_solar,f.actual_solar,f.solar_minutes), ('cloud_cover_pct'::text,NULL::double precision,NULL::double precision,0::bigint)) p(param, forecast, actual, observed_minutes)
  WHERE f.forecast_hour >= (now() - '14 days'::interval)
  GROUP BY ((f.forecast_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date), p.param;
v_forecast_accuracy_daily.name: v_forecast_accuracy_daily

v_forecast_accuracy_lead_buckets.definition:
WITH candidates AS (
         SELECT f_1.forecast_hour,
            f_1.fetched_at,
            f_1.lead_hours,
            f_1.forecast_temp,
            f_1.forecast_rh,
            f_1.forecast_vpd,
            f_1.forecast_solar,
            f_1.actual_temp,
            f_1.actual_rh,
            f_1.actual_vpd,
            f_1.actual_solar,
            f_1.temp_minutes,
            f_1.rh_minutes,
            f_1.vpd_minutes,
            f_1.solar_minutes,
            f_1.vintage_rows,
            f_1.vintage_conflict,
            f_1.lead_bucket,
            f_1.temp_error_f,
            f_1.rh_error_pct,
            f_1.vpd_error_kpa,
            f_1.solar_error_w,
            f_1.verification_contract_version,
            p.param,
            p.error,
            p.observed_minutes
           FROM v_forecast_outdoor_pairs f_1
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES ('temp_f'::text,f_1.temp_error_f,f_1.temp_minutes), ('rh_pct'::text,f_1.rh_error_pct,f_1.rh_minutes), ('vpd_kpa'::text,f_1.vpd_error_kpa,f_1.vpd_minutes), ('solar_w_m2'::text,f_1.solar_error_w,f_1.solar_minutes)) p(param, error, observed_minutes)
          WHERE p.param <> 'solar_w_m2'::text OR f_1.lead_hours >= 1::numeric
        ), selected AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (candidates.forecast_hour, candidates.lead_bucket, candidates.param) candidates.forecast_hour,
            candidates.fetched_at,
            candidates.lead_hours,
            candidates.forecast_temp,
            candidates.forecast_rh,
            candidates.forecast_vpd,
            candidates.forecast_solar,
            candidates.actual_temp,
            candidates.actual_rh,
            candidates.actual_vpd,
            candidates.actual_solar,
            candidates.temp_minutes,
            candidates.rh_minutes,
            candidates.vpd_minutes,
            candidates.solar_minutes,
            candidates.vintage_rows,
            candidates.vintage_conflict,
            candidates.lead_bucket,
            candidates.temp_error_f,
            candidates.rh_error_pct,
            candidates.vpd_error_kpa,
            candidates.solar_error_w,
            candidates.verification_contract_version,
            candidates.param,
            candidates.error,
            candidates.observed_minutes
           FROM candidates
          ORDER BY candidates.forecast_hour, candidates.lead_bucket, candidates.param, candidates.fetched_at DESC
        )
 SELECT (forecast_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS date,
    lead_bucket,
    param,
    count(error) AS samples,
    round(avg(error)::numeric,
        CASE param
            WHEN 'vpd_kpa'::text THEN 3
            WHEN 'solar_w_m2'::text THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END) AS bias,
    round(avg(abs(error))::numeric,
        CASE param
            WHEN 'vpd_kpa'::text THEN 3
            WHEN 'solar_w_m2'::text THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END) AS mae,
    round(avg(lead_hours) FILTER (WHERE error IS NOT NULL), 2) AS mean_lead_hours,
    sum(observed_minutes) FILTER (WHERE error IS NOT NULL) AS observed_minutes,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vintage_conflict) AS conflicting_hours,
    2 AS verification_contract_version
   FROM selected f
  GROUP BY ((forecast_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date), lead_bucket, param;
v_forecast_accuracy_lead_buckets.name: v_forecast_accuracy_lead_buckets

SELECT DISTINCT ON (ts) ts,

v_forecast_outdoor_hourly.definition:
WITH minutes AS (
         SELECT date_bin('00:01:00'::interval, climate.ts, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AS minute,
            avg(climate.outdoor_temp_f) FILTER (WHERE climate.outdoor_temp_f >= '-100'::integer::double precision AND climate.outdoor_temp_f <= 150::double precision) AS temp_f,
            avg(climate.outdoor_rh_pct) FILTER (WHERE climate.outdoor_rh_pct >= 0::double precision AND climate.outdoor_rh_pct <= 100::double precision) AS rh_pct,
            avg(climate.solar_irradiance_w_m2) FILTER (WHERE climate.solar_irradiance_w_m2 >= 0::double precision AND climate.solar_irradiance_w_m2 < 'Infinity'::double precision) AS solar_w_m2
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.ts >= date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, now() - '30 days 01:00:00'::interval, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND climate.ts < date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, now(), '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)
          GROUP BY (date_bin('00:01:00'::interval, climate.ts, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))
        ), samples AS (
         SELECT minutes.minute,
            minutes.temp_f,
            minutes.rh_pct,
            minutes.solar_w_m2,
                CASE
                    WHEN minutes.temp_f IS NOT NULL AND minutes.rh_pct IS NOT NULL THEN 0.6108::double precision * exp(17.27::double precision * ((minutes.temp_f - 32::double precision) / 1.8::double precision) / ((minutes.temp_f - 32::double precision) / 1.8::double precision + 237.3::double precision)) * (1::double precision - minutes.rh_pct / 100.0::double precision)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS vpd_kpa
           FROM minutes
        )
 SELECT date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, minute, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AS hour,
    avg(temp_f) FILTER (WHERE minute = date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, minute, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) AS actual_temp,
