    avg(rh_pct) FILTER (WHERE minute = date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, minute, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) AS actual_rh,
    avg(vpd_kpa) FILTER (WHERE minute = date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, minute, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) AS actual_vpd,
        CASE
            WHEN count(solar_w_m2) = 60 THEN avg(solar_w_m2)
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS actual_solar,
    count(temp_f) FILTER (WHERE minute = date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, minute, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) AS temp_minutes,
    count(rh_pct) FILTER (WHERE minute = date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, minute, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) AS rh_minutes,
    count(vpd_kpa) FILTER (WHERE minute = date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, minute, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) AS vpd_minutes,
    count(solar_w_m2) AS solar_minutes
   FROM samples
  GROUP BY (date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, minute, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone));
v_forecast_outdoor_hourly.name: v_forecast_outdoor_hourly

v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.definition:
WITH vintages AS (
         SELECT weather_forecast.ts,
            weather_forecast.fetched_at,
            count(*) AS vintage_rows,
            count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(weather_forecast.temp_f, weather_forecast.rh_pct, weather_forecast.vpd_kpa, weather_forecast.solar_w_m2)) > 1 AS vintage_conflict,
            min(weather_forecast.temp_f) AS temp_f,
            min(weather_forecast.rh_pct) AS rh_pct,
            min(weather_forecast.vpd_kpa) AS vpd_kpa,
            min(weather_forecast.solar_w_m2) AS solar_w_m2
           FROM weather_forecast
          WHERE weather_forecast.ts >= date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, now() - '30 days'::interval, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND weather_forecast.ts < date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, now(), '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND weather_forecast.ts = date_bin('01:00:00'::interval, weather_forecast.ts, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND weather_forecast.fetched_at <= weather_forecast.ts
          GROUP BY weather_forecast.ts, weather_forecast.fetched_at
        ), paired AS (
         SELECT f.ts AS forecast_hour,
            f.fetched_at,
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM f.ts - f.fetched_at) / 3600.0 AS lead_hours,
                CASE
                    WHEN NOT f.vintage_conflict AND f.temp_f >= '-100'::integer::double precision AND f.temp_f <= 150::double precision THEN f.temp_f
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS forecast_temp,
                CASE
                    WHEN NOT f.vintage_conflict AND f.rh_pct >= 0::double precision AND f.rh_pct <= 100::double precision THEN f.rh_pct
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS forecast_rh,
                CASE
                    WHEN NOT f.vintage_conflict AND f.vpd_kpa >= 0::double precision AND f.vpd_kpa < 'Infinity'::double precision THEN f.vpd_kpa
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS forecast_vpd,
                CASE
                    WHEN NOT f.vintage_conflict AND f.fetched_at <= (f.ts - '01:00:00'::interval) AND f.solar_w_m2 >= 0::double precision AND f.solar_w_m2 < 'Infinity'::double precision THEN f.solar_w_m2
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS forecast_solar,
            o.actual_temp,
            o.actual_rh,
            o.actual_vpd,
            s.actual_solar,
            COALESCE(o.temp_minutes, 0::bigint) AS temp_minutes,
            COALESCE(o.rh_minutes, 0::bigint) AS rh_minutes,
            COALESCE(o.vpd_minutes, 0::bigint) AS vpd_minutes,
            COALESCE(s.solar_minutes, 0::bigint) AS solar_minutes,
            f.vintage_rows,
            f.vintage_conflict
           FROM vintages f
             LEFT JOIN v_forecast_outdoor_hourly o ON o.hour = f.ts
             LEFT JOIN v_forecast_outdoor_hourly s ON s.hour = (f.ts - '01:00:00'::interval)
        )
 SELECT forecast_hour,
    fetched_at,
    lead_hours,
    forecast_temp,
    forecast_rh,
    forecast_vpd,
    forecast_solar,
    actual_temp,
    actual_rh,
    actual_vpd,
    actual_solar,
    temp_minutes,
    rh_minutes,
    vpd_minutes,
    solar_minutes,
    vintage_rows,
    vintage_conflict,
        CASE
            WHEN lead_hours < 6::numeric THEN '00-06h'::text
            WHEN lead_hours < 24::numeric THEN '06-24h'::text
            WHEN lead_hours < 48::numeric THEN '24-48h'::text
            ELSE '48h+'::text
        END AS lead_bucket,
    forecast_temp - actual_temp AS temp_error_f,
    forecast_rh - actual_rh AS rh_error_pct,
    forecast_vpd - actual_vpd AS vpd_error_kpa,
    forecast_solar - actual_solar AS solar_error_w,
    2 AS verification_contract_version
   FROM paired;
v_forecast_outdoor_pairs.name: v_forecast_outdoor_pairs

v_forecast_plan_outcome_mart.definition:
WITH plan_days AS (
         SELECT pj.plan_id,
            (pj.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS date,
            pj.created_at,
            pj.hypothesis,
            pj.experiment,
            pj.expected_outcome,
            pj.actual_outcome,
            pj.outcome_score,
            pj.validated_at,
            pj.planner_instance,
            pj.trigger_id
           FROM plan_journal pj
          WHERE pj.plan_id !~~ 'iris-reactive%'::text
        ), forecast_day AS (
         SELECT v_forecast_accuracy_lead_buckets.date,
            avg(v_forecast_accuracy_lead_buckets.mae) FILTER (WHERE v_forecast_accuracy_lead_buckets.param = 'temp_f'::text) AS temp_mae_f,
            avg(v_forecast_accuracy_lead_buckets.mae) FILTER (WHERE v_forecast_accuracy_lead_buckets.param = 'vpd_kpa'::text) AS vpd_mae_kpa,
            avg(v_forecast_accuracy_lead_buckets.mae) FILTER (WHERE v_forecast_accuracy_lead_buckets.param = 'solar_w_m2'::text) AS solar_mae_w
           FROM v_forecast_accuracy_lead_buckets
          GROUP BY v_forecast_accuracy_lead_buckets.date
        ), plan_posture AS (
         SELECT v_plan_tactical_outcome_daily.plan_id,
            jsonb_object_agg(v_plan_tactical_outcome_daily.parameter, v_plan_tactical_outcome_daily.avg_value) AS avg_tunables
           FROM v_plan_tactical_outcome_daily
          GROUP BY v_plan_tactical_outcome_daily.plan_id
        )
 SELECT pd.plan_id,
    pd.date,
    pd.created_at,
    pd.planner_instance,
    pd.trigger_id,
    fd.temp_mae_f,
    fd.vpd_mae_kpa,
    fd.solar_mae_w,
    pp.avg_tunables,
    ds.compliance_pct,
    ds.temp_compliance_pct,
    ds.vpd_compliance_pct,
    ds.stress_hours_heat,
    ds.stress_hours_vpd_high,
    ds.stress_hours_cold,
    ds.stress_hours_vpd_low,
    ds.water_used_gal,
    ds.mister_water_gal,
    COALESCE(ds.kwh_total, ds.kwh_estimated) AS kwh,
    ds.therms_estimated,
    ds.cost_total,
    pd.hypothesis,
    pd.experiment,
    pd.expected_outcome,
    pd.actual_outcome,
    pd.outcome_score,
    pd.validated_at
   FROM plan_days pd
     LEFT JOIN daily_summary ds ON ds.date = pd.date
     LEFT JOIN forecast_day fd ON fd.date = pd.date
     LEFT JOIN plan_posture pp ON pp.plan_id = pd.plan_id;
v_forecast_plan_outcome_mart.name: v_forecast_plan_outcome_mart

v_forecast_planning_priors.definition:
WITH history_candidates AS (
         SELECT f_1.forecast_hour,
            f_1.fetched_at,
            f_1.lead_hours,
            f_1.forecast_temp,
            f_1.forecast_rh,
            f_1.forecast_vpd,
            f_1.forecast_solar,
            f_1.actual_temp,
            f_1.actual_rh,
            f_1.actual_vpd,
            f_1.actual_solar,
            f_1.temp_minutes,
            f_1.rh_minutes,
            f_1.vpd_minutes,
            f_1.solar_minutes,
            f_1.vintage_rows,
            f_1.vintage_conflict,
            f_1.lead_bucket,
            f_1.temp_error_f,
            f_1.rh_error_pct,
            f_1.vpd_error_kpa,
            f_1.solar_error_w,
            f_1.verification_contract_version,
            p.param,
            p.error,
            p.observed_minutes
           FROM v_forecast_outdoor_pairs f_1
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES ('temp_f'::text,f_1.temp_error_f,f_1.temp_minutes), ('vpd_kpa'::text,f_1.vpd_error_kpa,f_1.vpd_minutes), ('solar_w_m2'::text,f_1.solar_error_w,f_1.solar_minutes)) p(param, error, observed_minutes)
          WHERE f_1.forecast_hour > (now() - '7 days'::interval) AND (p.param <> 'solar_w_m2'::text OR f_1.lead_hours >= 1::numeric)
        ), selected_history AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (history_candidates.forecast_hour, history_candidates.lead_bucket, history_candidates.param) history_candidates.forecast_hour,
            history_candidates.fetched_at,
            history_candidates.lead_hours,
            history_candidates.forecast_temp,
            history_candidates.forecast_rh,
            history_candidates.forecast_vpd,
            history_candidates.forecast_solar,
            history_candidates.actual_temp,
            history_candidates.actual_rh,
            history_candidates.actual_vpd,
            history_candidates.actual_solar,
            history_candidates.temp_minutes,
            history_candidates.rh_minutes,
            history_candidates.vpd_minutes,
            history_candidates.solar_minutes,
            history_candidates.vintage_rows,
            history_candidates.vintage_conflict,
            history_candidates.lead_bucket,
            history_candidates.temp_error_f,
            history_candidates.rh_error_pct,
            history_candidates.vpd_error_kpa,
            history_candidates.solar_error_w,
            history_candidates.verification_contract_version,
            history_candidates.param,
            history_candidates.error,
            history_candidates.observed_minutes
           FROM history_candidates
          ORDER BY history_candidates.forecast_hour, history_candidates.lead_bucket, history_candidates.param, history_candidates.fetched_at DESC
        ), calibration AS (
         SELECT selected_history.lead_bucket,
            selected_history.param,
            avg(selected_history.error) AS bias,
            count(selected_history.error) AS paired_hours,
            sum(selected_history.observed_minutes) FILTER (WHERE selected_history.error IS NOT NULL) AS observed_minutes
           FROM selected_history
          GROUP BY selected_history.lead_bucket, selected_history.param
        ), vintages AS (
         SELECT weather_forecast.ts,
            weather_forecast.fetched_at,
            count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(weather_forecast.temp_f, weather_forecast.vpd_kpa, weather_forecast.solar_w_m2)) > 1 AS vintage_conflict,
            min(weather_forecast.temp_f) AS temp_f,
            min(weather_forecast.vpd_kpa) AS vpd_kpa,
            min(weather_forecast.solar_w_m2) AS solar_w_m2
           FROM weather_forecast
          WHERE weather_forecast.ts > now() AND weather_forecast.ts <= (now() + '24:00:00'::interval) AND weather_forecast.fetched_at <= now()
          GROUP BY weather_forecast.ts, weather_forecast.fetched_at
        ), latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (vintages.ts) vintages.ts,
            vintages.fetched_at,
            vintages.vintage_conflict,
            vintages.temp_f,
            vintages.vpd_kpa,
            vintages.solar_w_m2,
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM vintages.ts - vintages.fetched_at) / 3600.0 AS lead_hours,
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - vintages.fetched_at) / 60.0 AS fetch_age_minutes
           FROM vintages
          ORDER BY vintages.ts, vintages.fetched_at DESC
        ), raw AS (
         SELECT f_1.ts,
            f_1.fetched_at,
            f_1.vintage_conflict,
            f_1.temp_f,
            f_1.vpd_kpa,
            f_1.solar_w_m2,
            f_1.lead_hours,
            f_1.fetch_age_minutes,
            p.param,
            p.raw_forecast,
                CASE
                    WHEN f_1.lead_hours < 6::numeric THEN '00-06h'::text
                    WHEN f_1.lead_hours < 24::numeric THEN '06-24h'::text
                    WHEN f_1.lead_hours < 48::numeric THEN '24-48h'::text
                    ELSE '48h+'::text
                END AS lead_bucket
           FROM latest f_1
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES ('temp_f'::text,
                        CASE
                            WHEN f_1.temp_f >= '-100'::integer::double precision AND f_1.temp_f <= 150::double precision THEN f_1.temp_f
                            ELSE NULL::double precision
                        END), ('vpd_kpa'::text,
                        CASE
                            WHEN f_1.vpd_kpa >= 0::double precision AND f_1.vpd_kpa < 'Infinity'::double precision THEN f_1.vpd_kpa
                            ELSE NULL::double precision
                        END), ('solar_w_m2'::text,
                        CASE
                            WHEN f_1.solar_w_m2 >= 0::double precision AND f_1.solar_w_m2 < 'Infinity'::double precision THEN f_1.solar_w_m2
                            ELSE NULL::double precision
                        END)) p(param, raw_forecast)
        )
 SELECT now() AS decision_at,
    f.ts AS valid_at,
    f.fetched_at AS available_at,
    f.lead_hours,
    f.fetch_age_minutes,
    f.lead_bucket,
    f.param,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT f.vintage_conflict THEN f.raw_forecast
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS raw_forecast,
    c.bias,
    COALESCE(c.paired_hours, 0::bigint) AS calibration_paired_hours,
    c.observed_minutes AS calibration_observed_minutes,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT f.vintage_conflict AND f.fetch_age_minutes <= 120::numeric AND f.raw_forecast IS NOT NULL AND c.paired_hours > 0 AND (f.param <> 'solar_w_m2'::text OR f.lead_hours >= 1::numeric) THEN
            CASE
                WHEN f.param = 'temp_f'::text THEN f.raw_forecast - c.bias
                ELSE GREATEST(0::double precision, f.raw_forecast - c.bias)
            END
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS corrected_prior,
        CASE
            WHEN f.vintage_conflict THEN 'conflicting_vintage'::text
            WHEN f.raw_forecast IS NULL THEN 'missing_forecast'::text
            WHEN f.fetch_age_minutes > 120::numeric THEN 'stale_forecast'::text
            WHEN f.param = 'solar_w_m2'::text AND f.lead_hours < 1::numeric THEN 'partial_window_nowcast'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(c.paired_hours, 0::bigint) = 0 THEN 'missing_calibration'::text
            ELSE 'available_diagnostic'::text
        END AS availability,
    2 AS verification_contract_version
   FROM raw f
     LEFT JOIN calibration c USING (lead_bucket, param);
v_forecast_planning_priors.name: v_forecast_planning_priors

v_forecast_verification_contract.definition:
SELECT 2 AS verification_contract_version,
    'fetched_at_recorded_availability_not_provider_issuance'::text AS vintage_basis,
    'outdoor_valid_time_one_minute_bin'::text AS instant_truth_basis,
    'outdoor_preceding_hour_all_60_minute_bins'::text AS solar_truth_basis,
    false AS indoor_response_verified;
v_forecast_verification_contract.name: v_forecast_verification_contract

v_forecast_vs_actual.definition:
SELECT forecast_hour AS hour,
    round(forecast_temp::numeric, 1) AS forecast_temp,
    round(forecast_rh::numeric, 0) AS forecast_rh,
    round(forecast_vpd::numeric, 2) AS forecast_vpd,
    round(forecast_solar::numeric, 0) AS forecast_solar,
    round(actual_temp::numeric, 1) AS actual_temp,
    round(actual_rh::numeric, 0) AS actual_rh,
    round(actual_solar::numeric, 0) AS actual_solar,
    temp_error_f AS temp_error,
    round(solar_error_w, 0) AS solar_error
   FROM v_forecast_accuracy
  WHERE forecast_hour > (now() - '7 days'::interval);
v_forecast_vs_actual.name: v_forecast_vs_actual

v_gdd.definition:
WITH daily_temps AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, climate.ts) AS date,
            avg(climate.temp_avg) AS avg_temp_f
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.temp_avg IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('day'::text, climate.ts))
        )
 SELECT c.id AS crop_id,
    c.name,
    c."position",
    dt.date,
    GREATEST(0::double precision, dt.avg_temp_f - c.base_temp_f) AS gdd_day,
    sum(GREATEST(0::double precision, dt.avg_temp_f - c.base_temp_f)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY dt.date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS gdd_cumulative
   FROM crops c
     JOIN daily_temps dt ON dt.date >= c.planted_date::timestamp with time zone
  WHERE c.is_active = true
  ORDER BY c.id, dt.date;
v_gdd.name: v_gdd

v_gpu_power_latest.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (gpu_power.greenhouse_id, gpu_power.host, gpu_power.gpu) gpu_power.ts,
            gpu_power.host,
            gpu_power.vm_name,
            gpu_power.purpose,
            gpu_power.gpu,
            gpu_power.device,
            gpu_power.model_name,
            gpu_power.watts,
            gpu_power.gpu_util_pct,
            gpu_power.temperature_c,
            gpu_power.memory_used_mb,
            gpu_power.memory_free_mb,
            gpu_power.source,
            gpu_power.raw,
            gpu_power.greenhouse_id
           FROM gpu_power
          ORDER BY gpu_power.greenhouse_id, gpu_power.host, gpu_power.gpu, gpu_power.ts DESC
        )
 SELECT ts,
    host,
    vm_name,
    purpose,
    gpu,
    device,
    model_name,
    watts,
    gpu_util_pct,
    temperature_c,
    memory_used_mb,
    memory_free_mb,
    source,
    raw,
    greenhouse_id,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - ts)::integer AS age_s
   FROM latest;
v_gpu_power_latest.name: v_gpu_power_latest

v_greenhouse_id_default_audit.definition:
SELECT c.table_name,
    c.column_default,
    c.is_nullable,
    c.column_default IS NOT NULL AS has_default,
    c.column_default::text = '''vallery''::text'::text AS uses_single_site_default
   FROM information_schema.columns c
     JOIN information_schema.tables t ON t.table_schema::name = c.table_schema::name AND t.table_name::name = c.table_name::name
  WHERE c.table_schema::name = 'public'::name AND t.table_type::text = 'BASE TABLE'::text AND c.column_name::name = 'greenhouse_id'::name
  ORDER BY c.table_name;
v_greenhouse_id_default_audit.name: v_greenhouse_id_default_audit

v_greenhouse_now.definition:
SELECT c.ts,
    round(c.temp_avg::numeric, 1) AS temp_avg,
    round(c.temp_north::numeric, 1) AS temp_north,
    round(c.temp_south::numeric, 1) AS temp_south,
    round(c.temp_east::numeric, 1) AS temp_east,
    round(c.temp_west::numeric, 1) AS temp_west,
    round(c.rh_avg::numeric, 1) AS rh_avg,
    round(c.vpd_avg::numeric, 2) AS vpd_avg,
    round(c.co2_ppm::numeric, 0) AS co2_ppm,
    round(c.lux::numeric, 0) AS lux,
    round(dc.crop_dli_mol_m2_day::numeric, 2) AS dli_today,
    o.outdoor_temp_f,
    o.outdoor_rh_pct,
    o.wind_mph,
    o.pressure_hpa,
    round(c.mister_water_today::numeric, 1) AS mister_water_today,
    h.hydro_ph,
    h.hydro_ec_us_cm,
    h.hydro_tds_ppm,
    h.hydro_water_temp_f,
    d.wifi_rssi,
    round(d.heap_bytes::numeric, 0) AS heap_kb,
    round(d.uptime_s::numeric, 0) AS uptime_s,
    ( SELECT s.value
           FROM system_state s
          WHERE s.entity = 'greenhouse_state'::text
          ORDER BY s.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS state,
    ( SELECT s.value
           FROM system_state s
          WHERE s.entity = 'lead_fan'::text
          ORDER BY s.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS lead_fan,
    fn_system_health() AS health_score,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM alert_log a
          WHERE a.disposition = 'open'::text) AS open_alerts,
    cost.cost_electric,
    cost.cost_gas,
    cost.cost_water,
    cost.cost_total,
    dc.availability AS dli_availability,
    dc.unavailable_reason AS dli_unavailable_reason,
    dc.provenance AS dli_provenance,
    dc.validity_revision AS dli_validity_revision,
    dc.valid_from AS dli_valid_from,
    dc.valid_to AS dli_valid_to
   FROM climate c
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d0.wifi_rssi,
            d0.heap_bytes,
            d0.uptime_s
           FROM diagnostics d0
          ORDER BY d0.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) d ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT round(c0.outdoor_temp_f::numeric, 1) AS outdoor_temp_f,
            round(c0.outdoor_rh_pct::numeric, 0) AS outdoor_rh_pct,
            round(c0.wind_speed_mph::numeric, 1) AS wind_mph,
            round(c0.pressure_hpa::numeric, 1) AS pressure_hpa
           FROM climate c0
          WHERE c0.outdoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL AND c0.ts > (now() - '00:30:00'::interval)
          ORDER BY c0.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) o ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT round(c1.hydro_ph::numeric, 1) AS hydro_ph,
            round(c1.hydro_ec_us_cm::numeric, 0) AS hydro_ec_us_cm,
            round(c1.hydro_tds_ppm::numeric, 0) AS hydro_tds_ppm,
            round(c1.hydro_water_temp_f::numeric, 1) AS hydro_water_temp_f
           FROM climate c1
          WHERE c1.hydro_ph IS NOT NULL AND c1.ts > (now() - '00:30:00'::interval)
          ORDER BY c1.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) h ON true
     CROSS JOIN v_cost_today cost
     LEFT JOIN v_dli_current dc ON dc.greenhouse_id = COALESCE(c.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)
  WHERE c.temp_avg IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY c.ts DESC
 LIMIT 1;
v_greenhouse_now.name: v_greenhouse_now

v_greenhouse_state.definition:
WITH state_base AS (
         SELECT c.ts,
            c.temp_avg,
            c.vpd_avg,
            c.rh_avg,
            c.dew_point,
            c.temp_north,
            c.temp_south,
            c.temp_east,
            c.temp_west,
            c.vpd_south,
            c.vpd_west,
            c.vpd_east,
            c.lux,
            c.solar_irradiance_w_m2,
            c.dli_today,
            c.co2_ppm,
            c.abs_humidity,
            c.enthalpy_delta,
            c.outdoor_temp_f,
            c.outdoor_rh_pct,
            round((c.temp_avg - COALESCE(c.dew_point, c.temp_avg - 10::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS dp_margin_f,
            fn_equip_at('fan1'::text, c.ts) AS fan1,
            fn_equip_at('fan2'::text, c.ts) AS fan2,
            fn_equip_at('vent'::text, c.ts) AS vent,
            fn_equip_at('fog'::text, c.ts) AS fog,
            fn_equip_at('heat1'::text, c.ts) AS heat1,
            fn_equip_at('heat2'::text, c.ts) AS heat2,
            fn_equip_at('mister_south'::text, c.ts) AS mist_south,
            fn_equip_at('mister_west'::text, c.ts) AS mist_west,
            fn_equip_at('mister_center'::text, c.ts) AS mist_center,
            fn_setpoint_at('temp_high'::text, c.ts) AS sp_temp_high,
            fn_setpoint_at('temp_low'::text, c.ts) AS sp_temp_low,
            fn_setpoint_at('vpd_high'::text, c.ts) AS sp_vpd_high,
            fn_setpoint_at('vpd_low'::text, c.ts) AS sp_vpd_low,
            fn_setpoint_at('bias_cool'::text, c.ts) AS sp_bias_cool,
            fn_setpoint_at('bias_heat'::text, c.ts) AS sp_bias_heat,
            fn_setpoint_at('vpd_hysteresis'::text, c.ts) AS sp_vpd_hysteresis,
            fn_setpoint_at('mist_max_closed_vent_s'::text, c.ts) AS sp_sealed_max_s,
            fn_setpoint_at('mist_thermal_relief_s'::text, c.ts) AS sp_relief_s,
            fn_setpoint_at('vpd_watch_dwell_s'::text, c.ts) AS sp_watch_dwell_s,
            fn_setpoint_at('d_cool_stage_2'::text, c.ts) AS sp_d_cool_s2,
            fn_setpoint_at('mister_engage_kpa'::text, c.ts) AS sp_mister_engage,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.temp_avg >= COALESCE(fn_setpoint_at('temp_low'::text, c.ts), 58::double precision) AND c.temp_avg <= COALESCE(fn_setpoint_at('temp_high'::text, c.ts), 82::double precision) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS temp_in_band,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.vpd_avg >= COALESCE(fn_setpoint_at('vpd_low'::text, c.ts), 0.5::double precision) AND c.vpd_avg <= COALESCE(fn_setpoint_at('vpd_high'::text, c.ts), 1.5::double precision) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS vpd_in_band,
            ( SELECT system_state.value
                   FROM system_state
                  WHERE system_state.entity = 'greenhouse_state'::text AND system_state.ts <= c.ts
                  ORDER BY system_state.ts DESC
                 LIMIT 1) AS greenhouse_mode
           FROM climate c
          WHERE c.temp_avg IS NOT NULL AND c.ts >= (now() - '14 days'::interval)
        )
 SELECT ts,
    temp_avg,
    vpd_avg,
    rh_avg,
    dew_point,
    temp_north,
    temp_south,
    temp_east,
    temp_west,
    vpd_south,
    vpd_west,
    vpd_east,
    lux,
    solar_irradiance_w_m2,
    dli_today,
    co2_ppm,
    abs_humidity,
    enthalpy_delta,
    outdoor_temp_f,
    outdoor_rh_pct,
    dp_margin_f,
    fan1,
    fan2,
    vent,
    fog,
    heat1,
    heat2,
    mist_south,
    mist_west,
    mist_center,
    sp_temp_high,
    sp_temp_low,
    sp_vpd_high,
    sp_vpd_low,
    sp_bias_cool,
    sp_bias_heat,
    sp_vpd_hysteresis,
    sp_sealed_max_s,
    sp_relief_s,
    sp_watch_dwell_s,
    sp_d_cool_s2,
    sp_mister_engage,
    temp_in_band,
    vpd_in_band,
    greenhouse_mode,
    round(((sp_temp_low + sp_temp_high) / 2.0::double precision)::numeric, 2) AS sp_temp_target,
    round(((sp_vpd_low + sp_vpd_high) / 2.0::double precision)::numeric, 3) AS sp_vpd_target,
    round((temp_avg - (sp_temp_low + sp_temp_high) / 2.0::double precision)::numeric, 2) AS temp_target_delta_f,
    round((vpd_avg - (sp_vpd_low + sp_vpd_high) / 2.0::double precision)::numeric, 3) AS vpd_target_delta_kpa,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN temp_avg < sp_temp_low THEN temp_avg - sp_temp_low
            WHEN temp_avg > sp_temp_high THEN temp_avg - sp_temp_high
            ELSE 0.0::double precision
        END::numeric, 2) AS temp_band_error_f,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN vpd_avg < sp_vpd_low THEN vpd_avg - sp_vpd_low
            WHEN vpd_avg > sp_vpd_high THEN vpd_avg - sp_vpd_high
            ELSE 0.0::double precision
        END::numeric, 3) AS vpd_band_error_kpa
   FROM state_base;
v_greenhouse_state.name: v_greenhouse_state

v_grower_economics_story.definition:
WITH harvest_daily AS (
         SELECT (harvests.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS date,
            sum(COALESCE(harvests.salable_weight_kg, harvests.weight_kg, 0::double precision)) AS salable_kg,
            sum(COALESCE(harvests.cull_weight_kg, 0::double precision)) AS cull_kg,
            sum(COALESCE(harvests.revenue, harvests.unit_price * harvests.unit_count::double precision, 0::double precision)) AS revenue
           FROM harvests
          GROUP BY ((harvests.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date)
        )
 SELECT ds.date,
    hd.salable_kg,
    hd.cull_kg,
    hd.revenue,
    NULL::double precision AS dli_final,
    ds.water_used_gal,
    COALESCE(ds.kwh_total, ds.kwh_estimated) AS kwh,
    ds.therms_estimated,
    ds.cost_total,
    ds.stress_hours_heat + ds.stress_hours_vpd_high + ds.stress_hours_cold + ds.stress_hours_vpd_low AS stress_hours,
    NULL::double precision AS kg_per_mol_dli,
        CASE
            WHEN ds.water_used_gal > 0::double precision THEN hd.salable_kg / ds.water_used_gal
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS kg_per_gal,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(ds.kwh_total, ds.kwh_estimated) > 0::double precision THEN hd.salable_kg / COALESCE(ds.kwh_total, ds.kwh_estimated)
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS kg_per_kwh,
        CASE
            WHEN ds.cost_total > 0::double precision THEN hd.revenue / ds.cost_total
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS revenue_per_cost_dollar
   FROM daily_summary ds
     LEFT JOIN harvest_daily hd USING (date)
  WHERE ds.date IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ds.date DESC;
v_grower_economics_story.name: v_grower_economics_story

v_growth_observation_quality.definition:
SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS date,
    crop_id,
    count(*) AS observations,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE health_score IS NOT NULL) AS health_scores,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE plant_height_cm IS NOT NULL OR leaf_count IS NOT NULL OR canopy_cover_pct IS NOT NULL OR flowering_count IS NOT NULL OR fruit_count IS NOT NULL OR root_condition IS NOT NULL OR mortality_count IS NOT NULL OR stress_tags IS NOT NULL) AS structured_growth_observations,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity IS NOT NULL OR affected_pct IS NOT NULL) AS structured_stress_observations,
    avg(health_score) AS avg_health_score
   FROM observations
  GROUP BY ((ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date), crop_id
  ORDER BY ((ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date) DESC, crop_id;
v_growth_observation_quality.name: v_growth_observation_quality

v_harvest_story.definition:
SELECT h.id,
    h.ts,
    (h.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS date,
    h.greenhouse_id,
    h.crop_id,
    c.name AS crop_name,
    h.position_id,
    h.zone,
    COALESCE(h.salable_weight_kg, h.weight_kg) AS salable_weight_kg,
    h.cull_weight_kg,
    h.unit_count,
    h.quality_grade,
    h.quality_reason,
    h.destination,
    h.unit_price,
    COALESCE(h.revenue, h.unit_price * h.unit_count::double precision) AS revenue,
    NULL::double precision AS dli_final,
    ds.water_used_gal,
    ds.kwh_total,
    NULL::double precision AS kg_per_mol_dli,
        CASE
            WHEN ds.water_used_gal > 0::double precision THEN COALESCE(h.salable_weight_kg, h.weight_kg) / ds.water_used_gal
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS kg_per_gal,
        CASE
            WHEN ds.kwh_total > 0::double precision THEN COALESCE(h.salable_weight_kg, h.weight_kg) / ds.kwh_total
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS kg_per_kwh
   FROM harvests h
     LEFT JOIN crops c ON c.id = h.crop_id
     LEFT JOIN daily_summary ds ON ds.date = (h.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date;
v_harvest_story.name: v_harvest_story

v_heat_in_band_7d.definition:
WITH samples AS (
         SELECT bt.ts,
            bt.greenhouse_id,
            bt.timeline_phase,
            bt.crop_temp_low,
            bt.crop_temp_high,
            bt.crop_vpd_low,
            bt.crop_vpd_high,
            bt.projected_temp_low,
            bt.projected_temp_high,
            bt.projected_vpd_low,
            bt.projected_vpd_high,
            bt.actual_temp_low,
            bt.actual_temp_high,
            bt.actual_vpd_low,
            bt.actual_vpd_high,
            bt.firmware_temp_low,
            bt.firmware_temp_high,
            bt.firmware_vpd_low,
            bt.firmware_vpd_high,
            bt.temp_width_f,
            bt.vpd_width_kpa,
            bt.sw_fsm_controller_enabled,
            bt.indoor_temp_f,
            bt.indoor_vpd_kpa,
            bt.outdoor_temp_f,
            bt.outdoor_vpd_kpa,
            bt.solar_w_m2,
            bt.outdoor_cold_for_vent,
            bt.temp_hysteresis_f,
            bt.heat_hysteresis_f,
            bt.d_heat_stage_2_f,
            bt.d_cool_stage_2_f,
            bt.bias_heat_f,
            bt.bias_cool_f,
            bt.vpd_hysteresis_kpa,
            bt.vpd_hysteresis_effective_kpa,
            bt.fog_escalation_kpa,
            bt.temp_heat_target_f,
            bt.temp_heat_on_below_f,
            bt.temp_heat2_on_below_f,
            bt.temp_heat2_clear_f,
            bt.temp_cool_on_above_f,
            bt.temp_cool_hold_until_f,
            bt.temp_cooling_entry_margin_f,
            bt.temp_cooling_exit_hysteresis_f,
            bt.solar_cooling_lead_f,
            bt.temp_cool_stage2_delta_f,
            bt.temp_cool_stage2_on_above_f,
            bt.vpd_humidify_on_above_kpa,
            bt.vpd_humidify_resolved_below_kpa,
            bt.vpd_dehum_on_below_kpa,
            bt.vpd_dehum_resolved_above_kpa,
            bt.vpd_low_eff_kpa,
            bt.vpd_high_eff_kpa,
            bt.vpd_vent_fog_on_above_kpa,
            bt.vpd_sealed_fog_on_above_kpa,
            lead(bt.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY bt.greenhouse_id ORDER BY bt.ts) AS next_ts,
            fn_equip_at('heat1'::text, bt.ts) AS heat1_on,
            fn_equip_at('heat2'::text, bt.ts) AS heat2_on
           FROM fn_band_timeline(now() - '7 days'::interval, now(), '00:05:00'::interval, 'vallery'::text) bt(ts, greenhouse_id, timeline_phase, crop_temp_low, crop_temp_high, crop_vpd_low, crop_vpd_high, projected_temp_low, projected_temp_high, projected_vpd_low, projected_vpd_high, actual_temp_low, actual_temp_high, actual_vpd_low, actual_vpd_high, firmware_temp_low, firmware_temp_high, firmware_vpd_low, firmware_vpd_high, temp_width_f, vpd_width_kpa, sw_fsm_controller_enabled, indoor_temp_f, indoor_vpd_kpa, outdoor_temp_f, outdoor_vpd_kpa, solar_w_m2, outdoor_cold_for_vent, temp_hysteresis_f, heat_hysteresis_f, d_heat_stage_2_f, d_cool_stage_2_f, bias_heat_f, bias_cool_f, vpd_hysteresis_kpa, vpd_hysteresis_effective_kpa, fog_escalation_kpa, temp_heat_target_f, temp_heat_on_below_f, temp_heat2_on_below_f, temp_heat2_clear_f, temp_cool_on_above_f, temp_cool_hold_until_f, temp_cooling_entry_margin_f, temp_cooling_exit_hysteresis_f, solar_cooling_lead_f, temp_cool_stage2_delta_f, temp_cool_stage2_on_above_f, vpd_humidify_on_above_kpa, vpd_humidify_resolved_below_kpa, vpd_dehum_on_below_kpa, vpd_dehum_resolved_above_kpa, vpd_low_eff_kpa, vpd_high_eff_kpa, vpd_vent_fog_on_above_kpa, vpd_sealed_fog_on_above_kpa)
          WHERE bt.timeline_phase = 'actual'::text
        ), classified AS (
         SELECT s.ts,
            s.greenhouse_id,
            s.timeline_phase,
            s.crop_temp_low,
            s.crop_temp_high,
            s.crop_vpd_low,
            s.crop_vpd_high,
            s.projected_temp_low,
            s.projected_temp_high,
            s.projected_vpd_low,
            s.projected_vpd_high,
            s.actual_temp_low,
            s.actual_temp_high,
            s.actual_vpd_low,
            s.actual_vpd_high,
            s.firmware_temp_low,
            s.firmware_temp_high,
            s.firmware_vpd_low,
            s.firmware_vpd_high,
            s.temp_width_f,
            s.vpd_width_kpa,
            s.sw_fsm_controller_enabled,
            s.indoor_temp_f,
            s.indoor_vpd_kpa,
            s.outdoor_temp_f,
            s.outdoor_vpd_kpa,
            s.solar_w_m2,
            s.outdoor_cold_for_vent,
            s.temp_hysteresis_f,
            s.heat_hysteresis_f,
            s.d_heat_stage_2_f,
            s.d_cool_stage_2_f,
            s.bias_heat_f,
            s.bias_cool_f,
            s.vpd_hysteresis_kpa,
            s.vpd_hysteresis_effective_kpa,
            s.fog_escalation_kpa,
            s.temp_heat_target_f,
            s.temp_heat_on_below_f,
            s.temp_heat2_on_below_f,
            s.temp_heat2_clear_f,
            s.temp_cool_on_above_f,
            s.temp_cool_hold_until_f,
            s.temp_cooling_entry_margin_f,
            s.temp_cooling_exit_hysteresis_f,
            s.solar_cooling_lead_f,
            s.temp_cool_stage2_delta_f,
            s.temp_cool_stage2_on_above_f,
            s.vpd_humidify_on_above_kpa,
            s.vpd_humidify_resolved_below_kpa,
            s.vpd_dehum_on_below_kpa,
            s.vpd_dehum_resolved_above_kpa,
            s.vpd_low_eff_kpa,
            s.vpd_high_eff_kpa,
            s.vpd_vent_fog_on_above_kpa,
            s.vpd_sealed_fog_on_above_kpa,
            s.next_ts,
            s.heat1_on,
            s.heat2_on,
            GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(s.next_ts, now()) - s.ts), 300.0)) / 60.0 AS sample_minutes,
            s.indoor_temp_f >= s.firmware_temp_low AND s.indoor_temp_f <= s.firmware_temp_high AS temp_in_band,
            s.indoor_temp_f < s.firmware_temp_low AS temp_below_band,
            s.indoor_temp_f > s.firmware_temp_high AS temp_above_band
           FROM samples s
          WHERE s.indoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL AND s.firmware_temp_low IS NOT NULL AND s.firmware_temp_high IS NOT NULL
        )
 SELECT greenhouse_id,
    min(ts) AS window_start,
    max(ts) AS window_end,
    count(*) AS samples,
    round(sum(sample_minutes) FILTER (WHERE heat1_on), 1) AS heat1_minutes,
    round(sum(sample_minutes) FILTER (WHERE heat2_on), 1) AS heat2_minutes,
    round(sum(sample_minutes) FILTER (WHERE heat1_on AND temp_in_band), 1) AS heat1_in_band_minutes,
    round(sum(sample_minutes) FILTER (WHERE heat2_on AND temp_in_band), 1) AS heat2_in_band_minutes,
    round(sum(sample_minutes) FILTER (WHERE heat1_on AND temp_below_band), 1) AS heat1_below_band_minutes,
    round(sum(sample_minutes) FILTER (WHERE heat2_on AND temp_below_band), 1) AS heat2_below_band_minutes,
    round(sum(sample_minutes) FILTER (WHERE (heat1_on OR heat2_on) AND temp_above_band), 1) AS heat_above_band_minutes,
    round(100.0 * sum(sample_minutes) FILTER (WHERE (heat1_on OR heat2_on) AND temp_in_band) / NULLIF(sum(sample_minutes) FILTER (WHERE heat1_on OR heat2_on), 0::numeric), 1) AS heat_runtime_in_band_pct
   FROM classified
  GROUP BY greenhouse_id;
v_heat_in_band_7d.name: v_heat_in_band_7d

v_heating_staging.definition:
WITH heat_events AS (
         SELECT equipment_state.ts,
            equipment_state.equipment,
            equipment_state.state,
            lead(equipment_state.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_state.equipment ORDER BY equipment_state.ts) AS next_ts
           FROM equipment_state
          WHERE equipment_state.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['heat1'::text, 'heat2'::text])
        ), heat2_on AS (
         SELECT heat_events.ts AS on_ts,
            COALESCE(heat_events.next_ts, now()) AS off_ts
           FROM heat_events
          WHERE heat_events.equipment = 'heat2'::text AND heat_events.state = true
        )
 SELECT (on_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS heat2_on_mdt,
    (off_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS heat2_off_mdt,
    round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM off_ts - on_ts) / 60::numeric, 1) AS duration_min,
    ( SELECT equipment_state.state
           FROM equipment_state
          WHERE equipment_state.equipment = 'heat1'::text AND equipment_state.ts <= h2.on_ts
          ORDER BY equipment_state.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS heat1_was_on,
    ( SELECT round(climate.temp_avg::numeric, 1) AS round
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.ts <= h2.on_ts AND climate.temp_avg IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY climate.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS temp_at_engage,
    fn_setpoint_at('temp_low'::text, on_ts) AS setpoint_temp_low
   FROM heat2_on h2
  ORDER BY on_ts DESC;
v_heating_staging.name: v_heating_staging

v_heating_staging_summary.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, heat2_on_mdt)::date AS date,
    count(*) AS heat2_events,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE(heat1_was_on, false)) AS inversions,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE(heat1_was_on, false))::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 1) AS inversion_pct,
    round(avg(temp_at_engage), 1) AS avg_engage_temp,
    round(sum(duration_min), 1) AS total_heat2_min
   FROM v_heating_staging
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('day'::text, heat2_on_mdt)::date)
  ORDER BY (date_trunc('day'::text, heat2_on_mdt)::date) DESC;
v_heating_staging_summary.name: v_heating_staging_summary

v_hydro_status.definition:
SELECT ts,
    round(hydro_ph::numeric, 1) AS ph,
    round(hydro_ec_us_cm::numeric, 0) AS ec_us_cm,
    round(hydro_tds_ppm::numeric, 0) AS tds_ppm,
    round(hydro_orp_mv::numeric, 0) AS orp_mv,
    round(hydro_water_temp_f::numeric, 1) AS water_temp_f,
    round(hydro_battery_pct::numeric, 0) AS battery_pct,
    hydro_ph >= 5.5::double precision AND hydro_ph <= 6.5::double precision AS ph_in_range,
    hydro_ec_us_cm >= 800::double precision AND hydro_ec_us_cm <= 2000::double precision AS ec_in_range,
    hydro_water_temp_f >= 60::double precision AND hydro_water_temp_f <= 75::double precision AS temp_in_range,
    hydro_battery_pct > 20::double precision AS battery_ok
   FROM climate c
  WHERE hydro_ph IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ts DESC
 LIMIT 1;
v_hydro_status.name: v_hydro_status

v_indoor_outdoor_correlation.definition:
SELECT time_bucket('01:00:00'::interval, ts) AS hour,
    round(avg(temp_avg)::numeric, 1) AS indoor_temp,
    round(avg(outdoor_temp_f)::numeric, 1) AS outdoor_temp,
    round((avg(temp_avg) - avg(outdoor_temp_f))::numeric, 1) AS thermal_gain,
    round(avg(solar_irradiance_w_m2)::numeric, 0) AS solar_w_m2,
    round(avg(vpd_avg)::numeric, 2) AS indoor_vpd,
    round(avg(outdoor_rh_pct)::numeric, 0) AS outdoor_rh,
    round(avg(wind_speed_mph)::numeric, 1) AS wind_mph,
        CASE
            WHEN avg(solar_irradiance_w_m2) > 50::double precision THEN round(((avg(temp_avg) - avg(outdoor_temp_f)) / NULLIF(avg(solar_irradiance_w_m2), 0::double precision) * 100::double precision)::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS gain_per_100w,
    count(*) AS samples
   FROM climate
  WHERE temp_avg IS NOT NULL AND outdoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY (time_bucket('01:00:00'::interval, ts))
  ORDER BY (time_bucket('01:00:00'::interval, ts)) DESC;
v_indoor_outdoor_correlation.name: v_indoor_outdoor_correlation

v_infra_cpu_latest.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (infra_cpu.greenhouse_id, infra_cpu.host) infra_cpu.ts,
            infra_cpu.host,
            infra_cpu.vm_name,
            infra_cpu.purpose,
            infra_cpu.cpu_util_pct,
            infra_cpu.load1,
            infra_cpu.cores,
            infra_cpu.memory_used_pct,
            infra_cpu.source,
            infra_cpu.raw,
            infra_cpu.greenhouse_id
           FROM infra_cpu
          ORDER BY infra_cpu.greenhouse_id, infra_cpu.host, infra_cpu.ts DESC
        )
 SELECT ts,
    host,
    vm_name,
    purpose,
    cpu_util_pct,
    load1,
    cores,
    memory_used_pct,
    source,
    raw,
    greenhouse_id,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - ts)::integer AS age_s
   FROM latest;
v_infra_cpu_latest.name: v_infra_cpu_latest

v_instrumentation_readiness.definition:
SELECT requirement_id,
    category,
    metric,
    current_status,
    blocks_story,
    recommended_source,
    priority,
        CASE
            WHEN current_status = ANY (ARRAY['installed'::text, 'complete'::text]) THEN 'ok'::text
            WHEN current_status = 'partial'::text THEN 'warn'::text
            ELSE 'blocked'::text
        END AS readiness_status
   FROM instrumentation_requirements
  ORDER BY priority, category, requirement_id;
v_instrumentation_readiness.name: v_instrumentation_readiness

v_iris_experiment_context.definition:
SELECT experiment_id,
    greenhouse_id,
    kind AS experiment_kind,
    status AS experiment_status,
    ( SELECT json_build_object('ts', c.ts, 'temp_avg', round(c.temp_avg::numeric, 1), 'rh_avg', round(c.rh_avg::numeric, 1), 'vpd_avg', round(c.vpd_avg::numeric, 2), 'temp_south', round(c.temp_south::numeric, 1), 'temp_north', round(c.temp_north::numeric, 1), 'temp_east', round(c.temp_east::numeric, 1), 'temp_west', round(c.temp_west::numeric, 1), 'vpd_south', round(c.vpd_south::numeric, 2), 'vpd_north', round(c.vpd_north::numeric, 2), 'vpd_east', round(c.vpd_east::numeric, 2), 'vpd_west', round(c.vpd_west::numeric, 2), 'rh_south', round(c.rh_south::numeric, 1), 'rh_north', round(c.rh_north::numeric, 1), 'rh_east', round(c.rh_east::numeric, 1), 'rh_west', round(c.rh_west::numeric, 1), 'outdoor_temp_f', round(c.outdoor_temp_f::numeric, 1), 'outdoor_rh_pct', round(c.outdoor_rh_pct::numeric, 1), 'outdoor_lux', c.outdoor_lux, 'solar_irradiance_w_m2', round(c.solar_irradiance_w_m2::numeric, 0), 'dew_point', round(c.dew_point::numeric, 1), 'abs_humidity', round(c.abs_humidity::numeric, 1), 'enthalpy_delta', round(c.enthalpy_delta::numeric, 2), 'co2_ppm', round(c.co2_ppm::numeric, 0)) AS json_build_object
           FROM climate c
          ORDER BY c.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS current_sensors,
    ( SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('ts', fc.ts, 'temp_f', round(fc.temp_f::numeric, 1), 'rh_pct', round(fc.rh_pct::numeric, 0), 'vpd_kpa', round(fc.vpd_kpa::numeric, 2), 'cloud_cover_pct', round(fc.cloud_cover_pct::numeric, 0), 'wind_speed_mph', round(fc.wind_speed_mph::numeric, 0), 'solar_w_m2', round(GREATEST(COALESCE(fc.direct_radiation_w_m2, 0::double precision), 0::double precision)::numeric, 0), 'precip_prob_pct', round(COALESCE(fc.precip_prob_pct, 0::double precision)::numeric, 0), 'fetched_at', fc.fetched_at) ORDER BY fc.ts) AS json_agg
           FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (wf.ts) wf.ts,
                    wf.fetched_at,
                    wf.temp_f,
                    wf.rh_pct,
                    wf.wind_speed_mph,
                    wf.wind_dir_deg,
                    wf.cloud_cover_pct,
                    wf.precip_prob_pct,
                    wf.solar_w_m2,
                    wf.dew_point_f,
                    wf.feels_like_f,
                    wf.vpd_kpa,
                    wf.precip_in,
                    wf.rain_in,
                    wf.snow_in,
                    wf.wind_gust_mph,
                    wf.uv_index,
                    wf.et0_mm,
                    wf.direct_radiation_w_m2,
                    wf.diffuse_radiation_w_m2,
                    wf.sunshine_duration_s,
                    wf.weather_code,
                    wf.cloud_cover_low_pct,
                    wf.cloud_cover_high_pct,
                    wf.surface_pressure_hpa,
                    wf.soil_temp_f,
                    wf.visibility_m,
                    wf.greenhouse_id
                   FROM weather_forecast wf
                  WHERE wf.ts > now() AND wf.ts <= (now() + '24:00:00'::interval)
                  ORDER BY wf.ts, wf.fetched_at DESC) fc) AS asof_forecast,
    ( SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name', cr.name, 'variety', cr.variety, 'position', cr."position", 'zone', cr.zone, 'stage', cr.stage, 'planted_date', cr.planted_date) ORDER BY cr.zone, cr."position") AS json_agg
           FROM crops cr
          WHERE cr.is_active) AS crop_topology,
    ( SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('template_id', t.template_id, 'kind', t.kind, 'locked', t.locked_at IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY t.kind) AS json_agg
           FROM policy_templates t
          WHERE t.experiment_id = e.experiment_id AND (t.kind = ANY (ARRAY['moderate'::text, 'aggressive'::text])) AND t.locked_at IS NOT NULL) AS candidate_templates,
    COALESCE(( SELECT json_build_object('template_id', s.virtual_selected_template_id, 'selected_at', s.created_at, 'trigger_ref', s.trigger_ref, 'context_revision', s.context_revision, 'source', 'context_snapshot') AS json_build_object
           FROM experiment_context_snapshots s
          WHERE s.experiment_id = e.experiment_id AND s.virtual_selected_template_id IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1), ( SELECT json_build_object('template_id', p.proposed_template_id, 'selected_at', p.created_at, 'trigger_ref', p.trigger_ref, 'source', 'policy_proposal') AS json_build_object
           FROM policy_proposals p
          WHERE p.experiment_id = e.experiment_id AND p.producer = 'ai'::text AND p.proposed_template_id IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1)) AS virtual_prior
   FROM control_experiments e
  WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['armed'::text, 'running'::text]);
v_iris_experiment_context.name: v_iris_experiment_context

v_iris_planning_context.definition:
SELECT now() AS query_ts,
    ( SELECT json_build_object('temp_avg', round(avg(c.temp_avg)::numeric, 1), 'vpd_avg', round(avg(c.vpd_avg)::numeric, 2), 'rh_avg', round(avg(c.rh_avg)::numeric, 1), 'outdoor_temp_f', round(avg(c.outdoor_temp_f)::numeric, 1), 'dli', ( SELECT json_build_object('value_mol_m2_day', dc.crop_dli_mol_m2_day, 'availability', dc.availability, 'unavailable_reason', dc.unavailable_reason, 'provenance', dc.provenance, 'validity_revision', dc.validity_revision, 'valid_from', dc.valid_from, 'valid_to', dc.valid_to) AS json_build_object
                   FROM v_dli_current dc
                  WHERE dc.greenhouse_id = 'vallery'::text
                 LIMIT 1), 'co2_ppm', round(avg(c.co2_ppm)::numeric, 0)) AS json_build_object
           FROM climate c
          WHERE c.ts >= (now() - '01:00:00'::interval) AND c.temp_avg IS NOT NULL) AS current_conditions,
    ( SELECT json_build_object('north', round(avg(c.temp_north)::numeric, 1), 'south', round(avg(c.temp_south)::numeric, 1), 'east', round(avg(c.temp_east)::numeric, 1), 'west', round(avg(c.temp_west)::numeric, 1)) AS json_build_object
           FROM climate c
          WHERE c.ts >= (now() - '01:00:00'::interval) AND c.temp_avg IS NOT NULL) AS zone_context,
    ( SELECT json_build_object('date', ds.date, 'cost_total', ds.cost_total, 'dli', json_build_object('value_mol_m2_day', d.crop_dli_mol_m2_day, 'availability', d.availability, 'unavailable_reason', d.unavailable_reason, 'provenance', d.provenance, 'validity_revision', d.validity_revision, 'valid_from', d.valid_from, 'valid_to', d.valid_to), 'stress_hours_vpd_high', ds.stress_hours_vpd_high, 'water_used_gal', ds.water_used_gal) AS json_build_object
           FROM daily_summary ds
             LEFT JOIN v_dli_daily d ON d.date = ds.date AND d.greenhouse_id = COALESCE(ds.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)
          ORDER BY ds.date DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS yesterday_summary,
    json_build_object('value_mol_m2_day', NULL::unknown, 'availability', 'unavailable', 'unavailable_reason', 'no_valid_interior_light_sensor', 'provenance', 'outdoor_forecast_is_not_interior_crop_dli', 'validity_revision', 'dli-validity-v1', 'valid_from', '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z', 'valid_to', NULL::unknown) AS dli_forecast,
    ( SELECT json_object_agg(sub.parameter, sub.value) AS json_object_agg
           FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.parameter) s.parameter,
                    s.value
                   FROM setpoint_changes s
                  ORDER BY s.parameter, s.ts DESC) sub) AS current_setpoints,
    ( SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(sub.*) ORDER BY sub.ts) AS json_agg
           FROM ( SELECT p.ts,
                    p.parameter,
                    p.value,
                    p.reason
                   FROM setpoint_plan p
                  WHERE p.ts > now() AND p.is_active AND p.parameter <> 'plan_metadata'::text
                  ORDER BY p.ts) sub) AS active_plan,
    ( SELECT json_build_object('composite_score', fn_system_health(), 'components', ( SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('component', h.component, 'score', h.score_pct)) AS json_agg
                   FROM v_system_health_score h)) AS json_build_object) AS system_health,
    json_build_object('electric_per_kwh', 0.111, 'gas_per_therm', 0.83, 'water_per_gal', 0.00484) AS cost_rates;
v_iris_planning_context.name: v_iris_planning_context

v_irrigation_accountability.definition:
SELECT day AS date,
    zone_path AS zone,
    count(*) AS events,
    round(sum(total_duration_min)::numeric, 1) AS runtime_min,
    round(sum(COALESCE(meter_delta_gal, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS volume_gal,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE meter_delta_gal IS NULL) AS missing_volume_events,
    0::bigint AS weather_skip_events,
    count(*) AS fertigation_events,
    max(run_start) AS latest_event
   FROM v_irrigation_fertigation_runs
  GROUP BY day, zone_path
  ORDER BY day DESC, zone_path;
v_irrigation_accountability.name: v_irrigation_accountability

v_irrigation_fertigation_runs.definition:
WITH raw AS (
         SELECT e.equipment,
            e.ts,
            e.state,
            lag(e.state) OVER (PARTITION BY e.equipment ORDER BY e.ts) AS prev_state
           FROM equipment_state e
          WHERE e.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['drip_wall_fert'::text, 'drip_wall'::text, 'mister_south_fert'::text, 'mister_south'::text, 'mister_west_fert'::text, 'mister_west'::text, 'drip_center_fert'::text, 'drip_center'::text, 'fert_master_valve'::text, 'water_flowing'::text])
        ), changes AS (
         SELECT raw.equipment,
            raw.ts,
            raw.state
           FROM raw
          WHERE raw.prev_state IS NULL OR raw.prev_state IS DISTINCT FROM raw.state
        ), intervals AS (
         SELECT changes.equipment,
            changes.ts AS start_ts,
            lead(changes.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY changes.equipment ORDER BY changes.ts) AS end_ts,
            changes.state
           FROM changes
        ), on_intervals AS (
         SELECT intervals.equipment,
            intervals.start_ts,
            intervals.end_ts
           FROM intervals
          WHERE intervals.state IS TRUE AND intervals.end_ts IS NOT NULL AND intervals.end_ts > intervals.start_ts
        ), fert_map(fert_relay, flush_relay, zone_path, serves_zones, schedule_id, expected_fert_min, expected_flush_min) AS (
         VALUES ('drip_wall_fert'::text,'drip_wall'::text,'wall_shared'::text,ARRAY['south'::text, 'west'::text],'wall_shared'::text,6,2), ('mister_south_fert'::text,'mister_south'::text,'south_wall_mister'::text,ARRAY['south'::text],'wall_shared'::text,6,2), ('mister_west_fert'::text,'mister_west'::text,'west_wall_mister'::text,ARRAY['west'::text],'wall_shared'::text,6,2), ('drip_center_fert'::text,'drip_center'::text,'center'::text,ARRAY['center'::text],'center'::text,6,2)
        ), fert_jobs AS (
         SELECT f.fert_relay,
            f.flush_relay,
            f.zone_path,
            f.serves_zones,
            f.schedule_id,
            COALESCE(s.fert_duration_min, f.expected_fert_min) AS expected_fert_min,
            COALESCE(s.flush_min, f.expected_flush_min) AS expected_flush_min,
            oi.start_ts AS fert_start,
            oi.end_ts AS fert_end
           FROM on_intervals oi
             JOIN fert_map f ON f.fert_relay = oi.equipment
             LEFT JOIN v_irrigation_schedule_current s ON s.schedule_id = f.schedule_id
        ), paired AS (
         SELECT fj.fert_relay,
            fj.flush_relay,
            fj.zone_path,
            fj.serves_zones,
            fj.schedule_id,
            fj.expected_fert_min,
            fj.expected_flush_min,
            fj.fert_start,
            fj.fert_end,
            fl.start_ts AS flush_start,
            fl.end_ts AS flush_end
           FROM fert_jobs fj
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT oi.start_ts,
                    oi.end_ts
                   FROM on_intervals oi
                  WHERE oi.equipment = fj.flush_relay AND oi.start_ts >= (fj.fert_end - '00:00:30'::interval) AND oi.start_ts <= (fj.fert_end + '00:10:00'::interval)
                  ORDER BY oi.start_ts
                 LIMIT 1) fl ON true
        ), measured AS (
         SELECT p.fert_relay,
            p.flush_relay,
            p.zone_path,
            p.serves_zones,
            p.schedule_id,
            p.expected_fert_min,
            p.expected_flush_min,
            p.fert_start,
            p.fert_end,
            p.flush_start,
            p.flush_end,
            COALESCE(p.flush_end, p.fert_end) AS run_end,
            master.overlap_min AS fert_master_overlap_min,
            water.overlap_min AS water_flowing_overlap_min,
            meter.samples AS meter_samples,
            meter.min_total_gal,
            meter.max_total_gal,
                CASE
                    WHEN meter.samples >= 2 THEN GREATEST(0.0::double precision, meter.max_total_gal - meter.min_total_gal)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS meter_delta_gal,
            meter.avg_flow_gpm,
            meter.max_flow_gpm
           FROM paired p
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT round(sum(EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(m.end_ts, p.fert_end) - GREATEST(m.start_ts, p.fert_start))) / 60.0, 2)::double precision AS overlap_min
                   FROM on_intervals m
                  WHERE m.equipment = 'fert_master_valve'::text AND m.start_ts < p.fert_end AND m.end_ts > p.fert_start) master ON true
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT round(sum(EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(w.end_ts, COALESCE(p.flush_end, p.fert_end)) - GREATEST(w.start_ts, p.fert_start))) / 60.0, 2)::double precision AS overlap_min
                   FROM on_intervals w
                  WHERE w.equipment = 'water_flowing'::text AND w.start_ts < COALESCE(p.flush_end, p.fert_end) AND w.end_ts > p.fert_start) water ON true
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT stats.samples,
                    first_sample.water_total_gal AS min_total_gal,
                    last_sample.water_total_gal AS max_total_gal,
                    stats.avg_flow_gpm,
                    stats.max_flow_gpm
                   FROM ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS samples,
                            avg(c.flow_gpm) AS avg_flow_gpm,
                            max(c.flow_gpm) AS max_flow_gpm
                           FROM climate c
                          WHERE c.ts >= (p.fert_start - '00:00:30'::interval) AND c.ts <= (COALESCE(p.flush_end, p.fert_end) + '00:01:30'::interval) AND c.water_total_gal IS NOT NULL AND c.water_total_gal > 0::double precision) stats
                     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c.water_total_gal
                           FROM climate c
                          WHERE c.ts >= (p.fert_start - '00:00:30'::interval) AND c.ts <= (COALESCE(p.flush_end, p.fert_end) + '00:01:30'::interval) AND c.water_total_gal IS NOT NULL AND c.water_total_gal > 0::double precision
                          ORDER BY c.ts
                         LIMIT 1) first_sample ON true
                     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c.water_total_gal
                           FROM climate c
                          WHERE c.ts >= (p.fert_start - '00:00:30'::interval) AND c.ts <= (COALESCE(p.flush_end, p.fert_end) + '00:01:30'::interval) AND c.water_total_gal IS NOT NULL AND c.water_total_gal > 0::double precision
                          ORDER BY c.ts DESC
                         LIMIT 1) last_sample ON true) meter ON true
        ), flagged AS (
         SELECT md5((measured.fert_relay || '|'::text) || measured.fert_start::text) AS run_id,
            (measured.fert_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS day,
            measured.zone_path,
            measured.serves_zones,
            measured.schedule_id,
            measured.fert_relay,
            measured.flush_relay,
            measured.fert_start,
            measured.fert_end,
            round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM measured.fert_end - measured.fert_start) / 60.0, 2)::double precision AS fert_duration_min,
            measured.flush_start,
            measured.flush_end,
                CASE
                    WHEN measured.flush_start IS NOT NULL AND measured.flush_end IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM measured.flush_end - measured.flush_start) / 60.0, 2)::double precision
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS flush_duration_min,
            measured.fert_start AS run_start,
            measured.run_end,
            round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM measured.run_end - measured.fert_start) / 60.0, 2)::double precision AS total_duration_min,
            measured.expected_fert_min,
            measured.expected_flush_min,
            COALESCE(measured.fert_master_overlap_min, 0.0::double precision) AS fert_master_overlap_min,
            COALESCE(measured.water_flowing_overlap_min, 0.0::double precision) AS water_flowing_overlap_min,
            measured.meter_samples,
            measured.min_total_gal,
            measured.max_total_gal,
            measured.meter_delta_gal,
            measured.avg_flow_gpm,
            measured.max_flow_gpm,
            array_remove(ARRAY[
                CASE
                    WHEN measured.flush_start IS NULL THEN 'missing_flush'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(measured.fert_master_overlap_min, 0.0::double precision) < GREATEST(0.5, EXTRACT(epoch FROM measured.fert_end - measured.fert_start) / 60.0 * 0.95)::double precision THEN 'low_master_overlap'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN measured.meter_samples IS NULL OR measured.meter_samples < 2 THEN 'meter_sparse'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN measured.meter_samples >= 2 AND COALESCE(measured.meter_delta_gal, 0.0::double precision) <= 0.0::double precision THEN 'zero_meter_delta'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END], NULL::text) AS quality_flags
           FROM measured
        )
 SELECT run_id,
    day,
    zone_path,
    serves_zones,
    schedule_id,
    fert_relay,
    flush_relay,
    fert_start,
    fert_end,
    fert_duration_min,
    flush_start,
    flush_end,
    flush_duration_min,
    run_start,
    run_end,
    total_duration_min,
    expected_fert_min,
    expected_flush_min,
    fert_master_overlap_min,
    water_flowing_overlap_min,
    meter_samples,
    min_total_gal,
    max_total_gal,
    meter_delta_gal,
    avg_flow_gpm,
    max_flow_gpm,
    quality_flags,
        CASE
            WHEN array_length(quality_flags, 1) IS NULL THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE array_to_string(quality_flags, ','::text)
        END AS quality_flag
   FROM flagged
  ORDER BY fert_start DESC, fert_relay;
v_irrigation_fertigation_runs.name: v_irrigation_fertigation_runs

v_irrigation_log.definition:
SELECT (('x'::text || substr(run_id, 1, 8)))::bit(32)::integer & 2147483647 AS id,
    run_start AS ts,
    zone_path AS zone,
    NULL::integer AS schedule_id,
    (run_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::time without time zone AS scheduled_time,
    run_start AS actual_start,
    run_end AS actual_end,
    round(COALESCE(meter_delta_gal, 0::double precision)::numeric, 2)::numeric(8,2) AS volume_gal,
    'equipment_state'::text AS source,
    concat_ws(' '::text, 'retired compatibility row reconstructed from v_irrigation_fertigation_runs;', 'run_id='::text || run_id, 'fert_relay='::text || fert_relay, 'flush_relay='::text || flush_relay, 'quality='::text || quality_flag) AS notes,
    run_end AS created_at,
    'vallery'::text AS greenhouse_id,
    false AS weather_skip,
    true AS fertigation,
    'water_total_gal'::text AS metering_method,
    round(total_duration_min * 60::double precision)::integer AS duration_s
   FROM v_irrigation_fertigation_runs
  ORDER BY run_start DESC, fert_relay;
v_irrigation_log.name: v_irrigation_log

v_irrigation_program_daily.definition:
SELECT day AS date,
    count(*) AS fertigation_events,
    round(sum(total_duration_min)::numeric, 1)::double precision AS runtime_min,
    round(sum(fert_duration_min)::numeric, 1)::double precision AS fert_runtime_min,
    round(sum(COALESCE(flush_duration_min, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1)::double precision AS flush_runtime_min,
    round(sum(fert_master_overlap_min)::numeric, 1)::double precision AS fert_master_overlap_min,
    round(sum(COALESCE(meter_delta_gal, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2)::double precision AS meter_delta_gal,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE quality_flag <> 'ok'::text) AS flagged_events,
    max(run_end) AS latest_event
   FROM v_irrigation_fertigation_runs
  GROUP BY day
  ORDER BY day DESC;
v_irrigation_program_daily.name: v_irrigation_program_daily

v_irrigation_schedule_current.definition:
WITH param_defaults(parameter, default_value) AS (
         VALUES ('irrig_wall_start_hour'::text,10.0), ('irrig_wall_start_min'::text,30.0), ('irrig_wall_duration_min'::text,10.0), ('irrig_wall_fert_duration_min'::text,6.0), ('irrig_wall_fert_every_n'::text,0.0), ('irrig_wall_days_mask'::text,127.0), ('irrig_wall_fert_days_mask'::text,127.0), ('irrig_wall_flush_min'::text,2.0), ('irrig_wall_interval_days'::text,1.0), ('irrig_center_start_hour'::text,10.0), ('irrig_center_start_min'::text,30.0), ('irrig_center_duration_min'::text,10.0), ('irrig_center_fert_duration_min'::text,6.0), ('irrig_center_fert_every_n'::text,0.0), ('irrig_center_days_mask'::text,127.0), ('irrig_center_fert_days_mask'::text,127.0), ('irrig_center_flush_min'::text,2.0), ('irrig_center_interval_days'::text,1.0)
        ), latest_snapshot AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (setpoint_snapshot.parameter) setpoint_snapshot.parameter,
            setpoint_snapshot.value,
            setpoint_snapshot.ts
           FROM setpoint_snapshot
          WHERE (setpoint_snapshot.parameter IN ( SELECT param_defaults.parameter
                   FROM param_defaults))
          ORDER BY setpoint_snapshot.parameter, setpoint_snapshot.ts DESC
        ), latest_esp32 AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (setpoint_changes.parameter) setpoint_changes.parameter,
            setpoint_changes.value,
            setpoint_changes.ts
           FROM setpoint_changes
          WHERE setpoint_changes.source = 'esp32'::text AND (setpoint_changes.parameter IN ( SELECT param_defaults.parameter
                   FROM param_defaults))
          ORDER BY setpoint_changes.parameter, setpoint_changes.ts DESC
        ), values_by_param AS (
         SELECT d.parameter,
            COALESCE(ap.value, e.value, s.value, d.default_value::double precision) AS value,
                CASE
                    WHEN ap.value IS NOT NULL THEN 'active_plan'::text
                    WHEN e.value IS NOT NULL THEN 'esp32_observed'::text
                    WHEN s.value IS NOT NULL THEN 'cfg_readback'::text
                    ELSE 'default'::text
                END AS source,
            ap.plan_id,
            ap.ts AS plan_ts,
            e.ts AS esp32_ts,
            s.ts AS readback_ts,
            s.value AS readback_value,
            d.default_value
           FROM param_defaults d
             LEFT JOIN v_active_plan ap ON ap.parameter = d.parameter
             LEFT JOIN latest_esp32 e ON e.parameter = d.parameter
             LEFT JOIN latest_snapshot s ON s.parameter = d.parameter
        ), pivoted AS (
         SELECT max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_wall_start_hour'::text) AS wall_start_hour,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_wall_start_min'::text) AS wall_start_min,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_wall_duration_min'::text) AS wall_duration_min,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_wall_fert_duration_min'::text) AS wall_fert_duration_min,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_wall_fert_every_n'::text) AS wall_fert_every_n,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_wall_days_mask'::text) AS wall_days_mask,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_wall_fert_days_mask'::text) AS wall_fert_days_mask,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_wall_flush_min'::text) AS wall_flush_min,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_wall_interval_days'::text) AS wall_interval_days,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_center_start_hour'::text) AS center_start_hour,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_center_start_min'::text) AS center_start_min,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_center_duration_min'::text) AS center_duration_min,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_center_fert_duration_min'::text) AS center_fert_duration_min,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_center_fert_every_n'::text) AS center_fert_every_n,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_center_days_mask'::text) AS center_days_mask,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_center_fert_days_mask'::text) AS center_fert_days_mask,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_center_flush_min'::text) AS center_flush_min,
            max(values_by_param.value) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.parameter = 'irrig_center_interval_days'::text) AS center_interval_days
           FROM values_by_param
        ), source_rollup AS (
         SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.source = 'active_plan'::text) > 0 THEN 'active_plan'::text
                    WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.source = 'esp32_observed'::text) > 0 THEN 'esp32_observed'::text
                    WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.source = 'cfg_readback'::text) > 0 THEN 'cfg_readback'::text
                    ELSE 'default'::text
                END AS schedule_source,
            max(values_by_param.plan_id) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.plan_id IS NOT NULL) AS plan_id,
            max(values_by_param.plan_ts) AS plan_ts,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.readback_ts IS NULL OR values_by_param.readback_ts < (now() - '00:15:00'::interval)) AS stale_readback_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE values_by_param.readback_value IS NOT NULL AND (abs(values_by_param.readback_value - values_by_param.value) / GREATEST(abs(values_by_param.value), 0.001::double precision)) >= 0.01::double precision) AS readback_drift_count
           FROM values_by_param
        ), latest_equipment AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipment_state.equipment) equipment_state.equipment,
            equipment_state.state,
            equipment_state.ts
           FROM equipment_state
          WHERE equipment_state.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['irrigation_enabled'::text, 'irrigation_wall_enabled'::text, 'irrigation_center_enabled'::text])
          ORDER BY equipment_state.equipment, equipment_state.ts DESC
        )
 SELECT 'wall_shared'::text AS schedule_id,
    'wall_shared'::text AS zone_path,
    'Wall shared drip + south/west misters'::text AS display_name,
    ARRAY['south'::text, 'west'::text] AS serves_zones,
    COALESCE(( SELECT latest_equipment.state
           FROM latest_equipment
          WHERE latest_equipment.equipment = 'irrigation_enabled'::text), true) AND COALESCE(( SELECT latest_equipment.state
           FROM latest_equipment
          WHERE latest_equipment.equipment = 'irrigation_wall_enabled'::text), true) AS enabled,
    make_time(GREATEST(0, LEAST(23, round(p.wall_start_hour)::integer)), GREATEST(0, LEAST(59, round(p.wall_start_min)::integer)), 0::double precision) AS start_time,
    round(p.wall_duration_min)::integer AS clean_duration_min,
    round(p.wall_fert_duration_min)::integer AS fert_duration_min,
    round(p.wall_flush_min)::integer AS flush_min,
    round(p.wall_interval_days)::integer AS interval_days,
    round(p.wall_days_mask)::integer AS days_mask,
    round(p.wall_fert_days_mask)::integer AS fert_days_mask,
    round(p.wall_fert_every_n)::integer AS fert_every_n,
    round(p.wall_fert_duration_min)::integer > 0 AND (round(p.wall_fert_days_mask)::integer <> 0 OR round(p.wall_fert_every_n)::integer > 0) AS fertigation_enabled,
    ARRAY['drip_wall_fert'::text, 'mister_south_fert'::text, 'mister_west_fert'::text] AS fert_relays,
    ARRAY['drip_wall'::text, 'mister_south'::text, 'mister_west'::text] AS flush_relays,
    s.schedule_source,
    s.plan_id,
    s.plan_ts,
    s.stale_readback_count,
    s.readback_drift_count,
    'One wall drip path serves south and west; firmware queues wall drip, south mister, and west mister fert jobs from this schedule.'::text AS notes
   FROM pivoted p
     CROSS JOIN source_rollup s
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'center'::text AS schedule_id,
    'center'::text AS zone_path,
    'Center drip'::text AS display_name,
    ARRAY['center'::text] AS serves_zones,
    COALESCE(( SELECT latest_equipment.state
           FROM latest_equipment
          WHERE latest_equipment.equipment = 'irrigation_enabled'::text), true) AND COALESCE(( SELECT latest_equipment.state
           FROM latest_equipment
          WHERE latest_equipment.equipment = 'irrigation_center_enabled'::text), true) AS enabled,
    make_time(GREATEST(0, LEAST(23, round(p.center_start_hour)::integer)), GREATEST(0, LEAST(59, round(p.center_start_min)::integer)), 0::double precision) AS start_time,
    round(p.center_duration_min)::integer AS clean_duration_min,
    round(p.center_fert_duration_min)::integer AS fert_duration_min,
    round(p.center_flush_min)::integer AS flush_min,
    round(p.center_interval_days)::integer AS interval_days,
    round(p.center_days_mask)::integer AS days_mask,
    round(p.center_fert_days_mask)::integer AS fert_days_mask,
    round(p.center_fert_every_n)::integer AS fert_every_n,
    round(p.center_fert_duration_min)::integer > 0 AND (round(p.center_fert_days_mask)::integer <> 0 OR round(p.center_fert_every_n)::integer > 0) AS fertigation_enabled,
    ARRAY['drip_center_fert'::text] AS fert_relays,
    ARRAY['drip_center'::text] AS flush_relays,
    s.schedule_source,
    s.plan_id,
    s.plan_ts,
    s.stale_readback_count,
    s.readback_drift_count,
    'Center drip/fert path; center root-zone and runoff feedback remain pending physical instrumentation.'::text AS notes
   FROM pivoted p
     CROSS JOIN source_rollup s;
v_irrigation_schedule_current.name: v_irrigation_schedule_current

v_irrigation_sensor_feedback_status.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT climate.ts,
            climate.soil_moisture_south_1,
            climate.soil_temp_south_1,
            climate.soil_ec_south_1,
            climate.soil_moisture_south_2,
            climate.soil_temp_south_2,
            climate.moisture_center,
            climate.ph_runoff_center,
            climate.ec_runoff_center
           FROM climate
          ORDER BY climate.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1
        ), windowed AS (
         SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS samples_24h,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND climate.soil_moisture_south_1 IS NOT NULL) AS south_1_samples_24h,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND climate.soil_moisture_south_1 > 0::double precision AND climate.soil_moisture_south_1 <= 100::double precision) AS south_1_positive_24h,
            min(climate.soil_moisture_south_1) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS south_1_min_24h,
            max(climate.soil_moisture_south_1) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS south_1_max_24h,
            max(climate.ts) FILTER (WHERE climate.soil_moisture_south_1 > 0::double precision AND climate.soil_moisture_south_1 <= 100::double precision) AS south_1_moisture_last_positive_ts,
            max(climate.ts) FILTER (WHERE climate.soil_ec_south_1 > 0::double precision) AS south_1_ec_last_positive_ts,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND climate.soil_moisture_south_2 IS NOT NULL) AS south_2_samples_24h,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND climate.soil_moisture_south_2 > 0::double precision AND climate.soil_moisture_south_2 <= 100::double precision) AS south_2_positive_24h,
            min(climate.soil_moisture_south_2) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS south_2_min_24h,
            max(climate.soil_moisture_south_2) FILTER (WHERE climate.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS south_2_max_24h,
            max(climate.ts) FILTER (WHERE climate.soil_moisture_south_2 > 0::double precision AND climate.soil_moisture_south_2 <= 100::double precision) AS south_2_last_positive_ts,
            max(climate.ts) FILTER (WHERE climate.moisture_center >= 0::double precision AND climate.moisture_center <= 100::double precision) AS center_moisture_last_valid_ts,
            max(climate.ts) FILTER (WHERE climate.ph_runoff_center >= 0::double precision AND climate.ph_runoff_center <= 14::double precision) AS center_ph_last_valid_ts,
            max(climate.ts) FILTER (WHERE climate.ec_runoff_center >= 0::double precision) AS center_ec_last_valid_ts
           FROM climate
        )
 SELECT 'south_soil_probe_1'::text AS feedback_key,
    'south'::text AS zone,
    'soil_moisture_south_1'::text AS signal,
    latest.ts AS last_sample_ts,
    latest.soil_moisture_south_1 AS latest_value,
        CASE
            WHEN windowed.south_1_samples_24h = 0 THEN 'missing'::text
            WHEN windowed.south_1_positive_24h = 0 THEN 'stuck_zero'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS status,
    jsonb_build_object('samples_24h', windowed.south_1_samples_24h, 'positive_samples_24h', windowed.south_1_positive_24h, 'min_24h', windowed.south_1_min_24h, 'max_24h', windowed.south_1_max_24h, 'last_positive_ts', windowed.south_1_moisture_last_positive_ts, 'soil_temp_south_1', latest.soil_temp_south_1, 'soil_ec_south_1', latest.soil_ec_south_1, 'soil_ec_south_1_last_positive_ts', windowed.south_1_ec_last_positive_ts, 'south_2_reference_samples_24h', windowed.south_2_samples_24h, 'south_2_reference_positive_samples_24h', windowed.south_2_positive_24h, 'south_2_reference_min_24h', windowed.south_2_min_24h, 'south_2_reference_max_24h', windowed.south_2_max_24h, 'south_2_reference_last_positive_ts', windowed.south_2_last_positive_ts, 'soil_moisture_south_2_reference', latest.soil_moisture_south_2, 'soil_temp_south_2_reference', latest.soil_temp_south_2) AS details,
        CASE
            WHEN windowed.south_1_positive_24h = 0 AND windowed.south_2_positive_24h > 0 AND latest.soil_temp_south_1 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Repair or replace south SEN0601/address-7 probe; south_1 temperature and nearby south_2 moisture are updating, so prioritize probe/media contact or channel failure over shared ingestion. Last positive timestamps are in details.'::text
            ELSE 'Repair or replace south SEN0601/address-7 probe; verify nonzero response after irrigation. Last positive timestamps are in details.'::text
        END AS required_action
   FROM latest
     CROSS JOIN windowed
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'center_root_zone_moisture'::text AS feedback_key,
    'center'::text AS zone,
    'moisture_center'::text AS signal,
    windowed.center_moisture_last_valid_ts AS last_sample_ts,
    latest.moisture_center AS latest_value,
        CASE
            WHEN latest.moisture_center IS NOT NULL AND NOT (latest.moisture_center >= 0::double precision AND latest.moisture_center <= 100::double precision) THEN 'invalid'::text
            WHEN windowed.center_moisture_last_valid_ts IS NULL THEN 'missing'::text
            WHEN windowed.center_moisture_last_valid_ts < (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) THEN 'stale'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS status,
    jsonb_build_object('last_valid_sample_ts', windowed.center_moisture_last_valid_ts, 'latest_raw_value', latest.moisture_center) AS details,
    'Install/map center root-zone moisture sensor.'::text AS required_action
   FROM latest
     CROSS JOIN windowed
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'center_runoff_ph'::text AS feedback_key,
    'center'::text AS zone,
    'ph_runoff_center'::text AS signal,
    windowed.center_ph_last_valid_ts AS last_sample_ts,
    latest.ph_runoff_center AS latest_value,
        CASE
            WHEN latest.ph_runoff_center IS NOT NULL AND NOT (latest.ph_runoff_center >= 0::double precision AND latest.ph_runoff_center <= 14::double precision) THEN 'invalid'::text
            WHEN windowed.center_ph_last_valid_ts IS NULL THEN 'missing'::text
            WHEN windowed.center_ph_last_valid_ts < (now() - '7 days'::interval) THEN 'stale'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS status,
    jsonb_build_object('last_valid_sample_ts', windowed.center_ph_last_valid_ts, 'latest_raw_value', latest.ph_runoff_center) AS details,
    'Install/map center runoff pH feedback.'::text AS required_action
   FROM latest
     CROSS JOIN windowed
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'center_runoff_ec'::text AS feedback_key,
    'center'::text AS zone,
    'ec_runoff_center'::text AS signal,
