    windowed.center_ec_last_valid_ts AS last_sample_ts,
    latest.ec_runoff_center AS latest_value,
        CASE
            WHEN latest.ec_runoff_center IS NOT NULL AND latest.ec_runoff_center < 0::double precision THEN 'invalid'::text
            WHEN windowed.center_ec_last_valid_ts IS NULL THEN 'missing'::text
            WHEN windowed.center_ec_last_valid_ts < (now() - '7 days'::interval) THEN 'stale'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS status,
    jsonb_build_object('last_valid_sample_ts', windowed.center_ec_last_valid_ts, 'latest_raw_value', latest.ec_runoff_center) AS details,
    'Install/map center runoff EC feedback.'::text AS required_action
   FROM latest
     CROSS JOIN windowed
  ORDER BY 2, 3;
v_irrigation_sensor_feedback_status.name: v_irrigation_sensor_feedback_status

v_latest_observations.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (zone) zone,
    ts,
    camera,
    confidence,
    crops_observed,
    environment_notes,
    recommended_actions
   FROM image_observations
  ORDER BY zone, ts DESC;
v_latest_observations.name: v_latest_observations

v_light_transmission.definition:
WITH indoor AS (
         SELECT time_bucket('00:05:00'::interval, climate.ts) AS bucket,
            avg(climate.lux) AS lux
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.lux IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY (time_bucket('00:05:00'::interval, climate.ts))
        ), outdoor AS (
         SELECT time_bucket('00:05:00'::interval, climate.ts) AS bucket,
            avg(climate.outdoor_lux) AS ppfd
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.outdoor_lux IS NOT NULL AND climate.outdoor_lux > 0::double precision
          GROUP BY (time_bucket('00:05:00'::interval, climate.ts))
        )
 SELECT indoor.bucket AS ts,
    round((indoor.lux / outdoor.ppfd * 100::double precision)::numeric, 1) AS transmission_pct
   FROM indoor
     JOIN outdoor ON indoor.bucket = outdoor.bucket;
v_light_transmission.name: v_light_transmission

v_lighting_circuit_status_now.definition:
WITH status AS (
         SELECT v_lighting_minutes_status_now.greenhouse_id,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.ts,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.light_key,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.equipment,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.target_light_minutes,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.start_hour,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.cutoff_hour,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.lux_on_threshold,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.lux_hysteresis,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.lux_off_threshold,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.min_on_s,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.min_off_s,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.auto_enabled,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.legacy_dli_target,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.source_chain,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.controller_contract,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.qualified_light_minutes,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.natural_qualified_minutes,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.switch_on_minutes,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.overlap_minutes,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.remaining_light_minutes,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.climate_ts,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_today,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.indoor_lux,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.outdoor_lux,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.exterior_lux,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.natural_lux,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.natural_qualified_now,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.local_hour,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.in_light_window,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.minutes_below_target,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.lux_below_on_threshold,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.lux_below_off_threshold,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.exterior_lux_fresh,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.exterior_lux_below_on_threshold,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.exterior_lux_below_off_threshold,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.occupancy_active,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.actual_on,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.firmware_state,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.firmware_reason,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.firmware_telemetry_fresh,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.equipment_ts,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.plant_supplement_demand,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.occupancy_lux_demand,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.expected_on,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_availability,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_unavailable_reason,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_provenance,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_validity_revision,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_valid_from,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_valid_to
           FROM v_lighting_minutes_status_now
        ), latest_reason AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (ss.entity) ss.entity,
            ss.value,
            ss.ts
           FROM system_state ss
          WHERE ss.entity = ANY (ARRAY['gl_main_state'::text, 'gl_main_reason'::text, 'gl_grow_state'::text, 'gl_grow_reason'::text])
          ORDER BY ss.entity, ss.ts DESC
        )
 SELECT s.greenhouse_id,
    s.ts,
    s.light_key,
    s.equipment,
    s.legacy_dli_target AS dli_target,
    s.start_hour,
    s.cutoff_hour,
    s.lux_on_threshold,
    s.lux_hysteresis,
    s.lux_off_threshold,
    s.min_on_s,
    s.min_off_s,
    s.auto_enabled,
    s.source_chain,
    s.controller_contract,
    s.climate_ts,
    s.dli_today,
    s.indoor_lux,
    s.outdoor_lux,
    s.natural_lux,
    s.local_hour,
    s.in_light_window,
    NULL::boolean AS dli_below_target,
    s.lux_below_on_threshold,
    s.lux_below_off_threshold,
    s.expected_on,
    s.actual_on,
        CASE
            WHEN s.firmware_telemetry_fresh THEN state_row.value
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS firmware_state,
        CASE
            WHEN s.firmware_telemetry_fresh THEN reason_row.value
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS firmware_reason,
    s.equipment_ts,
    state_row.value AS firmware_state_raw,
    reason_row.value AS firmware_reason_raw,
    state_row.ts AS firmware_state_ts,
    reason_row.ts AS firmware_reason_ts,
    s.firmware_telemetry_fresh,
    s.dli_availability,
    s.dli_unavailable_reason,
    s.dli_provenance,
    s.dli_validity_revision,
    s.dli_valid_from,
    s.dli_valid_to
   FROM status s
     LEFT JOIN latest_reason state_row ON state_row.entity = (('gl_'::text || s.light_key) || '_state'::text)
     LEFT JOIN latest_reason reason_row ON reason_row.entity = (('gl_'::text || s.light_key) || '_reason'::text);
v_lighting_circuit_status_now.name: v_lighting_circuit_status_now

v_lighting_daily.definition:
WITH runtime AS (
         SELECT v_equipment_runtime_daily.day,
            v_equipment_runtime_daily.equipment,
            v_equipment_runtime_daily.on_minutes,
            v_equipment_runtime_daily.cycles
           FROM v_equipment_runtime_daily
          WHERE v_equipment_runtime_daily.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['grow_light_main'::text, 'grow_light_grow'::text])
        )
 SELECT ds.date,
    (ds.date + '12:00:00'::time without time zone)::timestamp with time zone AS ts,
    d.crop_dli_mol_m2_day AS sensor_dli,
    ds.runtime_grow_light_min / 60.0::double precision AS grow_light_hours,
    COALESCE(main_rt.on_minutes, 0.0) / 60.0 AS main_light_hours,
    COALESCE(grow_rt.on_minutes, 0.0) / 60.0 AS grow_light_circuit_hours,
    COALESCE(main_rt.cycles, 0::bigint) AS main_light_cycles,
    COALESCE(grow_rt.cycles, 0::bigint) AS grow_light_circuit_cycles,
    p.target_dli,
    p.target_light_hours,
    p.sunrise_hour,
    p.natural_sunset_hour,
    p.cutoff_hour,
    p.max_crop_name,
    d.availability AS dli_availability,
    d.unavailable_reason AS dli_unavailable_reason,
    d.provenance AS dli_provenance,
    d.validity_revision AS dli_validity_revision,
    d.valid_from AS dli_valid_from,
    d.valid_to AS dli_valid_to
   FROM daily_summary ds
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL fn_lighting_policy((ds.date + '12:00:00'::time without time zone)::timestamp with time zone, COALESCE(ds.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)) p(greenhouse_id, ts, local_date, target_dli, target_ppfd_umol_m2_s, target_light_hours, sunrise_hour, natural_sunset_hour, cutoff_hour, max_crop_name, max_crop_stage, source_chain, controller_contract)
     LEFT JOIN runtime main_rt ON main_rt.day = ds.date AND main_rt.equipment = 'grow_light_main'::text
     LEFT JOIN runtime grow_rt ON grow_rt.day = ds.date AND grow_rt.equipment = 'grow_light_grow'::text
     LEFT JOIN v_dli_daily d ON d.date = ds.date AND d.greenhouse_id = COALESCE(ds.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text);
v_lighting_daily.name: v_lighting_daily

v_lighting_minutes_status_now.definition:
WITH policy AS (
         SELECT fn_lighting_minutes_policy.greenhouse_id,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.ts,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.light_key,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.equipment,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.target_light_minutes,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.start_hour,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.cutoff_hour,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.lux_on_threshold,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.lux_hysteresis,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.lux_off_threshold,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.min_on_s,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.min_off_s,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.auto_enabled,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.legacy_dli_target,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.source_chain,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.controller_contract
           FROM fn_lighting_minutes_policy(now(), 'vallery'::text) fn_lighting_minutes_policy(greenhouse_id, ts, light_key, equipment, target_light_minutes, start_hour, cutoff_hour, lux_on_threshold, lux_hysteresis, lux_off_threshold, min_on_s, min_off_s, auto_enabled, legacy_dli_target, source_chain, controller_contract)
        ), today_window AS (
         SELECT p.light_key,
            p.equipment,
            p.target_light_minutes,
            p.start_hour,
            p.cutoff_hour,
            p.lux_on_threshold,
            p.lux_hysteresis,
            p.lux_off_threshold,
            (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date + make_interval(hours => p.start_hour)) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS start_ts,
            LEAST((((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date + make_interval(hours => p.cutoff_hour)) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text), now()) AS end_ts
           FROM policy p
        ), minute_grid AS (
         SELECT w.light_key,
            w.equipment,
            w.target_light_minutes,
            w.start_hour,
            w.cutoff_hour,
            w.lux_on_threshold,
            w.lux_hysteresis,
            w.lux_off_threshold,
            w.start_ts,
            w.end_ts,
            gs.minute_ts
           FROM today_window w
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL generate_series(w.start_ts, w.end_ts - '00:01:00'::interval, '00:01:00'::interval) gs(minute_ts) ON w.end_ts > w.start_ts
        ), lux_min AS (
         SELECT time_bucket('00:01:00'::interval, c.ts) AS minute_ts,
            avg(COALESCE(c.outdoor_lux, c.lux)) AS natural_lux
           FROM climate c
          WHERE c.greenhouse_id = 'vallery'::text AND c.ts >= (( SELECT min(today_window.start_ts) AS min
                   FROM today_window)) AND c.ts <= (( SELECT max(today_window.end_ts) AS max
                   FROM today_window)) AND COALESCE(c.outdoor_lux, c.lux) IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY (time_bucket('00:01:00'::interval, c.ts))
        ), state_seed AS (
         SELECT w.light_key,
            w.equipment,
            w.start_ts AS ts,
            COALESCE(( SELECT e.state
                   FROM equipment_state e
                  WHERE e.greenhouse_id = 'vallery'::text AND e.equipment = w.equipment AND e.ts <= w.start_ts
                  ORDER BY e.ts DESC
                 LIMIT 1), false) AS state
           FROM today_window w
        ), state_events AS (
         SELECT w.light_key,
            w.equipment,
            e.ts,
            e.state
           FROM today_window w
             JOIN equipment_state e ON e.greenhouse_id = 'vallery'::text AND e.equipment = w.equipment AND e.ts >= w.start_ts AND e.ts <= w.end_ts
        ), state_timeline AS (
         SELECT x.light_key,
            x.equipment,
            x.ts,
            x.state,
            lead(x.ts, 1, w.end_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY x.light_key, x.equipment ORDER BY x.ts) AS next_ts
           FROM ( SELECT state_seed.light_key,
                    state_seed.equipment,
                    state_seed.ts,
                    state_seed.state
                   FROM state_seed
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT state_events.light_key,
                    state_events.equipment,
                    state_events.ts,
                    state_events.state
                   FROM state_events) x
             JOIN today_window w ON w.light_key = x.light_key AND w.equipment = x.equipment
        ), state_segments AS (
         SELECT st.light_key,
            st.equipment,
            GREATEST(st.ts, w.start_ts) AS start_ts,
            LEAST(st.next_ts, w.end_ts) AS end_ts
           FROM state_timeline st
             JOIN today_window w ON w.light_key = st.light_key AND w.equipment = st.equipment
          WHERE st.state IS TRUE AND st.ts < w.end_ts AND st.next_ts > w.start_ts
        ), minute_eval AS (
         SELECT mg.light_key,
            mg.equipment,
            mg.minute_ts,
            COALESCE(lm.natural_lux, 0.0::double precision) >= mg.lux_on_threshold AS natural_qualified,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM state_segments s
                  WHERE s.light_key = mg.light_key AND s.equipment = mg.equipment AND s.start_ts < (mg.minute_ts + '00:01:00'::interval) AND s.end_ts > mg.minute_ts)) AS switch_on
           FROM minute_grid mg
             LEFT JOIN lux_min lm ON lm.minute_ts = mg.minute_ts
        ), today AS (
         SELECT w.light_key,
            w.equipment,
            count(me.minute_ts)::integer AS observed_minutes,
            count(me.minute_ts) FILTER (WHERE me.natural_qualified)::integer AS natural_qualified_minutes,
            count(me.minute_ts) FILTER (WHERE me.switch_on)::integer AS switch_on_minutes,
            count(me.minute_ts) FILTER (WHERE me.natural_qualified AND me.switch_on)::integer AS overlap_minutes,
            count(me.minute_ts) FILTER (WHERE me.natural_qualified OR me.switch_on)::integer AS qualified_light_minutes,
            count(me.minute_ts) FILTER (WHERE NOT me.natural_qualified AND NOT me.switch_on)::integer AS below_threshold_off_minutes
           FROM today_window w
             LEFT JOIN minute_eval me ON me.light_key = w.light_key AND me.equipment = w.equipment
          GROUP BY w.light_key, w.equipment
        ), latest_climate AS (
         SELECT c.ts,
            d.crop_dli_mol_m2_day AS dli_today,
            c.lux,
            c.outdoor_lux
           FROM climate c
             LEFT JOIN v_dli_current d ON d.greenhouse_id = COALESCE(c.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)
          WHERE c.greenhouse_id = 'vallery'::text
          ORDER BY c.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1
        ), latest_equipment AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipment_state.equipment) equipment_state.equipment,
            equipment_state.state,
            equipment_state.ts
           FROM equipment_state
          WHERE equipment_state.greenhouse_id = 'vallery'::text AND (equipment_state.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['grow_light_main'::text, 'grow_light_grow'::text]))
          ORDER BY equipment_state.equipment, equipment_state.ts DESC
        ), current_firmware_start AS (
         WITH firmware_ordered AS (
                 SELECT diagnostics.ts,
                    diagnostics.firmware_version,
                    lag(diagnostics.firmware_version) OVER (ORDER BY diagnostics.ts) AS previous_firmware_version
                   FROM diagnostics
                  WHERE diagnostics.firmware_version IS NOT NULL AND diagnostics.firmware_version <> ''::text AND diagnostics.ts > (now() - '30 days'::interval)
                ), current_firmware AS (
                 SELECT diagnostics.firmware_version
                   FROM diagnostics
                  WHERE diagnostics.firmware_version IS NOT NULL AND diagnostics.firmware_version <> ''::text
                  ORDER BY diagnostics.ts DESC
                 LIMIT 1
                )
         SELECT max(fo.ts) AS ts
           FROM firmware_ordered fo
             CROSS JOIN current_firmware cf
          WHERE fo.firmware_version = cf.firmware_version AND fo.previous_firmware_version IS DISTINCT FROM fo.firmware_version
        ), latest_reason AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (system_state.entity) system_state.entity,
            system_state.value,
            system_state.ts
           FROM system_state
          WHERE system_state.entity = ANY (ARRAY['gl_main_state'::text, 'gl_main_reason'::text, 'gl_grow_state'::text, 'gl_grow_reason'::text])
          ORDER BY system_state.entity, system_state.ts DESC
        ), latest_occupancy AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (system_state.entity) system_state.entity,
            system_state.value,
            system_state.ts
           FROM system_state
          WHERE system_state.entity = ANY (ARRAY['occupancy'::text, 'occupancy_until'::text])
          ORDER BY system_state.entity, system_state.ts DESC
        ), occupancy AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(state.value = 'occupied'::text, false) AND COALESCE(
                CASE
                    WHEN until_row.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T'::text THEN until_row.value::timestamp with time zone > now()
                    ELSE false
                END, false) AS occupancy_active
           FROM ( SELECT 1 AS "?column?") seed
             LEFT JOIN latest_occupancy state ON state.entity = 'occupancy'::text
             LEFT JOIN latest_occupancy until_row ON until_row.entity = 'occupancy_until'::text
        ), outdoor_staleness AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT GREATEST(120, LEAST(1800, round(setpoint_snapshot.value)::integer)) AS "greatest"
                   FROM setpoint_snapshot
                  WHERE COALESCE(setpoint_snapshot.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) = 'vallery'::text AND setpoint_snapshot.parameter = 'outdoor_staleness_max_s'::text
                  ORDER BY setpoint_snapshot.ts DESC
                 LIMIT 1), 600) AS max_age_s
        ), joined AS (
         SELECT p.greenhouse_id,
            p.ts,
            p.light_key,
            p.equipment,
            p.target_light_minutes,
            p.start_hour,
            p.cutoff_hour,
            p.lux_on_threshold,
            p.lux_hysteresis,
            p.lux_off_threshold,
            p.min_on_s,
            p.min_off_s,
            p.auto_enabled,
            p.legacy_dli_target,
            p.source_chain,
            p.controller_contract,
            COALESCE(t.qualified_light_minutes, 0) AS qualified_light_minutes,
            COALESCE(t.natural_qualified_minutes, 0) AS natural_qualified_minutes,
            COALESCE(t.switch_on_minutes, 0) AS switch_on_minutes,
            COALESCE(t.overlap_minutes, 0) AS overlap_minutes,
            GREATEST(0, p.target_light_minutes - COALESCE(t.qualified_light_minutes, 0)) AS remaining_light_minutes,
            c.ts AS climate_ts,
            c.dli_today,
            c.lux AS indoor_lux,
            c.outdoor_lux,
            c.outdoor_lux AS exterior_lux,
            COALESCE(c.outdoor_lux, c.lux, 0.0::double precision) AS natural_lux,
            COALESCE(c.outdoor_lux, c.lux, 0.0::double precision) >= p.lux_on_threshold AS natural_qualified_now,
            EXTRACT(hour FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text))::integer AS local_hour,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.start_hour <= p.cutoff_hour THEN EXTRACT(hour FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text))::integer >= p.start_hour AND EXTRACT(hour FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text))::integer < p.cutoff_hour
                    ELSE EXTRACT(hour FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text))::integer >= p.start_hour OR EXTRACT(hour FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text))::integer < p.cutoff_hour
                END AS in_light_window,
            COALESCE(t.qualified_light_minutes, 0) < p.target_light_minutes AS minutes_below_target,
            COALESCE(c.outdoor_lux, c.lux, 0.0::double precision) < p.lux_on_threshold AS lux_below_on_threshold,
            COALESCE(c.outdoor_lux, c.lux, 0.0::double precision) < p.lux_off_threshold AS lux_below_off_threshold,
            c.outdoor_lux IS NOT NULL AND c.ts > (now() - make_interval(secs => os.max_age_s::double precision)) AS exterior_lux_fresh,
            c.outdoor_lux IS NOT NULL AND c.ts > (now() - make_interval(secs => os.max_age_s::double precision)) AND c.outdoor_lux < p.lux_on_threshold AS exterior_lux_below_on_threshold,
            c.outdoor_lux IS NOT NULL AND c.ts > (now() - make_interval(secs => os.max_age_s::double precision)) AND c.outdoor_lux < p.lux_off_threshold AS exterior_lux_below_off_threshold,
            o.occupancy_active,
            COALESCE(e.state, false) AS actual_on,
            state_row.value AS firmware_state,
            reason_row.value AS firmware_reason,
            state_row.ts >= COALESCE(( SELECT current_firmware_start.ts
                   FROM current_firmware_start), now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND reason_row.ts >= COALESCE(( SELECT current_firmware_start.ts
                   FROM current_firmware_start), now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND state_row.ts > (now() - '00:15:00'::interval) AND reason_row.ts > (now() - '00:15:00'::interval) AS firmware_telemetry_fresh,
            e.ts AS equipment_ts
           FROM policy p
             LEFT JOIN today t ON t.light_key = p.light_key AND t.equipment = p.equipment
             LEFT JOIN latest_climate c ON true
             LEFT JOIN latest_equipment e ON e.equipment = p.equipment
             LEFT JOIN latest_reason state_row ON state_row.entity = (('gl_'::text || p.light_key) || '_state'::text)
             LEFT JOIN latest_reason reason_row ON reason_row.entity = (('gl_'::text || p.light_key) || '_reason'::text)
             CROSS JOIN occupancy o
             CROSS JOIN outdoor_staleness os
        )
 SELECT j.greenhouse_id,
    j.ts,
    j.light_key,
    j.equipment,
    j.target_light_minutes,
    j.start_hour,
    j.cutoff_hour,
    j.lux_on_threshold,
    j.lux_hysteresis,
    j.lux_off_threshold,
    j.min_on_s,
    j.min_off_s,
    j.auto_enabled,
    j.legacy_dli_target,
    j.source_chain,
    j.controller_contract,
    j.qualified_light_minutes,
    j.natural_qualified_minutes,
    j.switch_on_minutes,
    j.overlap_minutes,
    j.remaining_light_minutes,
    j.climate_ts,
    j.dli_today,
    j.indoor_lux,
    j.outdoor_lux,
    j.exterior_lux,
    j.natural_lux,
    j.natural_qualified_now,
    j.local_hour,
    j.in_light_window,
    j.minutes_below_target,
    j.lux_below_on_threshold,
    j.lux_below_off_threshold,
    j.exterior_lux_fresh,
    j.exterior_lux_below_on_threshold,
    j.exterior_lux_below_off_threshold,
    j.occupancy_active,
    j.actual_on,
    j.firmware_state,
    j.firmware_reason,
    j.firmware_telemetry_fresh,
    j.equipment_ts,
    j.auto_enabled AND j.in_light_window AND j.minutes_below_target AND (j.lux_below_on_threshold OR (j.actual_on OR j.firmware_telemetry_fresh AND upper(COALESCE(j.firmware_state, ''::text)) = 'ON'::text) AND j.lux_below_off_threshold) AS plant_supplement_demand,
    j.auto_enabled AND j.occupancy_active AND j.exterior_lux_fresh AND (j.exterior_lux_below_on_threshold OR (j.actual_on OR j.firmware_telemetry_fresh AND upper(COALESCE(j.firmware_state, ''::text)) = 'ON'::text) AND j.exterior_lux_below_off_threshold) AS occupancy_lux_demand,
    j.auto_enabled AND j.in_light_window AND j.minutes_below_target AND (j.lux_below_on_threshold OR (j.actual_on OR j.firmware_telemetry_fresh AND upper(COALESCE(j.firmware_state, ''::text)) = 'ON'::text) AND j.lux_below_off_threshold) OR j.auto_enabled AND j.occupancy_active AND j.exterior_lux_fresh AND (j.exterior_lux_below_on_threshold OR (j.actual_on OR j.firmware_telemetry_fresh AND upper(COALESCE(j.firmware_state, ''::text)) = 'ON'::text) AND j.exterior_lux_below_off_threshold) AS expected_on,
    dc.availability AS dli_availability,
    dc.unavailable_reason AS dli_unavailable_reason,
    dc.provenance AS dli_provenance,
    dc.validity_revision AS dli_validity_revision,
    dc.valid_from AS dli_valid_from,
    dc.valid_to AS dli_valid_to
   FROM joined j
     LEFT JOIN v_dli_current dc ON dc.greenhouse_id = j.greenhouse_id;

v_lighting_qualified_minutes_daily.definition:
WITH policy AS (
         SELECT fn_lighting_minutes_policy.greenhouse_id,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.ts,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.light_key,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.equipment,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.target_light_minutes,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.start_hour,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.cutoff_hour,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.lux_on_threshold,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.lux_hysteresis,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.lux_off_threshold,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.min_on_s,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.min_off_s,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.auto_enabled,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.legacy_dli_target,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.source_chain,
            fn_lighting_minutes_policy.controller_contract
           FROM fn_lighting_minutes_policy(now(), 'vallery'::text) fn_lighting_minutes_policy(greenhouse_id, ts, light_key, equipment, target_light_minutes, start_hour, cutoff_hour, lux_on_threshold, lux_hysteresis, lux_off_threshold, min_on_s, min_off_s, auto_enabled, legacy_dli_target, source_chain, controller_contract)
        ), days AS (
         SELECT generate_series(((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date - 14)::timestamp with time zone, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval)::date AS local_date
        ), windows AS (
         SELECT d.local_date,
            p.light_key,
            p.equipment,
            p.target_light_minutes,
            p.start_hour,
            p.cutoff_hour,
            p.lux_on_threshold,
            p.lux_hysteresis,
            p.lux_off_threshold,
            ((d.local_date + make_interval(hours => p.start_hour)) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS start_ts,
            LEAST(((d.local_date + make_interval(hours => p.cutoff_hour)) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text), now()) AS end_ts
           FROM days d
             CROSS JOIN policy p
          WHERE ((d.local_date + make_interval(hours => p.start_hour)) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) < now()
        ), lux_min AS (
         SELECT time_bucket('00:01:00'::interval, c.ts) AS minute_ts,
            avg(COALESCE(c.outdoor_lux, c.lux)) AS natural_lux
           FROM climate c
          WHERE c.greenhouse_id = 'vallery'::text AND c.ts >= (( SELECT min(windows.start_ts) AS min
                   FROM windows)) AND c.ts <= (( SELECT max(windows.end_ts) AS max
                   FROM windows)) AND COALESCE(c.outdoor_lux, c.lux) IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY (time_bucket('00:01:00'::interval, c.ts))
        ), lux_samples AS (
         SELECT w_1.local_date,
            w_1.light_key,
            w_1.equipment,
            w_1.target_light_minutes,
            w_1.start_hour,
            w_1.cutoff_hour,
            w_1.lux_on_threshold,
            w_1.lux_hysteresis,
            w_1.lux_off_threshold,
            lm.minute_ts,
            lm.natural_lux,
            lm.natural_lux >= w_1.lux_on_threshold AS natural_qualified
           FROM windows w_1
             JOIN lux_min lm ON lm.minute_ts >= w_1.start_ts AND lm.minute_ts < w_1.end_ts
        ), state_seed AS (
         SELECT w_1.local_date,
            w_1.light_key,
            w_1.equipment,
            w_1.start_ts AS ts,
            COALESCE(( SELECT e.state
                   FROM equipment_state e
                  WHERE e.greenhouse_id = 'vallery'::text AND e.equipment = w_1.equipment AND e.ts <= w_1.start_ts
                  ORDER BY e.ts DESC
                 LIMIT 1), false) AS state
           FROM windows w_1
        ), state_events AS (
         SELECT w_1.local_date,
            w_1.light_key,
            w_1.equipment,
            e.ts,
            e.state
           FROM windows w_1
             JOIN equipment_state e ON e.greenhouse_id = 'vallery'::text AND e.equipment = w_1.equipment AND e.ts >= w_1.start_ts AND e.ts <= w_1.end_ts
        ), state_timeline AS (
         SELECT x.local_date,
            x.light_key,
            x.equipment,
            x.ts,
            x.state,
            lead(x.ts, 1, w_1.end_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY x.local_date, x.light_key, x.equipment ORDER BY x.ts) AS next_ts
           FROM ( SELECT state_seed.local_date,
                    state_seed.light_key,
                    state_seed.equipment,
                    state_seed.ts,
                    state_seed.state
                   FROM state_seed
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT state_events.local_date,
                    state_events.light_key,
                    state_events.equipment,
                    state_events.ts,
                    state_events.state
                   FROM state_events) x
             JOIN windows w_1 ON w_1.local_date = x.local_date AND w_1.light_key = x.light_key AND w_1.equipment = x.equipment
        ), state_segments AS (
         SELECT st.local_date,
            st.light_key,
            st.equipment,
            GREATEST(st.ts, w_1.start_ts) AS start_ts,
            LEAST(st.next_ts, w_1.end_ts) AS end_ts
           FROM state_timeline st
             JOIN windows w_1 ON w_1.local_date = st.local_date AND w_1.light_key = st.light_key AND w_1.equipment = st.equipment
          WHERE st.state IS TRUE AND st.ts < w_1.end_ts AND st.next_ts > w_1.start_ts
        ), switch_minutes AS (
         SELECT w_1.local_date,
            w_1.light_key,
            w_1.equipment,
            COALESCE(round(sum(EXTRACT(epoch FROM s_1.end_ts - s_1.start_ts)) / 60.0, 0), 0::numeric)::integer AS switch_on_minutes
           FROM windows w_1
             LEFT JOIN state_segments s_1 ON s_1.local_date = w_1.local_date AND s_1.light_key = w_1.light_key AND s_1.equipment = w_1.equipment
          GROUP BY w_1.local_date, w_1.light_key, w_1.equipment
        ), minute_join AS (
         SELECT ls.local_date,
            ls.light_key,
            ls.equipment,
            ls.target_light_minutes,
            ls.start_hour,
            ls.cutoff_hour,
            ls.lux_on_threshold,
            ls.lux_hysteresis,
            ls.lux_off_threshold,
            ls.minute_ts,
            ls.natural_lux,
            ls.natural_qualified,
            s_1.start_ts IS NOT NULL AS switch_on
           FROM lux_samples ls
             LEFT JOIN state_segments s_1 ON s_1.local_date = ls.local_date AND s_1.light_key = ls.light_key AND s_1.equipment = ls.equipment AND s_1.start_ts < (ls.minute_ts + '00:01:00'::interval) AND s_1.end_ts > ls.minute_ts
        ), minute_rollup AS (
         SELECT minute_join.local_date,
            minute_join.light_key,
            minute_join.equipment,
            max(minute_join.target_light_minutes) AS target_light_minutes,
            count(DISTINCT minute_join.minute_ts)::integer AS observed_minutes,
            count(DISTINCT minute_join.minute_ts) FILTER (WHERE minute_join.natural_qualified)::integer AS natural_qualified_minutes,
            count(DISTINCT minute_join.minute_ts) FILTER (WHERE minute_join.natural_qualified AND minute_join.switch_on)::integer AS overlap_minutes,
            count(DISTINCT minute_join.minute_ts) FILTER (WHERE minute_join.natural_qualified OR minute_join.switch_on)::integer AS qualified_light_minutes,
            count(DISTINCT minute_join.minute_ts) FILTER (WHERE NOT minute_join.natural_qualified AND NOT minute_join.switch_on)::integer AS below_threshold_off_minutes,
            round(avg(minute_join.natural_lux)::numeric, 0) AS avg_natural_lux,
            max(minute_join.start_hour) AS start_hour,
            max(minute_join.cutoff_hour) AS cutoff_hour,
            max(minute_join.lux_on_threshold) AS lux_on_threshold,
            max(minute_join.lux_hysteresis) AS lux_hysteresis,
            max(minute_join.lux_off_threshold) AS lux_off_threshold
           FROM minute_join
          GROUP BY minute_join.local_date, minute_join.light_key, minute_join.equipment
        )
 SELECT w.local_date,
    w.light_key,
    w.equipment,
    w.target_light_minutes,
    COALESCE(m.observed_minutes, 0) AS observed_minutes,
    COALESCE(m.natural_qualified_minutes, 0) AS natural_qualified_minutes,
    COALESCE(s.switch_on_minutes, 0) AS switch_on_minutes,
    COALESCE(m.overlap_minutes, 0) AS overlap_minutes,
    COALESCE(m.natural_qualified_minutes, 0) + COALESCE(s.switch_on_minutes, 0) - COALESCE(m.overlap_minutes, 0) AS qualified_light_minutes,
    GREATEST(0, w.target_light_minutes - (COALESCE(m.natural_qualified_minutes, 0) + COALESCE(s.switch_on_minutes, 0) - COALESCE(m.overlap_minutes, 0))) AS remaining_light_minutes,
    COALESCE(m.below_threshold_off_minutes, 0) AS below_threshold_off_minutes,
    m.avg_natural_lux,
    w.start_hour,
    w.cutoff_hour,
    w.lux_on_threshold,
    w.lux_hysteresis,
    w.lux_off_threshold,
    now() AS computed_at
   FROM windows w
     LEFT JOIN minute_rollup m ON m.local_date = w.local_date AND m.light_key = w.light_key AND m.equipment = w.equipment
     LEFT JOIN switch_minutes s ON s.local_date = w.local_date AND s.light_key = w.light_key AND s.equipment = w.equipment;
v_lighting_qualified_minutes_daily.name: v_lighting_qualified_minutes_daily

v_lighting_status_now.definition:
WITH policy AS (
         SELECT fn_lighting_policy.greenhouse_id,
            fn_lighting_policy.ts,
            fn_lighting_policy.local_date,
            fn_lighting_policy.target_dli,
            fn_lighting_policy.target_ppfd_umol_m2_s,
            fn_lighting_policy.target_light_hours,
            fn_lighting_policy.sunrise_hour,
            fn_lighting_policy.natural_sunset_hour,
            fn_lighting_policy.cutoff_hour,
            fn_lighting_policy.max_crop_name,
            fn_lighting_policy.max_crop_stage,
            fn_lighting_policy.source_chain,
            fn_lighting_policy.controller_contract
           FROM fn_lighting_policy(now(), 'vallery'::text) fn_lighting_policy(greenhouse_id, ts, local_date, target_dli, target_ppfd_umol_m2_s, target_light_hours, sunrise_hour, natural_sunset_hour, cutoff_hour, max_crop_name, max_crop_stage, source_chain, controller_contract)
        ), circuits AS (
         SELECT v_lighting_circuit_status_now.greenhouse_id,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.ts,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.light_key,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.equipment,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.dli_target,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.start_hour,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.cutoff_hour,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.lux_on_threshold,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.lux_hysteresis,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.lux_off_threshold,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.min_on_s,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.min_off_s,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.auto_enabled,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.source_chain,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.controller_contract,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.climate_ts,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.dli_today,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.indoor_lux,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.outdoor_lux,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.natural_lux,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.local_hour,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.in_light_window,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.dli_below_target,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.lux_below_on_threshold,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.lux_below_off_threshold,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.expected_on,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.actual_on,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.firmware_state,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.firmware_reason,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.equipment_ts,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.firmware_state_raw,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.firmware_reason_raw,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.firmware_state_ts,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.firmware_reason_ts,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.firmware_telemetry_fresh,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.dli_availability,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.dli_unavailable_reason,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.dli_provenance,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.dli_validity_revision,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.dli_valid_from,
            v_lighting_circuit_status_now.dli_valid_to
           FROM v_lighting_circuit_status_now
        ), main AS (
         SELECT circuits.greenhouse_id,
            circuits.ts,
            circuits.light_key,
            circuits.equipment,
            circuits.dli_target,
            circuits.start_hour,
            circuits.cutoff_hour,
            circuits.lux_on_threshold,
            circuits.lux_hysteresis,
            circuits.lux_off_threshold,
            circuits.min_on_s,
            circuits.min_off_s,
            circuits.auto_enabled,
            circuits.source_chain,
            circuits.controller_contract,
            circuits.climate_ts,
            circuits.dli_today,
            circuits.indoor_lux,
            circuits.outdoor_lux,
            circuits.natural_lux,
            circuits.local_hour,
            circuits.in_light_window,
            circuits.dli_below_target,
            circuits.lux_below_on_threshold,
            circuits.lux_below_off_threshold,
            circuits.expected_on,
            circuits.actual_on,
            circuits.firmware_state,
            circuits.firmware_reason,
            circuits.equipment_ts,
            circuits.firmware_state_raw,
            circuits.firmware_reason_raw,
            circuits.firmware_state_ts,
            circuits.firmware_reason_ts,
            circuits.firmware_telemetry_fresh,
            circuits.dli_availability,
            circuits.dli_unavailable_reason,
            circuits.dli_provenance,
            circuits.dli_validity_revision,
            circuits.dli_valid_from,
            circuits.dli_valid_to
           FROM circuits
          WHERE circuits.light_key = 'main'::text
        ), grow AS (
         SELECT circuits.greenhouse_id,
            circuits.ts,
            circuits.light_key,
            circuits.equipment,
            circuits.dli_target,
            circuits.start_hour,
            circuits.cutoff_hour,
            circuits.lux_on_threshold,
            circuits.lux_hysteresis,
            circuits.lux_off_threshold,
            circuits.min_on_s,
            circuits.min_off_s,
            circuits.auto_enabled,
            circuits.source_chain,
            circuits.controller_contract,

            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.min_on_s,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.min_off_s,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.auto_enabled,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.legacy_dli_target,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.source_chain,

            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.qualified_light_minutes,

            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.lux_below_on_threshold,

            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.exterior_lux_fresh,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.exterior_lux_below_on_threshold,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.exterior_lux_below_off_threshold,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.occupancy_active,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.actual_on,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.firmware_state,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.firmware_reason,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.firmware_telemetry_fresh,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.equipment_ts,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.plant_supplement_demand,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.occupancy_lux_demand,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.expected_on,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_availability,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_unavailable_reason,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_provenance,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_validity_revision,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_valid_from,
            v_lighting_minutes_status_now.dli_valid_to
           FROM v_lighting_minutes_status_now
        ), latest_desired AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (setpoint_changes.parameter) setpoint_changes.parameter,
            setpoint_changes.value,
            setpoint_changes.delivery_status,
            setpoint_changes.ts
           FROM setpoint_changes
          WHERE COALESCE(setpoint_changes.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) = 'vallery'::text AND COALESCE(setpoint_changes.source, ''::text) <> 'esp32'::text
          ORDER BY setpoint_changes.parameter, setpoint_changes.ts DESC
        ), latest_cfg AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (setpoint_snapshot.parameter) setpoint_snapshot.parameter,
            setpoint_snapshot.value,
            setpoint_snapshot.ts
           FROM setpoint_snapshot
          WHERE COALESCE(setpoint_snapshot.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) = 'vallery'::text
          ORDER BY setpoint_snapshot.parameter, setpoint_snapshot.ts DESC
        ), latest_decision AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (system_state.entity) system_state.entity,
            system_state.value,
            system_state.ts
           FROM system_state
          WHERE system_state.entity = ANY (ARRAY['gl_main_decision_epoch'::text, 'gl_grow_decision_epoch'::text])
          ORDER BY system_state.entity, system_state.ts DESC
        )
 SELECT s.greenhouse_id,
    s.ts,
    s.light_key,
    s.equipment,
    s.target_light_minutes,
    s.start_hour,
    s.cutoff_hour,
    s.lux_on_threshold,
    s.lux_hysteresis,
    s.lux_off_threshold,
    s.min_on_s,
    s.min_off_s,
    s.auto_enabled,
    s.legacy_dli_target,
    s.source_chain,
    s.controller_contract,
    s.qualified_light_minutes,
    s.natural_qualified_minutes,
    s.switch_on_minutes,
    s.overlap_minutes,
    s.remaining_light_minutes,
    s.climate_ts,
    s.dli_today,
    s.indoor_lux,
    s.outdoor_lux,
    s.exterior_lux,
    s.natural_lux,
    s.natural_qualified_now,
    s.local_hour,
    s.in_light_window,
    s.minutes_below_target,
    s.lux_below_on_threshold,
    s.lux_below_off_threshold,
    s.exterior_lux_fresh,
    s.exterior_lux_below_on_threshold,
    s.exterior_lux_below_off_threshold,
    s.occupancy_active,
    s.actual_on,
    s.firmware_state,
    s.firmware_reason,
    s.firmware_telemetry_fresh,
    s.equipment_ts,
    s.plant_supplement_demand,
    s.occupancy_lux_demand,
    s.expected_on,
    cfg_target.value AS cfg_target_light_minutes,
    cfg_lux.value AS cfg_lux_on_threshold,
    cfg_hyst.value AS cfg_lux_hysteresis,
    cfg_auto.value >= 0.5::double precision AS cfg_auto_enabled,
    cfg_auto.ts AS cfg_auto_ts,
    desired_target.value AS desired_target_light_minutes,
    desired_lux.value AS desired_lux_on_threshold,
    desired_hyst.value AS desired_lux_hysteresis,
    desired_auto.value >= 0.5::double precision AS desired_auto_enabled,
    desired_auto.delivery_status AS desired_auto_delivery_status,
    desired_auto.ts AS desired_auto_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN decision.value ~ '^[0-9]+([.]0+)?$'::text THEN round(decision.value::numeric)::bigint
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS firmware_decision_epoch,
    decision.ts AS firmware_decision_ts,
    decision.ts > (now() - '00:15:00'::interval) AS firmware_decision_fresh,
    NOT s.auto_enabled IS DISTINCT FROM (cfg_auto.value >= 0.5::double precision) AND NOT s.target_light_minutes IS DISTINCT FROM round(cfg_target.value)::integer AND COALESCE(abs(s.lux_on_threshold - cfg_lux.value) < 0.5::double precision, false) AND COALESCE(abs(s.lux_hysteresis - cfg_hyst.value) < 0.5::double precision, false) AS policy_matches_cfg,
    s.dli_availability,
    s.dli_unavailable_reason,
    s.dli_provenance,
    s.dli_validity_revision,
    s.dli_valid_from,
    s.dli_valid_to
   FROM status s
     LEFT JOIN latest_cfg cfg_target ON cfg_target.parameter = (('gl_'::text || s.light_key) || '_target_light_minutes'::text)
     LEFT JOIN latest_cfg cfg_lux ON cfg_lux.parameter = (('gl_'::text || s.light_key) || '_lux_threshold'::text)
     LEFT JOIN latest_cfg cfg_hyst ON cfg_hyst.parameter = (('gl_'::text || s.light_key) || '_lux_hysteresis'::text)
     LEFT JOIN latest_cfg cfg_auto ON cfg_auto.parameter = (('sw_gl_'::text || s.light_key) || '_auto_mode'::text)
     LEFT JOIN latest_desired desired_target ON desired_target.parameter = (('gl_'::text || s.light_key) || '_target_light_minutes'::text)
     LEFT JOIN latest_desired desired_lux ON desired_lux.parameter = (('gl_'::text || s.light_key) || '_lux_threshold'::text)
     LEFT JOIN latest_desired desired_hyst ON desired_hyst.parameter = (('gl_'::text || s.light_key) || '_lux_hysteresis'::text)
     LEFT JOIN latest_desired desired_auto ON desired_auto.parameter = (('sw_gl_'::text || s.light_key) || '_auto_mode'::text)
     LEFT JOIN latest_decision decision ON decision.entity = (('gl_'::text || s.light_key) || '_decision_epoch'::text);
