v_mister_effectiveness.definition:
WITH mister_events AS (
         SELECT equipment_state.ts,
            equipment_state.equipment,
            equipment_state.state,
            lead(equipment_state.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_state.equipment ORDER BY equipment_state.ts) AS next_ts,
            lead(equipment_state.state) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_state.equipment ORDER BY equipment_state.ts) AS next_state
           FROM equipment_state
          WHERE (equipment_state.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['mister_south'::text, 'mister_west'::text, 'mister_center'::text])) AND equipment_state.ts > (now() - '14 days'::interval)
        ), mister_cycles AS (
         SELECT mister_events.ts AS on_ts,
            mister_events.equipment,
            mister_events.next_ts AS off_ts,
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM mister_events.next_ts - mister_events.ts)::integer AS duration_s
           FROM mister_events
          WHERE mister_events.state = true AND mister_events.next_state = false AND (mister_events.next_ts - mister_events.ts) < '00:30:00'::interval AND (mister_events.next_ts - mister_events.ts) > '00:00:05'::interval
        )
 SELECT mc.on_ts,
    mc.equipment,
    mc.duration_s,
    round(vpd_before.vpd::numeric, 2) AS vpd_before,
    round(vpd_after.vpd::numeric, 2) AS vpd_after,
    round((vpd_before.vpd - vpd_after.vpd)::numeric, 2) AS vpd_delta,
    round(outdoor.outdoor_temp::numeric, 1) AS outdoor_temp_f,
    round(outdoor.outdoor_rh::numeric, 0) AS outdoor_rh_pct
   FROM mister_cycles mc
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT climate.vpd_avg AS vpd
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.ts <= mc.on_ts AND climate.vpd_avg IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY climate.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) vpd_before ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT climate.vpd_avg AS vpd
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.ts >= mc.off_ts AND climate.vpd_avg IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY climate.ts
         LIMIT 1) vpd_after ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT climate.outdoor_temp_f AS outdoor_temp,
            climate.outdoor_rh_pct AS outdoor_rh
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.ts <= mc.on_ts AND climate.outdoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY climate.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) outdoor ON true
  ORDER BY mc.on_ts DESC;
v_mister_effectiveness.name: v_mister_effectiveness

v_mister_fairness_7d.definition:
WITH bounds AS (
         SELECT now() - '7 days'::interval AS start_ts,
            now() AS end_ts
        ), zone_map AS (
         SELECT z.equipment,
            z.zone
           FROM ( VALUES ('mister_south'::text,'south'::text), ('mister_west'::text,'west'::text), ('mister_center'::text,'center'::text)) z(equipment, zone)
        ), mister_set AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT es.greenhouse_id,
            z.equipment,
            z.zone
           FROM equipment_state es
             JOIN zone_map z ON z.equipment = es.equipment
        ), seed AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (ms.greenhouse_id, ms.equipment) ms.greenhouse_id,
            ms.equipment,
            ms.zone,
            b.start_ts AS ts,
            COALESCE(es.state, false) AS state
           FROM mister_set ms
             CROSS JOIN bounds b
             LEFT JOIN equipment_state es ON es.greenhouse_id = ms.greenhouse_id AND es.equipment = ms.equipment AND es.ts <= b.start_ts
          ORDER BY ms.greenhouse_id, ms.equipment, es.ts DESC NULLS LAST
        ), events AS (
         SELECT seed.greenhouse_id,
            seed.equipment,
            seed.zone,
            seed.ts,
            seed.state
           FROM seed
        UNION ALL
         SELECT es.greenhouse_id,
            es.equipment,
            z.zone,
            es.ts,
            es.state
           FROM equipment_state es
             JOIN zone_map z ON z.equipment = es.equipment
             CROSS JOIN bounds b
          WHERE es.ts > b.start_ts AND es.ts <= b.end_ts
        ), ordered AS (
         SELECT e_1.greenhouse_id,
            e_1.equipment,
            e_1.zone,
            e_1.ts,
            e_1.state,
            lag(e_1.state) OVER (PARTITION BY e_1.greenhouse_id, e_1.equipment ORDER BY e_1.ts) AS prev_state,
            lead(e_1.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY e_1.greenhouse_id, e_1.equipment ORDER BY e_1.ts) AS next_ts
           FROM events e_1
        ), rollup AS (
         SELECT o.greenhouse_id,
            o.equipment,
            o.zone,
            sum(EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(COALESCE(o.next_ts, b.end_ts), b.end_ts) - GREATEST(o.ts, b.start_ts)) / 60.0) FILTER (WHERE o.state IS TRUE) AS runtime_min,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.state IS TRUE AND COALESCE(o.prev_state, false) IS FALSE AND o.ts > b.start_ts) AS cycles
           FROM ordered o
             CROSS JOIN bounds b
          WHERE o.ts < b.end_ts AND COALESCE(o.next_ts, b.end_ts) > b.start_ts
          GROUP BY o.greenhouse_id, o.equipment, o.zone
        ), totals AS (
         SELECT rollup.greenhouse_id,
            sum(COALESCE(rollup.runtime_min, 0::numeric)) AS total_runtime_min,
            sum(COALESCE(rollup.cycles, 0::bigint)) AS total_cycles
           FROM rollup
          GROUP BY rollup.greenhouse_id
        ), effect AS (
         SELECT 'vallery'::text AS greenhouse_id,
            v_mister_zone_effectiveness.zone,
            count(*) AS effect_samples,
            round(avg(v_mister_zone_effectiveness.zone_vpd_delta), 3) AS avg_vpd_delta_kpa
           FROM v_mister_zone_effectiveness
          WHERE v_mister_zone_effectiveness.on_ts > (now() - '7 days'::interval)
          GROUP BY 'vallery'::text, v_mister_zone_effectiveness.zone
        ), fairness AS (
         SELECT daily_summary.greenhouse_id,
            COALESCE(sum(daily_summary.mister_fairness_overrides_today), 0::bigint) AS fairness_overrides
           FROM daily_summary
          WHERE daily_summary.date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date - 6)
          GROUP BY daily_summary.greenhouse_id
        )
 SELECT r.greenhouse_id,
    r.zone,
    r.equipment,
    round(COALESCE(r.runtime_min, 0::numeric), 1) AS runtime_minutes,
    COALESCE(r.cycles, 0::bigint) AS cycles,
    round(100.0 * COALESCE(r.runtime_min, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(t.total_runtime_min, 0::numeric), 1) AS runtime_share_pct,
    round(100.0 * COALESCE(r.cycles, 0::bigint)::numeric / NULLIF(t.total_cycles, 0::numeric), 1) AS cycle_share_pct,
    e.effect_samples,
    e.avg_vpd_delta_kpa,
    COALESCE(f.fairness_overrides, 0::bigint) AS fairness_overrides_7d
   FROM rollup r
     JOIN totals t ON t.greenhouse_id = r.greenhouse_id
     LEFT JOIN effect e ON e.greenhouse_id = r.greenhouse_id AND e.zone = r.zone
     LEFT JOIN fairness f ON f.greenhouse_id = r.greenhouse_id
  ORDER BY r.greenhouse_id, r.zone;
v_mister_fairness_7d.name: v_mister_fairness_7d

v_mister_zone_effectiveness.definition:
WITH events AS (
         SELECT equipment_state.ts,
            equipment_state.equipment,
                CASE equipment_state.equipment
                    WHEN 'mister_south'::text THEN 'south'::text
                    WHEN 'mister_west'::text THEN 'west'::text
                    WHEN 'mister_center'::text THEN 'center'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS zone,
            equipment_state.state,
            lead(equipment_state.ts) OVER w AS next_change_ts,
            ( SELECT min(off_evt.ts) AS min
                   FROM equipment_state off_evt
                  WHERE off_evt.equipment = equipment_state.equipment AND off_evt.state = false AND off_evt.ts > equipment_state.ts) AS next_off_ts
           FROM equipment_state
          WHERE (equipment_state.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['mister_south'::text, 'mister_west'::text, 'mister_center'::text])) AND equipment_state.ts > (now() - '30 days'::interval)
          WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY equipment_state.equipment ORDER BY equipment_state.ts)
        ), starts AS (
         SELECT e.ts AS on_ts,
            e.equipment,
            e.zone,
            LEAST(COALESCE(LEAST(e.next_change_ts, e.next_off_ts), e.next_off_ts, e.next_change_ts), e.ts + '00:10:00'::interval) AS off_ts
           FROM events e
          WHERE e.state = true
        )
 SELECT s.on_ts,
    s.equipment,
    s.zone,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM s.off_ts - s.on_ts)::integer AS duration_s,
    before_vpd.vpd AS zone_vpd_before,
    after_vpd.vpd AS zone_vpd_after,
    round((before_vpd.vpd - after_vpd.vpd)::numeric, 3) AS zone_vpd_delta
   FROM starts s
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT
                CASE s.zone
                    WHEN 'south'::text THEN climate.vpd_south
                    WHEN 'west'::text THEN climate.vpd_west
                    ELSE climate.vpd_avg
                END AS vpd
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.ts <= s.on_ts
          ORDER BY climate.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) before_vpd ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT
                CASE s.zone
                    WHEN 'south'::text THEN climate.vpd_south
                    WHEN 'west'::text THEN climate.vpd_west
                    ELSE climate.vpd_avg
                END AS vpd
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.ts >= (COALESCE(s.off_ts, s.on_ts) + '00:05:00'::interval)
          ORDER BY climate.ts
         LIMIT 1) after_vpd ON true
  WHERE s.off_ts IS NOT NULL;
v_mister_zone_effectiveness.name: v_mister_zone_effectiveness

v_moisture_estimator_telemetry.definition:
SELECT l.ts,
    l.greenhouse_id,
    l.climate_action,
    l.priority_axis,
    l.vpd_target_kpa,
    l.vpd_target_delta_kpa,
    l.vpd_band_error_kpa,
    mx.obj IS NOT NULL AS mx_present,
    f.mx_action,
    f.mx_reason,
    f.vent_vpd_gain_kpa,
    f.heat_vpd_gain_kpa,
    f.vent_held_vpd_gain_kpa,
    f.hold_required,
    COALESCE(f.expected_vpd_gain_kpa,
        CASE
            WHEN f.mx_reason = 'vent_plus_heat_hold'::text OR COALESCE(f.hold_required, false) THEN COALESCE(f.vent_held_vpd_gain_kpa, f.vent_vpd_gain_kpa)
            WHEN f.mx_action = ANY (ARRAY['vent_dehum'::text, 'vent_humidify'::text]) THEN f.vent_vpd_gain_kpa
            WHEN f.mx_action = 'heat_assist'::text THEN f.heat_vpd_gain_kpa
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END) AS expected_vpd_gain_kpa,
    f.outdoor_fresh,
    f.outdoor_age_s,
    f.vent_overcools,
    f.heat_assist_corun,
    f.heat_assist_active,
    f.heat_assist_timer_s
   FROM climate_action_log l
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT l.source_system_state -> 'climate_moisture_exchange'::text AS obj
          WHERE jsonb_typeof(l.source_system_state -> 'climate_moisture_exchange'::text) = 'object'::text) mx ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT NULLIF(mx.obj ->> 'action'::text, ''::text) AS mx_action,
            NULLIF(mx.obj ->> 'reason'::text, ''::text) AS mx_reason,
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(mx.obj -> 'vent_vpd_gain_kpa'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (mx.obj ->> 'vent_vpd_gain_kpa'::text)::double precision
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS vent_vpd_gain_kpa,
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(mx.obj -> 'heat_vpd_gain_kpa'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (mx.obj ->> 'heat_vpd_gain_kpa'::text)::double precision
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS heat_vpd_gain_kpa,
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(mx.obj -> 'vent_held_vpd_gain_kpa'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (mx.obj ->> 'vent_held_vpd_gain_kpa'::text)::double precision
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS vent_held_vpd_gain_kpa,
                CASE
                    WHEN (mx.obj ->> 'hold_required'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['true'::text, 'false'::text]) THEN (mx.obj ->> 'hold_required'::text)::boolean
                    ELSE NULL::boolean
                END AS hold_required,
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(mx.obj -> 'expected_vpd_gain_kpa'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (mx.obj ->> 'expected_vpd_gain_kpa'::text)::double precision
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS expected_vpd_gain_kpa,
                CASE
                    WHEN (mx.obj ->> 'outdoor_fresh'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['true'::text, 'false'::text]) THEN (mx.obj ->> 'outdoor_fresh'::text)::boolean
                    ELSE NULL::boolean
                END AS outdoor_fresh,
            COALESCE(
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(mx.obj -> 'outdoor_age_s'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (mx.obj ->> 'outdoor_age_s'::text)::double precision
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(mx.obj -> 'outdoor_data_age_s'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (mx.obj ->> 'outdoor_data_age_s'::text)::double precision
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END) AS outdoor_age_s,
                CASE
                    WHEN (mx.obj ->> 'vent_overcools'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['true'::text, 'false'::text]) THEN (mx.obj ->> 'vent_overcools'::text)::boolean
                    ELSE NULL::boolean
                END AS vent_overcools,
                CASE
                    WHEN (mx.obj ->> 'heat_assist_corun'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['true'::text, 'false'::text]) THEN (mx.obj ->> 'heat_assist_corun'::text)::boolean
                    ELSE NULL::boolean
                END AS heat_assist_corun,
                CASE
                    WHEN (mx.obj ->> 'heat_assist_active'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['true'::text, 'false'::text]) THEN (mx.obj ->> 'heat_assist_active'::text)::boolean
                    ELSE NULL::boolean
                END AS heat_assist_active,
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(mx.obj -> 'heat_assist_timer_s'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (mx.obj ->> 'heat_assist_timer_s'::text)::double precision
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS heat_assist_timer_s) f ON true;
v_moisture_estimator_telemetry.name: v_moisture_estimator_telemetry

v_monthly_summary.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS month_start,
    count(*) AS days,
    round(avg(temp_avg)::numeric, 1) AS temp_avg,
    round(min(temp_min)::numeric, 1) AS temp_min,
    round(max(temp_max)::numeric, 1) AS temp_max,
    round(avg(rh_avg)::numeric, 1) AS rh_avg,
    round(min(rh_min)::numeric, 1) AS rh_min,
    round(max(rh_max)::numeric, 1) AS rh_max,
    round(avg(vpd_avg)::numeric, 2) AS vpd_avg,
    round(min(vpd_min)::numeric, 2) AS vpd_min,
    round(max(vpd_max)::numeric, 2) AS vpd_max,
    NULL::numeric AS dli_avg,
    round(avg(co2_avg)::numeric, 0) AS co2_avg,
    round(min(outdoor_temp_min)::numeric, 1) AS outdoor_temp_min,
    round(max(outdoor_temp_max)::numeric, 1) AS outdoor_temp_max,
    round(sum(COALESCE(stress_hours_heat, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS stress_hours_heat,
    round(sum(COALESCE(stress_hours_cold, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS stress_hours_cold,
    round(sum(COALESCE(stress_hours_vpd_high, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS stress_hours_vpd_high,
    round(sum(COALESCE(stress_hours_vpd_low, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS stress_hours_vpd_low,
    round(sum(COALESCE(water_used_gal, 0::double precision))::numeric, 0) AS total_water_gal,
    round(sum(COALESCE(mister_water_gal, 0::double precision))::numeric, 0) AS mister_water_gal,
    round(sum(COALESCE(kwh_total, kwh_estimated, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS kwh_total,
    round(sum(COALESCE(therms_estimated, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS therms_total,
    round(sum(COALESCE(cost_electric, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS cost_electric,
    round(sum(COALESCE(cost_gas, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS cost_gas,
    round(sum(COALESCE(cost_water, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS cost_water,
    round(sum(COALESCE(cost_total, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS total_cost,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_heat1_min, 0::double precision))::numeric / 60::numeric, 1) AS runtime_heat1_h,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_heat2_min, 0::double precision))::numeric / 60::numeric, 1) AS runtime_heat2_h,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_fan1_min + runtime_fan2_min, 0::double precision))::numeric / 60::numeric, 1) AS runtime_fans_h,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_fog_min, 0::double precision))::numeric / 60::numeric, 1) AS runtime_fog_h,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_vent_min, 0::double precision))::numeric / 60::numeric, 1) AS runtime_vent_h,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_grow_light_min, 0::double precision))::numeric / 60::numeric, 1) AS runtime_grow_light_h,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_mister_south_h + runtime_mister_west_h + runtime_mister_center_h, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS runtime_misters_h,
    sum(COALESCE(cycles_heat1, 0) + COALESCE(cycles_heat2, 0)) AS cycles_heat,
    sum(COALESCE(cycles_fan1, 0) + COALESCE(cycles_fan2, 0)) AS cycles_fans,
    sum(COALESCE(cycles_fog, 0)) AS cycles_fog,
    sum(COALESCE(cycles_vent, 0)) AS cycles_vent
   FROM daily_summary
  WHERE temp_avg IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, date::timestamp with time zone))
  ORDER BY (date_trunc('month'::text, date::timestamp with time zone)::date);
v_monthly_summary.name: v_monthly_summary

v_nutrient_lab_status.definition:
WITH latest_hydro AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON ((COALESCE(climate.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text))) COALESCE(climate.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) AS greenhouse_id,
            climate.ts,
            climate.hydro_ph,
            climate.hydro_ec_us_cm,
            climate.hydro_tds_ppm,
            climate.hydro_orp_mv,
            climate.hydro_battery_pct
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.hydro_ph IS NOT NULL OR climate.hydro_ec_us_cm IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY (COALESCE(climate.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)), climate.ts DESC
        ), latest_lab AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (lab_results.greenhouse_id, lab_results.sample_type, (COALESCE(lab_results.zone, ''::text))) lab_results.greenhouse_id,
            lab_results.sample_type,
            lab_results.zone,
            lab_results.crop_id,
            lab_results.sampled_at,
            lab_results.ph,
            lab_results.ec_ms_cm,
            lab_results.recipe_id
           FROM lab_results
          ORDER BY lab_results.greenhouse_id, lab_results.sample_type, (COALESCE(lab_results.zone, ''::text)), lab_results.sampled_at DESC NULLS LAST, lab_results.ts DESC NULLS LAST
        )
 SELECT h.greenhouse_id,
    h.ts AS hydro_ts,
    h.hydro_ph,
    h.hydro_ec_us_cm,
    h.hydro_tds_ppm,
    h.hydro_orp_mv,
    h.hydro_battery_pct,
    l.sample_type AS latest_lab_sample_type,
    l.zone AS latest_lab_zone,
    l.sampled_at AS latest_lab_sampled_at,
    l.ph AS latest_lab_ph,
    l.ec_ms_cm AS latest_lab_ec_ms_cm,
    nr.name AS recipe_name,
    nr.target_ph_low,
    nr.target_ph_high,
    nr.target_ec,
        CASE
            WHEN h.hydro_ph IS NULL THEN 'missing_hydro_ph'::text
            WHEN nr.target_ph_low IS NOT NULL AND h.hydro_ph < nr.target_ph_low THEN 'ph_low'::text
            WHEN nr.target_ph_high IS NOT NULL AND h.hydro_ph > nr.target_ph_high THEN 'ph_high'::text
            WHEN nr.target_ec IS NOT NULL AND h.hydro_ec_us_cm IS NOT NULL AND (h.hydro_ec_us_cm / 1000.0::double precision) > (nr.target_ec * 1.25::double precision) THEN 'ec_high'::text
            WHEN nr.target_ec IS NOT NULL AND h.hydro_ec_us_cm IS NOT NULL AND (h.hydro_ec_us_cm / 1000.0::double precision) < (nr.target_ec * 0.75::double precision) THEN 'ec_low'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS status
   FROM latest_hydro h
     LEFT JOIN latest_lab l ON l.greenhouse_id = h.greenhouse_id
     LEFT JOIN nutrient_recipes nr ON nr.id = l.recipe_id OR nr.is_active = true AND nr.crop_id = l.crop_id;
v_nutrient_lab_status.name: v_nutrient_lab_status

v_open_alerts.definition:
SELECT id,
    ts,
    alert_type,
    severity,
    category,
    sensor_id,
    zone,
    zone_id,
    greenhouse_id,
    message,
    details,
    source,
    disposition,
    acknowledged_at,
    acknowledged_by,
    metric_value,
    threshold_value,
    slack_thread_ts,
    slack_snoozed_until,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM alert_log a
  WHERE resolved_at IS NULL AND disposition <> 'suppressed'::text
  ORDER BY (
        CASE severity
            WHEN 'critical'::text THEN 0
            WHEN 'high'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'warning'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'info'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END), ts DESC;
v_open_alerts.name: v_open_alerts

v_openclaw_usage_daily.definition:
SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS day,
    session_type,
    count(*) AS calls,
    sum(COALESCE(tokens_in, 0) + COALESCE(tokens_out, 0)) AS total_tokens,
    sum(COALESCE(duration_ms, 0)) AS total_duration_ms,
    round(avg(duration_ms), 0) AS avg_duration_ms,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS error_count
   FROM openclaw_interaction_log
  GROUP BY ((ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date), session_type;
v_openclaw_usage_daily.name: v_openclaw_usage_daily

v_openclaw_usage_hourly.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('hour'::text, ts) AS hour,
    session_type,
    count(*) AS calls,
    sum(COALESCE(tokens_in, 0) + COALESCE(tokens_out, 0)) AS total_tokens,
    sum(COALESCE(duration_ms, 0)) AS total_duration_ms,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS error_count
   FROM openclaw_interaction_log
  WHERE ts > (now() - '7 days'::interval)
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, ts)), session_type;
v_openclaw_usage_hourly.name: v_openclaw_usage_hourly

v_override_activity_24h.definition:
SELECT override_type,
    count(*) AS events,
    min(ts) AS first_seen,
    max(ts) AS last_seen,
    count(DISTINCT mode) AS distinct_modes
   FROM override_events
  WHERE ts > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)
  GROUP BY override_type
  ORDER BY (count(*)) DESC;
v_override_activity_24h.name: v_override_activity_24h

v_plan_accuracy.definition:
SELECT plan_id,
    count(*) AS waypoints,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE plan_achieved) AS achieved,
    round(avg(accuracy_pct), 1) AS accuracy_pct,
    round(avg(abs(overshoot)), 2) AS mean_abs_error,
    min(planned_ts) AS plan_start,
    max(planned_ts) AS plan_end
   FROM v_plan_compliance
  GROUP BY plan_id;
v_plan_accuracy.name: v_plan_accuracy

v_plan_accuracy_72h.definition:
SELECT plan_id,
    floor(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - planned_ts) / 86400.0)::integer + 1 AS day_offset,
    count(*) AS waypoints_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE plan_achieved) AS achieved_count,
    round(avg(accuracy_pct), 1) AS accuracy_pct,
    round(avg(abs(overshoot)), 2) AS mean_abs_error
   FROM v_plan_compliance
  WHERE planned_ts > (now() - '72:00:00'::interval)
  GROUP BY plan_id, (floor(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - planned_ts) / 86400.0)::integer + 1)
  ORDER BY plan_id, (floor(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - planned_ts) / 86400.0)::integer + 1);
v_plan_accuracy_72h.name: v_plan_accuracy_72h

v_plan_accuracy_by_day.definition:
SELECT (planned_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS day,
    count(*) AS waypoints,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE plan_achieved) AS achieved,
    round(avg(accuracy_pct), 1) AS accuracy_pct,
    round(avg(abs(overshoot)), 2) AS mean_abs_error,
    count(DISTINCT plan_id) AS plans
   FROM v_plan_compliance
  GROUP BY ((planned_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date)
  ORDER BY ((planned_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date);
v_plan_accuracy_by_day.name: v_plan_accuracy_by_day

v_plan_comparison.definition:
WITH plan_order AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT setpoint_plan.plan_id,
            min(setpoint_plan.created_at) AS created_at
           FROM setpoint_plan
          WHERE setpoint_plan.plan_id ~~ 'iris-2026%'::text AND setpoint_plan.plan_id !~~ '%reactive%'::text AND setpoint_plan.plan_id !~~ '%fix%'::text AND setpoint_plan.plan_id !~~ '%dev%'::text
          GROUP BY setpoint_plan.plan_id
          ORDER BY (min(setpoint_plan.created_at)) DESC
         LIMIT 20
        ), plan_pairs AS (
         SELECT plan_order.plan_id,
            plan_order.created_at,
            lag(plan_order.plan_id) OVER (ORDER BY plan_order.created_at) AS prev_plan_id
           FROM plan_order
        ), cur_stats AS (
         SELECT sp.plan_id,
            sp.parameter,
            count(*) AS waypoints,
            round(avg(sp.value)::numeric, 2) AS avg_value,
            round(min(sp.value)::numeric, 2) AS min_value,
            round(max(sp.value)::numeric, 2) AS max_value
           FROM setpoint_plan sp
             JOIN plan_pairs pp_1 ON sp.plan_id = pp_1.plan_id
          WHERE sp.parameter = ANY (ARRAY['temp_high'::text, 'temp_low'::text, 'vpd_high'::text, 'vpd_hysteresis'::text, 'd_cool_stage_2'::text, 'mister_engage_kpa'::text, 'mister_all_kpa'::text, 'mister_pulse_on_s'::text, 'mister_pulse_gap_s'::text, 'mister_vpd_weight'::text])
          GROUP BY sp.plan_id, sp.parameter
        ), prev_stats AS (
         SELECT sp.plan_id AS prev_plan_id,
            sp.parameter,
            count(*) AS waypoints,
            round(avg(sp.value)::numeric, 2) AS avg_value,
            round(min(sp.value)::numeric, 2) AS min_value,
            round(max(sp.value)::numeric, 2) AS max_value
           FROM setpoint_plan sp
             JOIN plan_pairs pp_1 ON sp.plan_id = pp_1.prev_plan_id
          WHERE sp.parameter = ANY (ARRAY['temp_high'::text, 'temp_low'::text, 'vpd_high'::text, 'vpd_hysteresis'::text, 'd_cool_stage_2'::text, 'mister_engage_kpa'::text, 'mister_all_kpa'::text, 'mister_pulse_on_s'::text, 'mister_pulse_gap_s'::text, 'mister_vpd_weight'::text])
          GROUP BY sp.plan_id, sp.parameter
        )
 SELECT pp.plan_id,
    pp.prev_plan_id,
    (pp.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS plan_created,
    COALESCE(c.parameter, p.parameter) AS parameter,
    COALESCE(c.waypoints, 0::bigint) AS cur_waypoints,
    COALESCE(p.waypoints, 0::bigint) AS prev_waypoints,
    c.avg_value AS cur_avg,
    p.avg_value AS prev_avg,
    round(COALESCE(c.avg_value, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(p.avg_value, 0::numeric), 2) AS delta_avg,
    c.min_value AS cur_min,
    c.max_value AS cur_max,
    p.min_value AS prev_min,
    p.max_value AS prev_max
   FROM plan_pairs pp
     LEFT JOIN cur_stats c ON pp.plan_id = c.plan_id
     LEFT JOIN prev_stats p ON pp.prev_plan_id = p.prev_plan_id AND COALESCE(c.parameter, p.parameter) = p.parameter
  WHERE pp.prev_plan_id IS NOT NULL AND (c.parameter IS NOT NULL OR p.parameter IS NOT NULL)
  ORDER BY pp.created_at DESC, (COALESCE(c.parameter, p.parameter));
v_plan_comparison.name: v_plan_comparison

v_plan_compliance.definition:
SELECT created_at AS planned_ts,
    plan_id,
    'plan_outcome'::text AS parameter,
    'plan_outcome'::text AS target_type,
    outcome_score,
    anchor_score,
    validated_at,
    outcome_score >= 6 AS plan_achieved,
    (outcome_score - 10)::numeric AS overshoot,
    round(outcome_score::numeric * 10.0, 1) AS accuracy_pct
   FROM plan_journal pj
  WHERE outcome_score IS NOT NULL;
v_plan_compliance.name: v_plan_compliance

v_plan_execution_intervals.definition:
WITH iris_plans AS (
         SELECT plan_journal.plan_id,
            plan_journal.created_at,
            plan_journal.trigger_id,
            plan_journal.planner_instance,
            plan_journal.greenhouse_id
           FROM plan_journal
          WHERE plan_journal.plan_id ~~ 'iris-%'::text
        ), ordered AS (
         SELECT iris_plans.plan_id,
            iris_plans.created_at,
            iris_plans.trigger_id,
            iris_plans.planner_instance,
            iris_plans.greenhouse_id,
            lead(iris_plans.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY iris_plans.greenhouse_id ORDER BY iris_plans.created_at) AS superseded_at
           FROM iris_plans
        )
 SELECT plan_id,
    greenhouse_id,
    created_at AS interval_start,
    COALESCE(superseded_at, now()) AS interval_end,
    trigger_id,
    planner_instance,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(superseded_at, now()) - created_at) / 3600.0 AS governed_hours,
    COALESCE(superseded_at, now()) - created_at AS governed_duration
   FROM ordered;
v_plan_execution_intervals.name: v_plan_execution_intervals

v_plan_guardrail_scorecard.definition:
SELECT pei.plan_id,
    count(sc.*)::integer AS guardrail_events,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE sc.status = 'held_by_guardrail'::text)::integer AS held_guardrail_events,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE sc.status = 'guardrailed'::text)::integer AS dispatched_guardrail_events,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE sc.reason = 'vpd_high_moisture_guardrail'::text)::integer AS vpd_high_guardrail_events,
        CASE
            WHEN count(sc.*) >= 20 OR count(*) FILTER (WHERE sc.status = 'held_by_guardrail'::text) >= 10 THEN 3
            WHEN count(sc.*) >= 8 OR count(*) FILTER (WHERE sc.status = 'held_by_guardrail'::text) >= 3 THEN 2
            WHEN count(sc.*) >= 3 OR count(*) FILTER (WHERE sc.status = 'held_by_guardrail'::text) >= 1 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END::smallint AS guardrail_penalty
   FROM v_plan_execution_intervals pei
     LEFT JOIN setpoint_clamps sc ON sc.greenhouse_id = pei.greenhouse_id AND sc.ts >= pei.interval_start AND sc.ts < pei.interval_end
  GROUP BY pei.plan_id;
v_plan_guardrail_scorecard.name: v_plan_guardrail_scorecard

v_plan_tactical_outcome_daily.definition:
SELECT sp.plan_id,
    (min(sp.created_at) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS plan_date,
    sp.parameter,
    count(*) AS waypoints,
    round(avg(sp.value)::numeric, 3) AS avg_value,
    round(min(sp.value)::numeric, 3) AS min_value,
    round(max(sp.value)::numeric, 3) AS max_value,
    ds.compliance_pct,
    ds.temp_compliance_pct,
    ds.vpd_compliance_pct,
    ds.stress_hours_heat,
    ds.stress_hours_vpd_high,
    ds.stress_hours_cold,
    ds.stress_hours_vpd_low,
    ds.water_used_gal,
    ds.mister_water_gal,
    ds.cost_total
   FROM setpoint_plan sp
     LEFT JOIN daily_summary ds ON ds.date = (sp.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date
  WHERE sp.parameter = ANY (ARRAY['d_cool_stage_2'::text, 'dwell_gate_ms'::text, 'enthalpy_close'::text, 'enthalpy_open'::text, 'fog_escalation_kpa'::text, 'heat_hysteresis'::text, 'min_fog_off_s'::text, 'min_fog_on_s'::text, 'mist_backoff_s'::text, 'mist_max_closed_vent_s'::text, 'mist_thermal_relief_s'::text, 'mister_all_delay_s'::text, 'mister_all_kpa'::text, 'mister_engage_delay_s'::text, 'mister_engage_kpa'::text, 'mister_pulse_gap_s'::text, 'mister_pulse_on_s'::text, 'mister_vpd_weight'::text, 'mister_water_budget_gal'::text, 'outdoor_staleness_max_s'::text, 'sw_dwell_gate_enabled'::text, 'sw_fog_closes_vent'::text, 'sw_mister_closes_vent'::text, 'sw_summer_vent_enabled'::text, 'temp_hysteresis'::text, 'vent_prefer_dp_delta_f'::text, 'vent_prefer_temp_delta_f'::text, 'vpd_hysteresis'::text, 'vpd_watch_dwell_s'::text])
  GROUP BY sp.plan_id, sp.parameter, ds.date, ds.compliance_pct, ds.temp_compliance_pct, ds.vpd_compliance_pct, ds.stress_hours_heat, ds.stress_hours_vpd_high, ds.stress_hours_cold, ds.stress_hours_vpd_low, ds.water_used_gal, ds.mister_water_gal, ds.cost_total;
v_plan_tactical_outcome_daily.name: v_plan_tactical_outcome_daily

v_plan_transition_audit_36h.definition:
SELECT plan_id,
    plan_created_at,
    transition_ts,
    parameter,
    planned_value,
    prior_value,
    applied_value,
    readback_value,
    status,
    guardrail_reason,
    push_ts,
    push_latency_s,
    confirmed_at,
    confirm_latency_s,
    matching_push_ts,
    readback_ts,
    trigger_id,
    planner_instance
   FROM fn_plan_transition_audit(NULL::text, '36:00:00'::interval, '00:10:00'::interval) fn_plan_transition_audit(plan_id, plan_created_at, transition_ts, parameter, planned_value, prior_value, applied_value, readback_value, status, guardrail_reason, push_ts, push_latency_s, confirmed_at, confirm_latency_s, matching_push_ts, readback_ts, trigger_id, planner_instance);
v_plan_transition_audit_36h.name: v_plan_transition_audit_36h

v_plan_window_scorecard.definition:
WITH plan_days AS (
         SELECT pei.plan_id,
            d.d::date AS day,
            GREATEST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(pei.interval_end, d.d + '1 day'::interval) - GREATEST(pei.interval_start, d.d)) / 86400.0, 0::numeric) AS day_weight
           FROM v_plan_execution_intervals pei
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(pei.interval_start::date::timestamp with time zone, LEAST(pei.interval_end::date, CURRENT_DATE)::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval) d(d)
        )
 SELECT pd.plan_id,
    sum(pd.day_weight) AS governed_day_fraction,
    sum(pd.day_weight::double precision * COALESCE(vpp.heat_stress_h, 0::double precision)) AS heat_stress_h,
    sum(pd.day_weight::double precision * COALESCE(vpp.cold_stress_h, 0::double precision)) AS cold_stress_h,
    sum(pd.day_weight::double precision * COALESCE(vpp.vpd_high_stress_h, 0::double precision)) AS vpd_high_stress_h,
    sum(pd.day_weight::double precision * COALESCE(vpp.vpd_low_stress_h, 0::double precision)) AS vpd_low_stress_h,
    sum(pd.day_weight::double precision * COALESCE(vpp.total_stress_h, 0::double precision)) AS total_stress_h,
        CASE
            WHEN sum(pd.day_weight) > 0::numeric THEN sum(pd.day_weight * COALESCE(vpp.compliance_pct, 0::numeric)) / sum(pd.day_weight)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS compliance_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN sum(pd.day_weight) > 0::numeric THEN sum(pd.day_weight * COALESCE(vpp.temp_compliance_pct, 0::numeric)) / sum(pd.day_weight)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS temp_compliance_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN sum(pd.day_weight) > 0::numeric THEN sum(pd.day_weight * COALESCE(vpp.vpd_compliance_pct, 0::numeric)) / sum(pd.day_weight)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS vpd_compliance_pct,
    sum(pd.day_weight::double precision * COALESCE(vpp.cost_total, 0::double precision)) AS cost_total,
        CASE
            WHEN sum(pd.day_weight) > 0::numeric THEN sum(pd.day_weight * COALESCE(vpp.planner_score, 0::numeric)) / sum(pd.day_weight)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS planner_score
   FROM plan_days pd
     LEFT JOIN v_planner_performance vpp ON vpp.date = pd.day
  GROUP BY pd.plan_id;
v_plan_window_scorecard.name: v_plan_window_scorecard

v_planner_performance.definition:
WITH daily AS (
         SELECT d.date,
            d.cycles_fan1,
            d.cycles_fan2,
            d.cycles_heat1,
            d.cycles_heat2,
            d.cycles_fog,
            d.cycles_vent,
            d.cycles_dehum,
            d.cycles_safety_dehum,
            d.runtime_fan1_min,
            d.runtime_fan2_min,
            d.runtime_heat1_min,
            d.runtime_heat2_min,
            d.runtime_fog_min,
            d.runtime_vent_min,
            d.runtime_mister_south_h,
            d.runtime_mister_west_h,
            d.runtime_mister_center_h,
            d.water_used_gal,
            d.mister_water_gal,
            d.dli_final,
            d.captured_at,
            d.kwh_total,
            d.kwh_heat,
            d.kwh_fans,
            d.kwh_other,
            d.peak_kw,
            d.gas_used_therms,
            d.runtime_grow_light_min,
            d.cycles_grow_light,
            d.runtime_drip_wall_h,
            d.runtime_drip_center_h,
            d.kwh_estimated,
            d.therms_estimated,
            d.cost_electric,
            d.cost_gas,
            d.cost_water,
            d.cost_total,
            d.temp_min,
            d.temp_max,
            d.temp_avg,
            d.rh_min,
            d.rh_max,
            d.rh_avg,
            d.vpd_min,
            d.vpd_max,
            d.vpd_avg,
            d.co2_avg,
            d.outdoor_temp_min,
            d.outdoor_temp_max,
            d.stress_hours_heat,
            d.stress_hours_cold,
            d.stress_hours_vpd_high,
            d.stress_hours_vpd_low,
            d.notes,
            d.greenhouse_id,
            d.min_dp_margin_f,
            d.dp_risk_hours,
            d.compliance_pct,
            d.temp_compliance_pct,
            d.vpd_compliance_pct,
            d.mister_fairness_overrides_today,
            d.cycles_mister_south,
            d.cycles_mister_west,
            d.cycles_mister_center,
            d.cycles_drip_wall,
            d.cycles_drip_center,
            d.runtime_drip_wall_fert_h,
            d.runtime_drip_center_fert_h,
            d.runtime_mister_south_fert_h,
            d.runtime_mister_west_fert_h,
            d.runtime_fert_master_h,
            d.runtime_irrigation_clean_h,
            d.runtime_irrigation_fert_h,
            d.runtime_irrigation_total_h,
            d.cycles_drip_wall_fert,
            d.cycles_drip_center_fert,
            d.cycles_mister_south_fert,
            d.cycles_mister_west_fert,
            d.cycles_fert_master,
            d.irrigation_water_gal,
            d.fertigation_water_gal,
            d.compliance_v2_raw_pct,
            d.compliance_v2_attributable_pct,
            d.compliance_v2_unachievable_frac,
            d.graded_temp_compliance_pct,
            d.graded_vpd_compliance_pct,
            d.graded_stress_hours_heat,
            d.graded_stress_hours_cold,
            d.graded_stress_hours_vpd_high,
            d.graded_stress_hours_vpd_low,
            d.feasibility_unknown_min,
            d.dev_temp_norm_median_day,
            d.dev_temp_norm_median_night,
            d.dev_temp_norm_p95,
            d.dev_vpd_norm_median_day,
            d.dev_vpd_norm_median_night,
            d.dev_vpd_norm_p95,
            d.runtime_grow_light_main_min,
            d.runtime_grow_light_grow_min,
            COALESCE(w.available_for_scoring, false) AS water_ok,
            COALESCE(e.available_for_scoring, false) AS energy_ok
           FROM daily_summary d
             LEFT JOIN v_water_attribution_daily w ON w.date = d.date AND w.greenhouse_id = d.greenhouse_id
             LEFT JOIN v_runtime_energy_daily e ON e.date = d.date AND e.greenhouse_id = d.greenhouse_id
          WHERE d.date IS NOT NULL
        ), scored AS (
         SELECT d.date,
            d.stress_hours_heat AS heat_stress_h,
            d.stress_hours_cold AS cold_stress_h,
            d.stress_hours_vpd_high AS vpd_high_stress_h,
            d.stress_hours_vpd_low AS vpd_low_stress_h,
            COALESCE(d.compliance_v2_attributable_pct, d.compliance_pct, 0::double precision) AS score_compliance,
            d.compliance_pct,
            d.temp_compliance_pct,
            d.vpd_compliance_pct,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.water_ok AND d.energy_ok THEN d.cost_total
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS cost_total,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.energy_ok THEN d.cost_electric
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS cost_electric,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.water_ok AND d.energy_ok AND d.cost_total IS NOT NULL THEN d.cost_gas
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS cost_gas,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.water_ok THEN d.cost_water
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS cost_water,
            d.compliance_pct AS compliance_binary_pct,
            d.compliance_v2_raw_pct AS compliance_raw_graded_pct,
            d.compliance_v2_unachievable_frac AS unachievable_frac,
            d.water_ok AND d.energy_ok AND d.cost_total IS NOT NULL AS resource_ok
           FROM daily d
        )
 SELECT date,
    heat_stress_h,
    cold_stress_h,
    vpd_high_stress_h,
    vpd_low_stress_h,
    heat_stress_h + cold_stress_h + vpd_high_stress_h + vpd_low_stress_h AS total_stress_h,
    round(compliance_pct::numeric, 1) AS compliance_pct,
    round(temp_compliance_pct::numeric, 1) AS temp_compliance_pct,
    round(vpd_compliance_pct::numeric, 1) AS vpd_compliance_pct,
    cost_total,
    cost_electric,
    cost_gas,
    cost_water,
        CASE
            WHEN (heat_stress_h + cold_stress_h + vpd_high_stress_h + vpd_low_stress_h) > 0::double precision AND cost_total IS NOT NULL THEN round((cost_total / (heat_stress_h + cold_stress_h + vpd_high_stress_h + vpd_low_stress_h))::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cost_per_stress_hour,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN resource_ok THEN score_compliance / 100.0::double precision * 80::double precision + GREATEST(0::double precision, 1.0::double precision - LEAST(cost_total / 15.0::double precision, 1.0::double precision)) * 20::double precision
            ELSE score_compliance
        END::numeric, 1) AS planner_score,
    round(compliance_binary_pct::numeric, 1) AS compliance_binary_pct,
    round(compliance_raw_graded_pct::numeric, 1) AS compliance_raw_graded_pct,
    round(unachievable_frac::numeric, 4) AS unachievable_frac,
        CASE
            WHEN resource_ok THEN 20::numeric
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS planner_score_resource_weight_pct,
    resource_ok AS resource_terms_available
   FROM scored;
v_planner_performance.name: v_planner_performance

v_planner_trigger_health.definition:
WITH recent AS (
         SELECT planner_trigger_ledger.id,
            planner_trigger_ledger.greenhouse_id,
            planner_trigger_ledger.event_type,
            planner_trigger_ledger.event_label,
            planner_trigger_ledger.instance,
            planner_trigger_ledger.expected_at,
            planner_trigger_ledger.due_at,
            planner_trigger_ledger.delivered_at,
            planner_trigger_ledger.resolved_at,
            planner_trigger_ledger.status,
            planner_trigger_ledger.expected_action,
            planner_trigger_ledger.sla_seconds,
            planner_trigger_ledger.catchup,
            planner_trigger_ledger.plan_delivery_log_id,
            planner_trigger_ledger.trigger_id,
            planner_trigger_ledger.resulting_plan_id,
            planner_trigger_ledger.notes,
            planner_trigger_ledger.created_at,
            planner_trigger_ledger.updated_at,
            planner_trigger_ledger.terminal_action,
            planner_trigger_ledger.terminal_at,
            planner_trigger_ledger.failure_class,
            planner_trigger_ledger.had_required_failure
           FROM planner_trigger_ledger
          WHERE planner_trigger_ledger.expected_at >= (now() - '36:00:00'::interval)
        ), latest_required AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (recent.event_type) recent.event_type,
            recent.event_label,
            recent.instance,
            recent.expected_at,
            recent.due_at,
            recent.delivered_at,
            recent.resolved_at,
            recent.status,
            recent.resulting_plan_id,
            recent.trigger_id
           FROM recent
          WHERE recent.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['SUNRISE'::text, 'SUNSET'::text, 'MIDNIGHT'::text])
          ORDER BY recent.event_type, recent.expected_at DESC
        ), last_required_recovery AS (
         SELECT max(recent.expected_at) AS expected_at
           FROM recent
          WHERE (recent.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['SUNRISE'::text, 'SUNSET'::text, 'MIDNIGHT'::text])) AND recent.expected_action = 'set_plan'::text AND recent.status = 'plan_written'::text AND recent.terminal_action = 'set_plan'::text
        ), unrecovered_required_failures AS (
         SELECT required.id,
            required.greenhouse_id,
            required.event_type,
            required.event_label,
            required.instance,
            required.expected_at,
            required.due_at,
            required.delivered_at,
            required.resolved_at,
            required.status,
            required.expected_action,
            required.sla_seconds,
            required.catchup,
            required.plan_delivery_log_id,
            required.trigger_id,
            required.resulting_plan_id,
            required.notes,
            required.created_at,
            required.updated_at,
            required.terminal_action,
            required.terminal_at,
            required.failure_class,
            required.had_required_failure
           FROM recent required
             CROSS JOIN last_required_recovery recovery
          WHERE (required.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['SUNRISE'::text, 'SUNSET'::text, 'MIDNIGHT'::text])) AND (required.had_required_failure OR required.expected_action = 'set_plan'::text AND (required.status = ANY (ARRAY['missed'::text, 'timed_out'::text, 'delivery_failed'::text, 'wrong_action'::text, 'neutral_fallback'::text, 'acked'::text, 'action_completed'::text]))) AND (recovery.expected_at IS NULL OR required.expected_at > recovery.expected_at)
        )
 SELECT now() AS generated_at,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM recent
          WHERE recent.status = 'expected'::text AND recent.due_at < now()))::integer AS missed_expected_count,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM recent
          WHERE recent.status = 'delivered'::text AND recent.due_at < now()))::integer AS overdue_delivered_count,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM unrecovered_required_failures))::integer AS required_failure_count,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM recent
          WHERE recent.status = ANY (ARRAY['plan_written'::text, 'acked'::text])))::integer AS resolved_count,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM recent))::integer AS recent_expected_count,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(latest_required.*) ORDER BY latest_required.expected_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM latest_required), '[]'::jsonb) AS latest_required;
v_planner_trigger_health.name: v_planner_trigger_health

v_policy_twin_asof_input.definition:
WITH ranked_climate AS (
         SELECT c0.ts,
            c0.temp_avg,
            c0.temp_north,
            c0.temp_south,
            c0.temp_east,
            c0.temp_west,
            c0.temp_case,
            c0.temp_control,
            c0.temp_intake,
            c0.rh_avg,
            c0.rh_north,
            c0.rh_south,
            c0.rh_east,
            c0.rh_west,
            c0.rh_case,
            c0.vpd_avg,
            c0.vpd_north,
            c0.vpd_south,
            c0.vpd_east,
            c0.vpd_west,
            c0.vpd_control,
            c0.dew_point,
            c0.abs_humidity,
            c0.enthalpy_delta,
            c0.co2_ppm,
            c0.lux,
            c0.dli_today,
            c0.flow_gpm,
            c0.water_total_gal,
            c0.mister_water_today,
            c0.outdoor_temp_f,
            c0.outdoor_rh_pct,
            c0.ph_input,
            c0.ec_input,
            c0.ph_runoff_wall,
            c0.ec_runoff_wall,
            c0.ph_runoff_center,
            c0.ec_runoff_center,
            c0.moisture_north,
            c0.moisture_south,
            c0.moisture_center,
            c0.ppfd,
            c0.dli_par_today,
            c0.pressure_hpa,
            c0.leaf_temp_north,
            c0.leaf_temp_south,
            c0.leaf_wetness_north,
            c0.leaf_wetness_south,
            c0.wind_speed_mph,
            c0.wind_direction_deg,
            c0.outdoor_lux,
            c0.solar_irradiance_w_m2,
            c0.precip_in,
            c0.uv_index,
            c0.hydro_tds_ppm,
            c0.hydro_water_temp_f,
            c0.wind_gust_mph,
            c0.wind_lull_mph,
            c0.wind_speed_avg_mph,
            c0.wind_direction_avg_deg,
            c0.feels_like_f,
            c0.wet_bulb_temp_f,
            c0.vapor_pressure_inhg,
            c0.air_density_kg_m3,
            c0.precip_intensity_in_h,
            c0.lightning_count,
            c0.lightning_avg_dist_mi,
            c0.solar_altitude_deg,
            c0.solar_azimuth_deg,
            c0.hydro_ec_us_cm,
            c0.hydro_orp_mv,
            c0.hydro_ph,
            c0.hydro_battery_pct,
            c0.soil_moisture_south_1,
            c0.soil_temp_south_1,
            c0.soil_ec_south_1,
            c0.soil_moisture_south_2,
            c0.soil_temp_south_2,
            c0.soil_moisture_west,
            c0.soil_temp_west,
            c0.intake_rh,
            c0.intake_vpd,
            c0.outdoor_illuminance,
            c0.greenhouse_id,
            c0.solar_phase,
            c0.solar_sunrise_min,
            c0.solar_noon_min,
            c0.solar_sunset_min,
            c0.house_temp_target_f,
            c0.house_temp_delta_f,
            c0.house_vpd_target,
            c0.house_vpd_delta,
            c0.vpd_target_center,
            c0.vpd_target_south,
            c0.vpd_target_west,
            c0.vpd_target_east,
            c0.vpd_delta_center,
            c0.vpd_delta_south,
            c0.vpd_delta_west,
            c0.vpd_delta_east,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c0.greenhouse_id, c0.ts ORDER BY (c0.temp_avg IS NOT NULL AND c0.vpd_avg IS NOT NULL AND c0.rh_avg IS NOT NULL) DESC, (c0.outdoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL AND c0.outdoor_rh_pct IS NOT NULL) DESC, c0.temp_avg DESC NULLS LAST, c0.vpd_avg DESC NULLS LAST, c0.rh_avg DESC NULLS LAST) AS duplicate_rank
           FROM climate c0
        )
 SELECT c.greenhouse_id,
    c.ts,
    c.temp_avg,
    c.rh_avg,
    c.vpd_avg,
    c.dew_point AS indoor_dew_point,
    COALESCE(c.enthalpy_delta, '-5'::integer::double precision) AS enthalpy_delta,
    c.solar_irradiance_w_m2,
    c.outdoor_temp_f,
    COALESCE(c.outdoor_rh_pct, 30::double precision) AS outdoor_rh_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN c.outdoor_temp_f IS NULL OR c.outdoor_rh_pct IS NULL OR c.outdoor_rh_pct <= 0::double precision THEN NULL::double precision
            ELSE 243.04::double precision * (ln(c.outdoor_rh_pct / 100.0::double precision) + 17.625::double precision * ((c.outdoor_temp_f - 32.0::double precision) * 5.0::double precision / 9.0::double precision) / (243.04::double precision + (c.outdoor_temp_f - 32.0::double precision) * 5.0::double precision / 9.0::double precision)) / (17.625::double precision - (ln(c.outdoor_rh_pct / 100.0::double precision) + 17.625::double precision * ((c.outdoor_temp_f - 32.0::double precision) * 5.0::double precision / 9.0::double precision) / (243.04::double precision + (c.outdoor_temp_f - 32.0::double precision) * 5.0::double precision / 9.0::double precision))) * 9.0::double precision / 5.0::double precision + 32.0::double precision
        END AS outdoor_dewpoint_f,
    c.temp_avg IS NOT NULL AND c.rh_avg IS NOT NULL AND c.vpd_avg IS NOT NULL AS sensors_valid,
    od.outdoor_observation_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN c.outdoor_temp_f IS NULL OR c.outdoor_rh_pct IS NULL OR od.outdoor_observation_ts IS NULL THEN NULL::integer
            ELSE GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(epoch FROM c.ts - od.outdoor_observation_ts)::integer)
        END AS outdoor_data_age_s,
    occ.value = 'occupied'::text AS occupied,
    diag.ts AS diag_asof,
    diag.sntp_valid,
    diag.last_sntp_sync_age_s,
    diag.sntp_valid = 1 AS clock_valid,
    boot.boot_event_ts,
    boot.reset_reason,
    diag.uptime_s,
    diag.firmware_version,
    c.mister_water_today,
    c.flow_gpm,
    c.water_total_gal,
    diag.sealed_timer_s,
    diag.vpd_watch_timer_s,
    diag.mist_backoff_timer_s,
    diag.vent_latch_timer_s,
    diag.relief_cycle_count,
    diag.zone_wet_granted,
    diag.band_source,
    (eq.states ->> 'fog'::text)::boolean AS live_relay_fog,
    (eq.states ->> 'vent'::text)::boolean AS live_relay_vent,
    (eq.states ->> 'fan1'::text)::boolean AS live_relay_fan1,
    (eq.states ->> 'fan2'::text)::boolean AS live_relay_fan2,
    (eq.states ->> 'heat1'::text)::boolean AS live_relay_heat1,
    (eq.states ->> 'heat2'::text)::boolean AS live_relay_heat2,
    (eq.states ->> 'mister_south'::text)::boolean AS live_mister_south,
    (eq.states ->> 'mister_west'::text)::boolean AS live_mister_west,
    (eq.states ->> 'mister_center'::text)::boolean AS live_mister_center,
    eq.newest_transition AS relay_readback_asof,
    spb.ts AS sp_asof,
    spv.sp_payload,
    snap.snapshot_id,
    snap.device_id,
    snap.reported_at AS snapshot_reported_at,
    GREATEST(0::numeric, EXTRACT(epoch FROM c.ts - snap.reported_at))::bigint AS snapshot_age_s,
    snap.device_generation,
    snap.assignment_id,
    snap.content_sha256 AS observed_content_sha256,
    snap.activation_sha256 AS observed_activation_sha256,
    snap.validity AS observed_validity,
    snap.apply_state,
    snap.schema_revision,
    vec.vector_id,
    vec.content_sha256 AS vector_content_sha256,
    vec.activation_sha256 AS vector_activation_sha256,
    vec.canonical_bytes AS vector_canonical_bytes,
    vec.status AS vector_status,
    vec.validity AS vector_validity,
    snap.content_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND snap.content_sha256 = vec.content_sha256 AS policy_hash_match,
    (snap.validity IS NULL OR snap.validity @> c.ts) AND (vec.validity IS NULL OR vec.validity @> c.ts) AS validity_contains_tick,
    expo.exposure_id,
    expo.identity_confirmed AS exposure_identity_confirmed
   FROM ranked_climate c
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT w.ts AS outdoor_observation_ts
           FROM ( SELECT o.ts,
                    o.outdoor_temp_f,
                    o.outdoor_rh_pct,
                    lag(o.outdoor_temp_f) OVER (ORDER BY o.ts) AS prev_temp,
                    lag(o.outdoor_rh_pct) OVER (ORDER BY o.ts) AS prev_rh
                   FROM climate o
                  WHERE o.greenhouse_id = c.greenhouse_id AND o.ts <= c.ts AND o.ts >= (c.ts - '24:00:00'::interval)) w
          WHERE w.outdoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL AND w.outdoor_rh_pct IS NOT NULL AND (w.outdoor_temp_f IS DISTINCT FROM w.prev_temp OR w.outdoor_rh_pct IS DISTINCT FROM w.prev_rh)
          ORDER BY w.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) od ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.value
           FROM system_state s
          WHERE s.greenhouse_id = c.greenhouse_id AND s.entity = 'occupancy'::text AND s.ts <= c.ts
          ORDER BY s.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) occ ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d.ts,
            d.sntp_valid,
            d.last_sntp_sync_age_s,
            d.uptime_s,
            d.firmware_version,
            d.sealed_timer_s,
            d.vpd_watch_timer_s,
            d.mist_backoff_timer_s,
            d.vent_latch_timer_s,
            d.relief_cycle_count,
            d.zone_wet_granted,
            d.band_source
           FROM diagnostics d
          WHERE d.greenhouse_id = c.greenhouse_id AND d.ts <= c.ts AND d.ts >= (c.ts - '01:00:00'::interval)
          ORDER BY d.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) diag ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d.ts AS boot_event_ts,
            d.reset_reason
           FROM diagnostics d
          WHERE d.greenhouse_id = c.greenhouse_id AND d.ts <= c.ts AND d.ts >= (c.ts - '7 days'::interval) AND d.uptime_s < 300::double precision
          ORDER BY d.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) boot ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(e.equipment, e.state) AS states,
            max(e.ts) AS newest_transition
           FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (es.equipment) es.equipment,
                    es.state,
                    es.ts
                   FROM equipment_state es
                  WHERE es.greenhouse_id = c.greenhouse_id AND es.ts <= c.ts AND (es.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['fog'::text, 'vent'::text, 'fan1'::text, 'fan2'::text, 'heat1'::text, 'heat2'::text, 'mister_south'::text, 'mister_west'::text, 'mister_center'::text]))
                  ORDER BY es.equipment, es.ts DESC) e) eq ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ss.ts
           FROM setpoint_snapshot ss
          WHERE ss.greenhouse_id = c.greenhouse_id AND ss.parameter = 'temp_high'::text AND ss.ts <= c.ts
          ORDER BY ss.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) spb ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(ss.parameter, to_jsonb(ss.value)) AS sp_payload
           FROM setpoint_snapshot ss
          WHERE ss.greenhouse_id = c.greenhouse_id AND ss.ts = spb.ts) spv ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.snapshot_id,
            s.device_id,
            s.reported_at,
            s.device_generation,
            s.assignment_id,
            s.content_sha256,
            s.activation_sha256,
            s.validity,
            s.apply_state,
            s.schema_revision
           FROM policy_device_snapshots s
          WHERE (s.greenhouse_id = c.greenhouse_id OR s.greenhouse_id IS NULL) AND s.reported_at <= c.ts
          ORDER BY s.reported_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) snap ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT v.vector_id,
            v.content_sha256,
            v.activation_sha256,
            v.canonical_bytes,
            v.status,
            v.validity
           FROM effective_policy_vectors v
          WHERE snap.activation_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND v.activation_sha256 = snap.activation_sha256 OR snap.activation_sha256 IS NULL AND snap.device_generation IS NOT NULL AND v.greenhouse_id = c.greenhouse_id AND v.device_generation = snap.device_generation
          ORDER BY v.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) vec ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.exposure_id,
            x.identity_confirmed
           FROM policy_exposures x
          WHERE x.device_id = snap.device_id AND x.started_at <= c.ts AND (x.ended_at IS NULL OR x.ended_at >= c.ts)
          ORDER BY x.started_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) expo ON true
  WHERE c.duplicate_rank = 1;

v_relay_stuck.definition:
WITH latest_on AS (
         SELECT equipment_state.equipment,
            max(equipment_state.ts) AS last_on_ts
           FROM equipment_state
          WHERE equipment_state.state = true AND (equipment_state.equipment <> ALL (ARRAY['economiser_enabled'::text, 'economiser_blocked'::text, 'fog_closes_vent'::text, 'irrigation_enabled'::text, 'irrigation_wall_enabled'::text, 'irrigation_center_enabled'::text, 'irrigation_weather_skip'::text, 'sntp_status'::text, 'mister_budget_exceeded'::text, 'fan_burst_active'::text, 'fog_burst_active'::text, 'vent_bypass_active'::text, 'leak_detected'::text, 'water_flowing'::text, 'mister_any'::text, 'gl_auto_mode'::text, 'occupancy_inhibit'::text]))
          GROUP BY equipment_state.equipment
        ), latest_off AS (
         SELECT equipment_state.equipment,
            max(equipment_state.ts) AS last_off_ts
           FROM equipment_state
          WHERE equipment_state.state = false
          GROUP BY equipment_state.equipment
        ), stuck_check AS (
         SELECT lo.equipment,
            lo.last_on_ts,
            lf.last_off_ts,
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - lo.last_on_ts) / 3600.0 AS hours_on,
                CASE lo.equipment
                    WHEN 'heat1'::text THEN 3
                    WHEN 'heat2'::text THEN 3
                    WHEN 'fan1'::text THEN 4
                    WHEN 'fan2'::text THEN 4
                    WHEN 'fog'::text THEN 2
                    WHEN 'vent'::text THEN 6
                    ELSE 8
                END AS threshold_hours
           FROM latest_on lo
             LEFT JOIN latest_off lf ON lo.equipment = lf.equipment
          WHERE lo.last_on_ts > COALESCE(lf.last_off_ts, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)
        )
 SELECT equipment,
    last_on_ts,
    hours_on,
    threshold_hours,
    hours_on > threshold_hours::numeric AS is_stuck
   FROM stuck_check;
v_relay_stuck.name: v_relay_stuck

v_replay_outdoor_freshness.definition:
WITH ranked_outdoor AS (
         SELECT c.greenhouse_id,
            c.ts,
            c.outdoor_temp_f,
            c.outdoor_rh_pct,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.greenhouse_id, c.ts ORDER BY (c.outdoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL AND c.outdoor_rh_pct IS NOT NULL) DESC, c.outdoor_temp_f DESC NULLS LAST, c.outdoor_rh_pct DESC NULLS LAST) AS duplicate_rank
           FROM climate c
        ), outdoor_samples AS (
         SELECT ranked_outdoor.greenhouse_id,
            ranked_outdoor.ts,
            ranked_outdoor.outdoor_temp_f,
            ranked_outdoor.outdoor_rh_pct
           FROM ranked_outdoor
          WHERE ranked_outdoor.duplicate_rank = 1
        ), ordered AS (
         SELECT c.greenhouse_id,
            c.ts,
            c.outdoor_temp_f,
            c.outdoor_rh_pct,
            lag(c.outdoor_temp_f) OVER (PARTITION BY c.greenhouse_id ORDER BY c.ts) AS previous_outdoor_temp_f,
            lag(c.outdoor_rh_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY c.greenhouse_id ORDER BY c.ts) AS previous_outdoor_rh_pct
           FROM outdoor_samples c
        ), marked AS (
         SELECT o.greenhouse_id,
            o.ts,
            o.outdoor_temp_f,
            o.outdoor_rh_pct,
            o.previous_outdoor_temp_f,
            o.previous_outdoor_rh_pct,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.outdoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL AND o.outdoor_rh_pct IS NOT NULL AND (o.outdoor_temp_f IS DISTINCT FROM o.previous_outdoor_temp_f OR o.outdoor_rh_pct IS DISTINCT FROM o.previous_outdoor_rh_pct) THEN o.ts
                    ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
                END AS outdoor_observed_at
           FROM ordered o
        ), carried AS (
         SELECT m.greenhouse_id,
            m.ts,
            m.outdoor_temp_f,
            m.outdoor_rh_pct,
            m.previous_outdoor_temp_f,
            m.previous_outdoor_rh_pct,
            m.outdoor_observed_at,
            max(m.outdoor_observed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY m.greenhouse_id ORDER BY m.ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS outdoor_observation_ts
           FROM marked m
        )
 SELECT greenhouse_id,
    ts,
    outdoor_temp_f,
    outdoor_rh_pct,
    outdoor_observation_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN outdoor_temp_f IS NULL OR outdoor_rh_pct IS NULL OR outdoor_observation_ts IS NULL THEN NULL::integer
            ELSE GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(epoch FROM ts - outdoor_observation_ts)::integer)
        END AS outdoor_data_age_s,
    outdoor_observation_ts IS NOT NULL AS observation_backed,
        CASE
            WHEN outdoor_temp_f IS NULL OR outdoor_rh_pct IS NULL OR outdoor_observation_ts IS NULL THEN false
            ELSE EXTRACT(epoch FROM ts - outdoor_observation_ts) < 600::numeric
        END AS outdoor_fresh,
    'conservative_change_observation'::text AS freshness_basis,
        CASE
            WHEN outdoor_temp_f IS NULL OR outdoor_rh_pct IS NULL THEN 'missing'::text
            WHEN outdoor_temp_f < 50::double precision AND outdoor_rh_pct >= 50::double precision THEN 'cold_wet'::text
            WHEN outdoor_temp_f < 50::double precision THEN 'cold_dry'::text
            WHEN outdoor_rh_pct >= 50::double precision THEN 'warm_wet'::text
            ELSE 'warm_dry'::text
        END AS outdoor_regime
   FROM carried;
v_replay_outdoor_freshness.name: v_replay_outdoor_freshness

v_required_sensor_coverage.definition:
SELECT cfg.greenhouse_id,
    cfg.target_table,
    cfg.target_column,
    cfg.entity_name,
    cfg.entity_type,
    cfg.is_required,
    sr.sensor_id,
    COALESCE(sr.active, false) AS registry_active,
    vs.last_seen_at,
    vs.seconds_since,
    COALESCE(vs.is_stale, true) AS is_stale,
        CASE
            WHEN sr.sensor_id IS NULL THEN 'missing_registry'::text
            WHEN sr.active IS NOT TRUE THEN 'inactive_registry'::text
            WHEN vs.is_stale THEN 'stale'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS coverage_status
   FROM greenhouse_sensor_config cfg
     LEFT JOIN sensor_registry sr ON sr.source_table = cfg.target_table AND sr.source_column = cfg.target_column
     LEFT JOIN v_sensor_staleness vs ON vs.sensor_id = sr.sensor_id
  WHERE cfg.is_required = true;
v_required_sensor_coverage.name: v_required_sensor_coverage

v_resource_accounting_health.definition:
WITH energy_meter_health AS (
         WITH intervals AS (
                 WITH checked AS (
                         SELECT e.ts,
                            e.greenhouse_id,
                            e.watts_total,
                            e.ch0_source_ts,
                            e.ch1_source_ts,
                            COALESCE(e.measurement_revision = 'ha_shelly_power_v1'::text AND e.ch0_quality = 'ok'::text AND e.ch1_quality = 'ok'::text AND e.ch0_entity_id = 'sensor.shellyproem50_ac15186daafc_energy_meter_0_power'::text AND e.ch1_entity_id = 'sensor.shellyproem50_ac15186daafc_energy_meter_1_power'::text AND e.ch0_source_ts <= e.ts AND e.ch1_source_ts <= e.ts AND e.ch0_source_ts > (e.ts - '00:05:00'::interval) AND e.ch1_source_ts > (e.ts - '00:05:00'::interval) AND e.watts_total > '-Infinity'::double precision AND e.watts_total < 'Infinity'::double precision AND e.ch0_power_w > '-Infinity'::double precision AND e.ch0_power_w < 'Infinity'::double precision AND e.ch1_power_w > '-Infinity'::double precision AND e.ch1_power_w < 'Infinity'::double precision AND abs(e.watts_total::numeric - e.ch0_power_w::numeric - e.ch1_power_w::numeric) <= (GREATEST(abs(e.watts_total::numeric), abs(e.ch0_power_w::numeric), abs(e.ch1_power_w::numeric), 1::numeric) * 0.00000000000001), false) AS qualified
                           FROM energy e
                          WHERE isfinite(e.ts)
                        ), grouped AS (
                         SELECT COALESCE(checked.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) AS greenhouse_id,
                            checked.ts,
                            count(*) = 1 AND bool_and(checked.qualified) AS qualified,
                            min(checked.watts_total) AS watts_total,
                            min(LEAST(checked.ch0_source_ts, checked.ch1_source_ts)) AS source_through_ts
                           FROM checked
                          GROUP BY (COALESCE(checked.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)), checked.ts
                        ), sequenced AS (
                         SELECT grouped.greenhouse_id,
                            grouped.ts,
                            grouped.qualified,
                            grouped.watts_total,
                            grouped.source_through_ts,
                            lead(grouped.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY grouped.greenhouse_id ORDER BY grouped.ts) AS next_ts
                           FROM grouped
                        )
                 SELECT sequenced.greenhouse_id,
                    sequenced.ts,
                    sequenced.qualified,
                    sequenced.watts_total,
                    sequenced.source_through_ts,
                        CASE
                            WHEN sequenced.qualified THEN GREATEST(sequenced.ts, LEAST(COALESCE(sequenced.next_ts, sequenced.ts), sequenced.ts + '00:05:00'::interval, sequenced.source_through_ts + '00:05:00'::interval))
                            ELSE sequenced.ts
                        END AS end_ts
                   FROM sequenced
                ), latest AS (
                 SELECT intervals.greenhouse_id,
                    max(intervals.source_through_ts) AS latest_ts,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE intervals.source_through_ts >= (now() - '00:10:00'::interval) AND intervals.source_through_ts <= now()) AS recent_sample_count
                   FROM intervals
                  WHERE intervals.qualified
                  GROUP BY intervals.greenhouse_id
                )
         SELECT h.id AS greenhouse_id,
            l.latest_ts,
            round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - l.latest_ts), 1) AS sample_age_seconds,
            COALESCE(l.recent_sample_count, 0::bigint) AS recent_sample_count,
                CASE
                    WHEN l.latest_ts IS NULL THEN 'unavailable'::text
                    WHEN l.latest_ts < (now() - '00:10:00'::interval) THEN 'stale'::text
                    WHEN l.latest_ts > now() THEN 'unavailable'::text
                    ELSE 'fresh'::text
                END AS meter_status,
            COALESCE(l.latest_ts >= (now() - '00:10:00'::interval) AND l.latest_ts <= now(), false) AS fresh_for_observation,
            'partial_shelly_two_channels'::text AS measured_scope
           FROM greenhouses h
             LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.greenhouse_id = h.id
        )
 SELECT 'water_ledger'::text AS resource,
    h.greenhouse_id,
    h.ledger_status AS quality,
    h.available_for_scoring,
    h.materialized_through_ts AS observed_through,
    jsonb_build_object('raw_latest_ts', h.raw_latest_ts, 'raw_age_seconds', h.raw_age_seconds, 'materializer_lag_seconds', h.materializer_lag_seconds, 'latest_gap_ts', h.latest_gap_ts, 'latest_discontinuity_ts', h.latest_discontinuity_ts) AS detail
   FROM v_water_ledger_health h
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'energy_runtime_model'::text AS resource,
    e.greenhouse_id,
    e.model_quality AS quality,
    e.available_for_scoring,
    ((e.date + 1)::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS observed_through,
    jsonb_build_object('modeled_kwh', e.modeled_kwh, 'modeled_kwh_low', e.modeled_kwh_low, 'modeled_kwh_high', e.modeled_kwh_high, 'runtime_coverage_pct', e.runtime_coverage_pct, 'scope', e.modeled_scope, 'coefficient_revisions', e.coefficient_revisions, 'runtime_evidence', e.runtime_evidence) AS detail
   FROM v_runtime_energy_daily e
  WHERE e.date = ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date - 1)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'energy_partial_meter'::text AS resource,
    h.greenhouse_id,
        CASE
            WHEN h.meter_status <> 'fresh'::text THEN h.meter_status
            ELSE COALESCE(e.measured_quality, 'unavailable'::text)
        END AS quality,
    h.meter_status = 'fresh'::text AND COALESCE(e.available_for_scoring, false) AS available_for_scoring,
    h.latest_ts AS observed_through,
    jsonb_build_object('measured_kwh', e.measured_kwh, 'meter_coverage_pct', e.meter_coverage_pct, 'scope', h.measured_scope, 'sample_count', e.sample_count, 'current_meter_status', h.meter_status, 'sample_age_seconds', h.sample_age_seconds, 'recent_sample_count', h.recent_sample_count, 'completed_day_quality', e.measured_quality) AS detail
   FROM energy_meter_health h
     LEFT JOIN v_energy_daily e ON e.greenhouse_id = h.greenhouse_id AND e.date = ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date - 1);
v_resource_accounting_health.name: v_resource_accounting_health

WITH runtime AS (
         SELECT ds.date,

            rt.is_complete_day,
            rt.start_state_known,
            rt.is_deploy_gate_eligible AS runtime_evidence_eligible,
            rt.quality AS runtime_quality
           FROM daily_summary ds
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES ('heat1'::text), ('fan1'::text), ('fan2'::text), ('fog'::text), ('vent'::text), ('grow_light_main'::text), ('grow_light_grow'::text)) v(equipment)
             LEFT JOIN mv_equipment_runtime_daily rt ON rt.day = ds.date AND rt.greenhouse_id = ds.greenhouse_id AND rt.equipment = v.equipment
        ), evidence AS (
         SELECT r_1.date,
            r_1.greenhouse_id,
            r_1.equipment,
            r_1.on_minutes,
            r_1.is_complete_day,
            r_1.start_state_known,
            r_1.runtime_evidence_eligible,
            r_1.runtime_quality,
            c.nominal_value AS coefficient_nominal,
            c.lower_bound AS coefficient_low,
            c.upper_bound AS coefficient_high,
            c.coefficient_source,
            c.revision AS coefficient_revision,
            c.evidence_ref,
            c.unit,
            c.lower_bound <> c.upper_bound AS has_uncertainty
           FROM runtime r_1
             LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.greenhouse_id = r_1.greenhouse_id AND e.slug = r_1.equipment AND e.is_active
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT rc.id,
                    rc.equipment_id,
                    rc.resource_kind,
                    rc.unit,
                    rc.nominal_value,
                    rc.lower_bound,
                    rc.upper_bound,
                    rc.coefficient_source,
                    rc.revision,
                    rc.evidence_ref,
                    rc.valid_from,
                    rc.valid_to,
                    rc.is_model_default,
                    rc.notes,
                    rc.created_at
                   FROM resource_coefficients rc
                  WHERE rc.equipment_id = e.id AND rc.resource_kind = 'electric_watts'::text AND rc.valid_from <= (r_1.date::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AND (rc.valid_to IS NULL OR rc.valid_to > (r_1.date::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text))
                  ORDER BY rc.valid_from DESC, rc.id DESC
                 LIMIT 1) c ON true
        )
 SELECT date,
    greenhouse_id,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_or(on_minutes IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(runtime_evidence_eligible, false) OR coefficient_nominal IS NULL) THEN NULL::double precision
            ELSE round(sum(on_minutes / 60.0::double precision * coefficient_nominal / 1000.0::double precision)::numeric, 3)::double precision
        END AS modeled_kwh,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_or(on_minutes IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(runtime_evidence_eligible, false) OR coefficient_low IS NULL) THEN NULL::double precision
            ELSE round(sum(on_minutes / 60.0::double precision * coefficient_low / 1000.0::double precision)::numeric, 3)::double precision
        END AS modeled_kwh_low,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_or(on_minutes IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(runtime_evidence_eligible, false) OR coefficient_high IS NULL) THEN NULL::double precision
            ELSE round(sum(on_minutes / 60.0::double precision * coefficient_high / 1000.0::double precision)::numeric, 3)::double precision
        END AS modeled_kwh_high,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_minutes IS NOT NULL AND coefficient_nominal IS NOT NULL AND runtime_evidence_eligible)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 1)::double precision AS runtime_coverage_pct,
    jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('equipment', equipment, 'revision', coefficient_revision, 'source', coefficient_source, 'low', coefficient_low, 'nominal', coefficient_nominal, 'high', coefficient_high, 'unit', unit, 'evidence_ref', evidence_ref)) FILTER (WHERE coefficient_nominal IS NOT NULL) AS coefficient_revisions,
    'whole_controlled_equipment_runtime'::text AS modeled_scope,
        CASE
            WHEN date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date THEN 'incomplete_runtime'::text
            WHEN bool_or(coefficient_nominal IS NULL) THEN 'missing_coefficients'::text
            WHEN bool_or(on_minutes IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(runtime_evidence_eligible, false)) THEN 'incomplete_runtime_evidence'::text
            WHEN bool_or(has_uncertainty) THEN 'uncertain_coefficients'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS model_quality,
    date < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AND bool_and(on_minutes IS NOT NULL) AND bool_and(COALESCE(runtime_evidence_eligible, false)) AND bool_and(coefficient_nominal IS NOT NULL) AND NOT bool_or(COALESCE(has_uncertainty, true)) AS available_for_scoring,
    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('equipment', equipment, 'quality', COALESCE(runtime_quality, 'missing'::text), 'complete_day', COALESCE(is_complete_day, false), 'start_state_known', COALESCE(start_state_known, false), 'eligible', COALESCE(runtime_evidence_eligible, false)) ORDER BY equipment) AS runtime_evidence
   FROM evidence r
  GROUP BY date, greenhouse_id;
v_runtime_energy_daily.name: v_runtime_energy_daily

v_sensor_staleness.definition:
WITH last_readings AS (
         SELECT sr.sensor_id,
            sr.type,
            sr.zone,
            sr.expected_interval_s,
            sr.source_table,
            sr.source_column,
                CASE sr.source_table
                    WHEN 'climate'::text THEN ( SELECT max(c.ts) AS max
                       FROM climate c
                      WHERE c.ts > (now() - GREATEST('02:00:00'::interval, sr.expected_interval_s::double precision * '00:00:02'::interval)) AND (to_jsonb(c.*) ->> sr.source_column) IS NOT NULL)
                    WHEN 'equipment_state'::text THEN ( SELECT max(es.ts) AS max
                       FROM equipment_state es
                      WHERE es.equipment = sr.source_column)
                    WHEN 'system_state'::text THEN ( SELECT max(ss.ts) AS max
                       FROM system_state ss
                      WHERE ss.entity = sr.source_column)
                    WHEN 'diagnostics'::text THEN ( SELECT max(d.ts) AS max
                       FROM diagnostics d
                      WHERE d.ts > (now() - '02:00:00'::interval))
                    ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
                END AS last_seen_at
           FROM sensor_registry sr
          WHERE sr.active = true
        )
 SELECT sensor_id,
    type,
    zone,
    expected_interval_s,
    last_seen_at,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - last_seen_at)::integer AS seconds_since,
        CASE
            WHEN last_seen_at IS NULL THEN true
            WHEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - last_seen_at) > (expected_interval_s * 2)::numeric THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS is_stale,
        CASE
            WHEN last_seen_at IS NULL THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - last_seen_at) / NULLIF(expected_interval_s, 0)::numeric, 1)
        END AS staleness_ratio
   FROM last_readings;
v_sensor_staleness.name: v_sensor_staleness

    percentile_disc(0.95::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (EXTRACT(epoch FROM confirmed_at - ts))) FILTER (WHERE confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS p95_confirm_s,

v_setpoint_effective_drift_7d.definition:
WITH ranked AS (
         SELECT c.ts,
            c.parameter,
            c.requested,
            c.applied,
            c.band_lo,
            c.band_hi,
            c.reason,
            c.greenhouse_id,
            c.status,
            c.plan_id,
            c.plan_ts,
            c.trigger_id,
            c.planner_instance,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.greenhouse_id, c.parameter ORDER BY c.ts DESC) AS rn
           FROM setpoint_clamps c
          WHERE c.ts > (now() - '7 days'::interval)
        )
 SELECT greenhouse_id,
    parameter,
    count(*) AS drift_events,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'guardrailed'::text) AS guardrailed_events,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'held_by_guardrail'::text) AS held_events,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'rejected'::text) AS rejected_events,
    round(avg(abs(requested - applied))::numeric, 3) AS avg_abs_delta,
    round(max(abs(requested - applied))::numeric, 3) AS max_abs_delta,
    min(ts) AS first_seen,
    max(ts) AS last_seen,
    max(requested) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS latest_requested,
    max(applied) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS latest_effective,
    max(reason) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS latest_reason,
    max(status) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS latest_status,
    max(plan_id) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS latest_plan_id
   FROM ranked
  GROUP BY greenhouse_id, parameter
  ORDER BY (count(*)) DESC, parameter;
v_setpoint_effective_drift_7d.name: v_setpoint_effective_drift_7d

UNION ALL
 SELECT v_active_plan.parameter,
    COALESCE(( SELECT max(weather_forecast.ts) AS max
           FROM weather_forecast
          WHERE weather_forecast.fetched_at > (now() - '12:00:00'::interval)), now() + '16 days'::interval) AS ts,
    v_active_plan.value,

   FROM v_active_plan
  WHERE v_active_plan.parameter = ANY (ARRAY['temp_high'::text, 'temp_low'::text, 'vpd_high'::text, 'vpd_low'::text, 'vpd_hysteresis'::text, 'd_cool_stage_2'::text, 'mister_engage_kpa'::text, 'mister_all_kpa'::text, 'mister_pulse_on_s'::text, 'mister_pulse_gap_s'::text])
UNION ALL
 SELECT setpoint_plan.parameter,
    setpoint_plan.ts,
    setpoint_plan.value,
    'plan'::text AS source
   FROM setpoint_plan
  WHERE (setpoint_plan.parameter = ANY (ARRAY['temp_high'::text, 'temp_low'::text, 'vpd_high'::text, 'vpd_low'::text, 'vpd_hysteresis'::text, 'd_cool_stage_2'::text, 'mister_engage_kpa'::text, 'mister_all_kpa'::text, 'mister_pulse_on_s'::text, 'mister_pulse_gap_s'::text])) AND setpoint_plan.is_active = true AND setpoint_plan.ts > now()
