v_setpoint_velocity.definition:
WITH marks AS (
         SELECT sc.ts,
            sc.parameter,
            sc.source,
                CASE
                    WHEN sc.value IS DISTINCT FROM lag(sc.value) OVER (PARTITION BY sc.parameter ORDER BY sc.ts) THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS is_new_grp
           FROM setpoint_changes sc
          WHERE sc.ts > (now() - '30 days'::interval)
        ), base AS (
         SELECT marks.ts,
            marks.parameter,
            marks.source,
            sum(marks.is_new_grp) OVER (PARTITION BY marks.parameter ORDER BY marks.ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS grp
           FROM marks
        ), grp_start AS (
         SELECT base.parameter,
            base.grp,
            min(base.ts) AS grp_ts
           FROM base
          GROUP BY base.parameter, base.grp
        ), flagged AS (
         SELECT b.ts,
            b.parameter,
            b.source,
            gs.grp_ts IS NOT NULL AND gs.grp_ts < (b.ts + '00:10:00'::interval) AS is_oscillation
           FROM base b
             LEFT JOIN grp_start gs ON gs.parameter = b.parameter AND gs.grp = (b.grp + 1)
        )
 SELECT date_trunc('hour'::text, ts) AS hour,
    parameter,
    source,
    count(*) AS writes,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_oscillation) AS oscillations
   FROM flagged
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, ts)), parameter, source;
v_setpoint_velocity.name: v_setpoint_velocity

v_slack_forecast_triage.definition:
WITH items AS (
         SELECT forecast_deviation_log.ts,
            forecast_deviation_log.greenhouse_id,
            'forecast_deviation'::text AS item_type,
            forecast_deviation_log.parameter AS target,
                CASE
                    WHEN forecast_deviation_log.triggered THEN 'triggered'::text
                    ELSE 'observed'::text
                END AS status,
            abs(forecast_deviation_log.delta) AS urgency,
            jsonb_build_object('observed', forecast_deviation_log.observed, 'forecasted', forecast_deviation_log.forecasted, 'delta', forecast_deviation_log.delta, 'threshold', forecast_deviation_log.threshold, 'triggered', forecast_deviation_log.triggered) AS details
           FROM forecast_deviation_log
          WHERE forecast_deviation_log.ts >= (now() - '72:00:00'::interval)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT COALESCE(forecast_action_log.triggered_at, forecast_action_log.outcome_evaluated_at, now()) AS ts,
            forecast_action_log.greenhouse_id,
            'forecast_action'::text AS item_type,
            COALESCE(forecast_action_log.param, forecast_action_log.rule_name) AS target,
            COALESCE(forecast_action_log.outcome, forecast_action_log.action_taken) AS status,
                CASE
                    WHEN forecast_action_log.action_taken <> 'evaluated_ok'::text THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END::double precision AS urgency,
            jsonb_build_object('rule_name', forecast_action_log.rule_name, 'action_taken', forecast_action_log.action_taken, 'plan_id', forecast_action_log.plan_id, 'old_value', forecast_action_log.old_value, 'new_value', forecast_action_log.new_value, 'condition', forecast_action_log.forecast_condition, 'outcome_metrics', forecast_action_log.outcome_metrics) AS details
           FROM forecast_action_log
          WHERE COALESCE(forecast_action_log.triggered_at, forecast_action_log.outcome_evaluated_at, now()) >= (now() - '72:00:00'::interval)
        )
 SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY urgency DESC NULLS LAST, ts DESC) AS id,
    ts,
    greenhouse_id,
    item_type,
    target,
    status,
    urgency,
    details
   FROM items
  ORDER BY urgency DESC NULLS LAST, ts DESC;
v_slack_forecast_triage.name: v_slack_forecast_triage

v_soil_status.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT climate.ts,
            climate.soil_moisture_south_1,
            climate.soil_temp_south_1,
            climate.soil_ec_south_1,
            climate.soil_moisture_south_2,
            climate.soil_temp_south_2,
            climate.soil_moisture_west,
            climate.soil_temp_west
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.soil_moisture_south_1 IS NOT NULL OR climate.soil_moisture_west IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY climate.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1
        ), trend AS (
         SELECT (array_agg(climate.soil_moisture_south_1 ORDER BY climate.ts DESC) FILTER (WHERE climate.soil_moisture_south_1 IS NOT NULL))[1] AS last_s1,
            (array_agg(climate.soil_moisture_south_1 ORDER BY climate.ts) FILTER (WHERE climate.soil_moisture_south_1 IS NOT NULL))[1] AS first_s1,
            (array_agg(climate.soil_moisture_south_2 ORDER BY climate.ts DESC) FILTER (WHERE climate.soil_moisture_south_2 IS NOT NULL))[1] AS last_s2,
            (array_agg(climate.soil_moisture_south_2 ORDER BY climate.ts) FILTER (WHERE climate.soil_moisture_south_2 IS NOT NULL))[1] AS first_s2,
            (array_agg(climate.soil_moisture_west ORDER BY climate.ts DESC) FILTER (WHERE climate.soil_moisture_west IS NOT NULL))[1] AS last_w,
            (array_agg(climate.soil_moisture_west ORDER BY climate.ts) FILTER (WHERE climate.soil_moisture_west IS NOT NULL))[1] AS first_w
           FROM climate
          WHERE climate.ts > (now() - '06:00:00'::interval) AND (climate.soil_moisture_south_1 IS NOT NULL OR climate.soil_moisture_west IS NOT NULL)
        ), unpivoted AS (
         SELECT 'south_1'::text AS zone,
            l.soil_moisture_south_1 AS moisture,
            l.soil_temp_south_1 AS temp,
            l.soil_ec_south_1 AS ec,
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - l.ts)::integer AS age_s,
                CASE
                    WHEN (t_1.last_s1 - t_1.first_s1) > 2::double precision THEN 'rising'::text
                    WHEN (t_1.first_s1 - t_1.last_s1) > 2::double precision THEN 'falling'::text
                    ELSE 'stable'::text
                END AS trend
           FROM latest l,
            trend t_1
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'south_2'::text AS text,
            l.soil_moisture_south_2,
            l.soil_temp_south_2,
            NULL::double precision AS float8,
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - l.ts)::integer AS "extract",
                CASE
                    WHEN (t_1.last_s2 - t_1.first_s2) > 2::double precision THEN 'rising'::text
                    WHEN (t_1.first_s2 - t_1.last_s2) > 2::double precision THEN 'falling'::text
                    ELSE 'stable'::text
                END AS "case"
           FROM latest l,
            trend t_1
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'west'::text AS text,
            l.soil_moisture_west,
            l.soil_temp_west,
            NULL::double precision AS float8,
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - l.ts)::integer AS "extract",
                CASE
                    WHEN (t_1.last_w - t_1.first_w) > 2::double precision THEN 'rising'::text
                    WHEN (t_1.first_w - t_1.last_w) > 2::double precision THEN 'falling'::text
                    ELSE 'stable'::text
                END AS "case"
           FROM latest l,
            trend t_1
        )
 SELECT u.zone,
    u.moisture,
    u.temp,
    u.ec,
    u.age_s,
    u.trend,
    t.min_pct,
    t.max_pct,
    t.crop,
        CASE
            WHEN u.moisture IS NULL THEN 'offline'::text
            WHEN u.moisture < t.wilt_pct::double precision THEN 'critical_dry'::text
            WHEN u.moisture < t.min_pct::double precision THEN 'dry'::text
            WHEN u.moisture > t.saturation_pct::double precision THEN 'saturated'::text
            WHEN u.moisture > t.max_pct::double precision THEN 'wet'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS status
   FROM unpivoted u
     LEFT JOIN soil_moisture_targets t ON u.zone = t.zone;
v_soil_status.name: v_soil_status

v_state_durations.definition:
WITH transitions AS (
         SELECT system_state.ts,
            system_state.value AS state,
            lead(system_state.ts) OVER (ORDER BY system_state.ts) AS next_ts
           FROM system_state
          WHERE system_state.entity = 'greenhouse_state'::text AND system_state.ts > (now() - '30 days'::interval)
        )
 SELECT ts::date AS date,
    state,
    round(sum(EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(next_ts, now()) - ts) / 3600::numeric), 2) AS hours,
    count(*) AS transitions
   FROM transitions
  GROUP BY (ts::date), state
  ORDER BY (ts::date) DESC, (round(sum(EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(next_ts, now()) - ts) / 3600::numeric), 2)) DESC;
v_state_durations.name: v_state_durations

v_state_transition_rate.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('hour'::text, ts) AS hour,
    count(*) AS transitions,
    count(DISTINCT value) AS unique_states
   FROM system_state
  WHERE entity = 'greenhouse_state'::text AND ts > (now() - '30 days'::interval)
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, ts));
v_state_transition_rate.name: v_state_transition_rate

v_stress_hours_today.definition:
WITH bounds AS (
         SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS start_ts,
            ((date_trunc('day'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) + '1 day'::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS end_ts
        ), g AS (
         SELECT gg.ts,
            gg.zone,
            gg.reading_temp,
            gg.reading_vpd,
            gg.g_temp,
            gg.g_vpd,
            gg.zone_score,
            gg.feasibility,
            gg.proxy_center,
            lead(gg.ts) OVER (ORDER BY gg.ts) AS next_ts
           FROM ( SELECT fn_zone_band_grade.ts,
                    fn_zone_band_grade.zone,
                    fn_zone_band_grade.reading_temp,
                    fn_zone_band_grade.reading_vpd,
                    fn_zone_band_grade.g_temp,
                    fn_zone_band_grade.g_vpd,
                    fn_zone_band_grade.zone_score,
                    fn_zone_band_grade.feasibility,
                    fn_zone_band_grade.proxy_center
                   FROM fn_zone_band_grade(( SELECT bounds.start_ts
                           FROM bounds), LEAST(now(), ( SELECT bounds.end_ts
                           FROM bounds))) fn_zone_band_grade(ts, zone, reading_temp, reading_vpd, g_temp, g_vpd, zone_score, feasibility, proxy_center)
                  WHERE fn_zone_band_grade.zone = 'center'::text) gg
        ), w AS (
         SELECT g.ts,
            g.zone,
            g.reading_temp,
            g.reading_vpd,
            g.g_temp,
            g.g_vpd,
            g.zone_score,
            g.feasibility,
            g.proxy_center,
            g.next_ts,
            LEAST(GREATEST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(g.next_ts, LEAST(now(), g.ts + '00:02:00'::interval)) - g.ts) / 3600.0, 0::numeric), 5.0 / 60.0) AS sample_hours,
            ( SELECT b.temp_low
                   FROM fn_zone_band('center'::text, g.ts) b(zone, temp_low, temp_high, temp_stress_low, temp_stress_high, vpd_low, vpd_high, vpd_stress_low, vpd_stress_high, crop_basis, is_proxy)) AS t_lo,
            ( SELECT b.temp_high
                   FROM fn_zone_band('center'::text, g.ts) b(zone, temp_low, temp_high, temp_stress_low, temp_stress_high, vpd_low, vpd_high, vpd_stress_low, vpd_stress_high, crop_basis, is_proxy)) AS t_hi,
            ( SELECT b.vpd_low
                   FROM fn_zone_band('center'::text, g.ts) b(zone, temp_low, temp_high, temp_stress_low, temp_stress_high, vpd_low, vpd_high, vpd_stress_low, vpd_stress_high, crop_basis, is_proxy)) AS v_lo,
            ( SELECT b.vpd_high
                   FROM fn_zone_band('center'::text, g.ts) b(zone, temp_low, temp_high, temp_stress_low, temp_stress_high, vpd_low, vpd_high, vpd_stress_low, vpd_stress_high, crop_basis, is_proxy)) AS v_hi
           FROM g
        )
 SELECT ( SELECT bounds.start_ts
           FROM bounds) AS date,
    round(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN reading_temp < t_lo THEN (1::numeric - COALESCE(g_temp, 0::numeric)) * sample_hours
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END), 2) AS cold_stress_hours,
    round(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN reading_temp > t_hi THEN (1::numeric - COALESCE(g_temp, 0::numeric)) * sample_hours
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END), 2) AS heat_stress_hours,
    round(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN reading_vpd > v_hi THEN (1::numeric - COALESCE(g_vpd, 0::numeric)) * sample_hours
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END), 2) AS vpd_stress_hours,
    round(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN reading_vpd < v_lo THEN (1::numeric - COALESCE(g_vpd, 0::numeric)) * sample_hours
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END), 2) AS vpd_low_hours
   FROM w;
v_stress_hours_today.name: v_stress_hours_today

v_succession_gaps.definition:
WITH current_crops AS (
         SELECT crops.id,
            crops.name,
            crops.zone,
            crops."position",
            crops.expected_harvest,
            crops.is_active
           FROM crops
          WHERE crops.is_active = true
        ), next_planned AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (succession_plan.zone, succession_plan."position") succession_plan.zone,
            succession_plan."position",
            succession_plan.crop AS next_crop,
            succession_plan.planned_sow
           FROM succession_plan
          WHERE succession_plan.is_active = true AND succession_plan.planned_sow >= CURRENT_DATE
          ORDER BY succession_plan.zone, succession_plan."position", succession_plan.planned_sow
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(c.zone, n.zone) AS zone,
    COALESCE(c."position", n."position") AS "position",
    c.name AS current_crop,
    c.expected_harvest AS current_harvest_date,
    n.next_crop AS next_planned_crop,
    n.planned_sow AS next_sow_date,
        CASE
            WHEN c.expected_harvest IS NOT NULL AND n.planned_sow IS NOT NULL THEN n.planned_sow - c.expected_harvest
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS gap_days,
        CASE
            WHEN c.expected_harvest IS NULL THEN true
            WHEN n.planned_sow IS NULL THEN true
            WHEN (n.planned_sow - c.expected_harvest) > 7 THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS gap_flag
   FROM current_crops c
     FULL JOIN next_planned n ON c.zone = n.zone AND c."position" = n."position";
v_succession_gaps.name: v_succession_gaps

v_succession_plan_readiness.definition:
SELECT p.greenhouse_id,
    z.slug AS zone,
    p.id AS position_id,
    p.label AS "position",
    c.id AS active_crop_id,
    c.name AS active_crop_name,
    c.expected_harvest,
    sp.id AS succession_plan_id,
    sp.crop AS next_crop,
    sp.planned_sow,
    sp.planned_harvest,
        CASE
            WHEN c.id IS NULL AND sp.id IS NULL THEN 'empty_unplanned'::text
            WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.expected_harvest IS NULL THEN 'active_crop_missing_harvest'::text
            WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL AND sp.id IS NULL THEN 'active_no_successor'::text
            ELSE 'planned'::text
        END AS readiness_status
   FROM positions p
     JOIN shelves sh ON sh.id = p.shelf_id
     JOIN zones z ON z.id = sh.zone_id
     LEFT JOIN crops c ON c.position_id = p.id AND c.is_active = true
     LEFT JOIN succession_plan sp ON sp."position" = p.label AND sp.zone = z.slug AND sp.is_active = true
  WHERE p.is_active = true;
v_succession_plan_readiness.name: v_succession_plan_readiness

v_succession_timeline.definition:
SELECT 'current'::text AS entry_type,
    c.zone,
    c."position",
    c.name AS crop,
    c.variety,
    c.planted_date AS start_date,
    c.expected_harvest AS end_date,
    c.stage,
    NULL::text AS rotation_group,
    NULL::text AS season
   FROM crops c
  WHERE c.is_active = true
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'planned'::text AS entry_type,
    s.zone,
    s."position",
    s.crop,
    s.variety,
    s.planned_sow AS start_date,
    s.planned_harvest AS end_date,
    'planned'::text AS stage,
    s.rotation_group,
    s.season
   FROM succession_plan s
  WHERE s.is_active = true
  ORDER BY 2, 3, 6;
v_succession_timeline.name: v_succession_timeline

v_system_health_score.definition:
SELECT 'sensor_health'::text AS component,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT v_sensor_staleness.is_stale)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 1) AS score_pct,
    jsonb_build_object('total_sensors', count(*), 'healthy', count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT v_sensor_staleness.is_stale), 'stale', count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_sensor_staleness.is_stale)) AS details,
    now() AS checked_at
   FROM v_sensor_staleness
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'alert_load'::text AS component,
    GREATEST(0::numeric, round(100.0 - COALESCE(sum(
        CASE alert_log.severity
            WHEN 'critical'::text THEN 10
            WHEN 'warning'::text THEN 3
            WHEN 'info'::text THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END), 0::bigint)::numeric, 1)) AS score_pct,
    jsonb_build_object('open_total', count(*), 'critical', count(*) FILTER (WHERE alert_log.severity = 'critical'::text), 'warning', count(*) FILTER (WHERE alert_log.severity = 'warning'::text)) AS details,
    now() AS checked_at
   FROM alert_log
  WHERE alert_log.disposition = 'open'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'equipment_health'::text AS component,
    fn_equipment_health()::numeric AS score_pct,
    jsonb_build_object('score', fn_equipment_health()) AS details,
    now() AS checked_at
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'controller'::text AS component,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN d.ts IS NULL THEN 0::double precision
            ELSE LEAST(100::double precision, GREATEST(0::numeric, 40::numeric - EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - d.ts) / 15.0)::double precision + LEAST(30::double precision, GREATEST(0::double precision, (d.wifi_rssi + 80::double precision) * 1.0::double precision)) + LEAST(30::double precision, d.uptime_s / 120.0::double precision))
        END::numeric, 1) AS score_pct,
    jsonb_build_object('wifi_rssi_dbm', d.wifi_rssi, 'uptime_s', d.uptime_s, 'heap_bytes', d.heap_bytes) AS details,
    now() AS checked_at
   FROM ( SELECT diagnostics.ts,
            diagnostics.wifi_rssi,
            diagnostics.uptime_s,
            diagnostics.heap_bytes
           FROM diagnostics
          WHERE diagnostics.ts > (now() - '00:10:00'::interval)
          ORDER BY diagnostics.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) d;
v_system_health_score.name: v_system_health_score

v_target_curve.definition:
SELECT gs AS ts,
    (fn_band_setpoints(gs)).temp_low AS target_temp_min,
    (fn_band_setpoints(gs)).temp_high AS target_temp_max,
    (fn_zone_band('center'::text, gs)).temp_stress_low AS stress_temp_low,
    (fn_zone_band('center'::text, gs)).temp_stress_high AS stress_temp_high,
    (fn_band_setpoints(gs)).vpd_low AS target_vpd_min,
    (fn_band_setpoints(gs)).vpd_high AS target_vpd_max,
    (fn_zone_band('center'::text, gs)).vpd_stress_low AS stress_vpd_low,
    (fn_zone_band('center'::text, gs)).vpd_stress_high AS stress_vpd_high,
    12.0::double precision AS target_dli
   FROM generate_series((date_trunc('day'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text), (date_trunc('day'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) + '24:00:00'::interval, '00:05:00'::interval) gs(gs);
v_target_curve.name: v_target_curve

v_topology_tree.definition:
SELECT id AS greenhouse_id,
    name AS greenhouse_name,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('zone_id', z.id, 'slug', z.slug, 'name', z.name, 'status', z.status, 'shelves', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('shelf_id', sh.id, 'slug', sh.slug, 'name', sh.name, 'kind', sh.kind, 'positions', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('position_id', p.id, 'label', p.label, 'mount_type', p.mount_type, 'is_active', p.is_active) ORDER BY p.label) AS jsonb_agg
                           FROM positions p
                          WHERE p.shelf_id = sh.id), '[]'::jsonb)) ORDER BY sh.slug) AS jsonb_agg
                   FROM shelves sh
                  WHERE sh.zone_id = z.id), '[]'::jsonb)) ORDER BY z.slug) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM zones z
          WHERE z.greenhouse_id = g.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS zones
   FROM greenhouses g;
v_topology_tree.name: v_topology_tree

v_vent_mist_assist_7d.definition:
WITH bounds AS (
         SELECT now() - '7 days'::interval AS start_ts,
            now() AS end_ts
        ), diag AS (
         SELECT d.greenhouse_id,
            d.ts,
            d.vent_mist_assist_active,
            lead(d.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY d.greenhouse_id ORDER BY d.ts) AS next_ts
           FROM diagnostics d
             CROSS JOIN bounds b
          WHERE d.ts > (b.start_ts - '00:10:00'::interval) AND d.ts <= b.end_ts
        ), assist AS (
         SELECT d.greenhouse_id,
            GREATEST(d.ts, b.start_ts) AS ts,
            LEAST(COALESCE(d.next_ts, b.end_ts), b.end_ts) AS next_ts
           FROM diag d
             CROSS JOIN bounds b
          WHERE d.vent_mist_assist_active = 1 AND d.ts < b.end_ts AND COALESCE(d.next_ts, b.end_ts) > b.start_ts
        ), enriched AS (
         SELECT a.greenhouse_id,
            a.ts,
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM a.next_ts - a.ts) / 60.0 AS minutes,
            COALESCE(state.value, 'unknown'::text) AS greenhouse_state,
            COALESCE(reason.value, 'vent_mist_assist_active'::text) AS mode_reason,
            fn_equip_at('vent'::text, a.ts) AS vent_on,
            fn_equip_at('fog'::text, a.ts) AS fog_on,
            fn_equip_at('mister_south'::text, a.ts) OR fn_equip_at('mister_west'::text, a.ts) OR fn_equip_at('mister_center'::text, a.ts) AS any_mister_on,
            c.temp_avg,
            c.vpd_avg,
            c.outdoor_temp_f,
            c.outdoor_rh_pct
           FROM assist a
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ss.value
                   FROM system_state ss
                  WHERE ss.greenhouse_id = a.greenhouse_id AND ss.entity = 'greenhouse_state'::text AND ss.ts <= a.ts
                  ORDER BY ss.ts DESC
                 LIMIT 1) state ON true
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ss.value
                   FROM system_state ss
                  WHERE ss.greenhouse_id = a.greenhouse_id AND ss.entity = 'mode_reason'::text AND ss.ts <= a.ts
                  ORDER BY ss.ts DESC
                 LIMIT 1) reason ON true
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c_1.temp_avg,
                    c_1.vpd_avg,
                    c_1.outdoor_temp_f,
                    c_1.outdoor_rh_pct
                   FROM climate c_1
                  WHERE c_1.greenhouse_id = a.greenhouse_id AND c_1.ts <= a.ts
                  ORDER BY c_1.ts DESC
                 LIMIT 1) c ON true
          WHERE a.next_ts > a.ts
        )
 SELECT greenhouse_id,
    greenhouse_state,
    mode_reason,
    count(*) AS samples,
    round(sum(minutes), 1) AS assist_minutes,
    round(sum(minutes) FILTER (WHERE vent_on), 1) AS vent_open_minutes,
    round(sum(minutes) FILTER (WHERE fog_on), 1) AS fog_minutes,
    round(sum(minutes) FILTER (WHERE any_mister_on), 1) AS mister_minutes,
    round(avg(temp_avg)::numeric, 1) AS avg_temp_f,
    round(avg(vpd_avg)::numeric, 2) AS avg_vpd_kpa,
    round(avg(outdoor_temp_f)::numeric, 1) AS avg_outdoor_temp_f,
    round(avg(outdoor_rh_pct)::numeric, 1) AS avg_outdoor_rh_pct
   FROM enriched
  GROUP BY greenhouse_id, greenhouse_state, mode_reason
  ORDER BY (round(sum(minutes), 1)) DESC;
v_vent_mist_assist_7d.name: v_vent_mist_assist_7d

v_water_accountability.definition:
SELECT date,
    total_gal,
    mister_gal,
    drip_gal,
    unaccounted_gal,
    gal_per_vpd_stress_hour,
        CASE
            WHEN total_gal IS NULL THEN 'missing_total'::text
            WHEN total_gal < 0::double precision THEN 'negative_total'::text
            WHEN mister_gal > (total_gal + 5::double precision) THEN 'mister_exceeds_total'::text
            WHEN unaccounted_gal < '-5'::integer::double precision THEN 'negative_unaccounted'::text
            WHEN unaccounted_gal > GREATEST(25::double precision, total_gal * 0.25::double precision) THEN 'high_unaccounted'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS quality_flag
   FROM v_water_budget;
v_water_accountability.name: v_water_accountability

v_water_attribution_daily.definition:
WITH events AS (
         SELECT (e_1.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS date,
            e_1.greenhouse_id,
            round(sum(e_1.delta_gal) FILTER (WHERE e_1.attribution_class = 'meter_attributed'::text)::numeric, 3)::double precision AS attributed_gal,
            round(sum(e_1.delta_gal) FILTER (WHERE e_1.attributed_scope = 'climate_wetting'::text)::numeric, 3)::double precision AS climate_wetting_gal,
            round(sum(e_1.delta_gal) FILTER (WHERE e_1.attributed_scope = 'wall_irrigation'::text)::numeric, 3)::double precision AS wall_irrigation_gal,
            round(sum(e_1.delta_gal) FILTER (WHERE e_1.attributed_scope = 'wall_fertigation'::text)::numeric, 3)::double precision AS wall_fertigation_gal,
            round(sum(e_1.delta_gal) FILTER (WHERE e_1.attributed_scope = 'unsupported_path'::text)::numeric, 3)::double precision AS unsupported_path_gal,
            round(sum(e_1.delta_gal) FILTER (WHERE e_1.attribution_class = 'ambiguous_overlap'::text)::numeric, 3)::double precision AS ambiguous_gal,
            round(sum(e_1.delta_gal) FILTER (WHERE e_1.attribution_class = 'manual_or_unattributed'::text)::numeric, 3)::double precision AS manual_or_unattributed_gal,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE e_1.attribution_quality <> 'ok'::text) AS attribution_quality_events
           FROM v_water_event_attribution e_1
          GROUP BY ((e_1.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date), e_1.greenhouse_id
        ), runs AS (
         SELECT (r_1.run_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AS date,
            r_1.greenhouse_id,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE r_1.run_classification = 'command_only'::text) AS command_only_runs,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE r_1.run_classification = 'ambiguous_overlap'::text) AS ambiguous_runs,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE r_1.run_classification = 'meter_attributed'::text) AS meter_attributed_runs
           FROM v_water_run_accounting r_1
          GROUP BY ((r_1.run_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date), r_1.greenhouse_id
        )
 SELECT m.day::date AS date,
    m.greenhouse_id,
    m.used_gal AS quality_filtered_meter_gal,
    COALESCE(e.attributed_gal, 0::double precision) AS attributed_gal,
    COALESCE(e.climate_wetting_gal, 0::double precision) AS climate_wetting_gal,
    COALESCE(e.wall_irrigation_gal, 0::double precision) AS wall_irrigation_gal,
    COALESCE(e.wall_fertigation_gal, 0::double precision) AS wall_fertigation_gal,
    COALESCE(e.unsupported_path_gal, 0::double precision) AS unsupported_path_gal,
    COALESCE(e.ambiguous_gal, 0::double precision) AS ambiguous_gal,
    COALESCE(e.manual_or_unattributed_gal, 0::double precision) AS manual_or_unattributed_gal,
    COALESCE(r.command_only_runs, 0::bigint) AS command_only_runs,
    COALESCE(r.ambiguous_runs, 0::bigint) AS ambiguous_runs,
    COALESCE(r.meter_attributed_runs, 0::bigint) AS meter_attributed_runs,
    round((m.used_gal - COALESCE(e.attributed_gal, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(e.ambiguous_gal, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(e.manual_or_unattributed_gal, 0::double precision))::numeric, 6)::double precision AS conservation_error_gal,
    m.quality AS ledger_quality,
        CASE
            WHEN abs(m.used_gal - COALESCE(e.attributed_gal, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(e.ambiguous_gal, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(e.manual_or_unattributed_gal, 0::double precision)) > 0.001::double precision THEN 'conservation_error'::text
            WHEN m.quality <> 'ok'::text THEN m.quality
            WHEN COALESCE(e.attribution_quality_events, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'attribution_degraded'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS resource_quality,
    m.available_for_scoring AND abs(m.used_gal - COALESCE(e.attributed_gal, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(e.ambiguous_gal, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(e.manual_or_unattributed_gal, 0::double precision)) <= 0.001::double precision AND COALESCE(e.attribution_quality_events, 0::bigint) = 0 AS available_for_scoring
   FROM v_water_meter_daily m
     LEFT JOIN events e ON e.date = m.day::date AND e.greenhouse_id = m.greenhouse_id
     LEFT JOIN runs r ON r.date = m.day::date AND r.greenhouse_id = m.greenhouse_id;
v_water_attribution_daily.name: v_water_attribution_daily

v_water_budget.definition:
SELECT ds.date,
    w.quality_filtered_meter_gal AS total_gal,
    w.climate_wetting_gal AS mister_gal,
    w.wall_irrigation_gal AS drip_gal,
    w.manual_or_unattributed_gal + w.ambiguous_gal + w.unsupported_path_gal AS unaccounted_gal,
        CASE
            WHEN ds.stress_hours_vpd_high > 0::double precision THEN round((w.climate_wetting_gal / ds.stress_hours_vpd_high)::numeric, 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS gal_per_vpd_stress_hour,
    w.wall_fertigation_gal AS fertigation_gal,
    COALESCE(ds.runtime_irrigation_clean_h, 0::double precision) AS clean_runtime_h,
    COALESCE(ds.runtime_irrigation_fert_h, 0::double precision) AS fert_runtime_h,
    COALESCE(ds.runtime_fert_master_h, 0::double precision) AS fert_master_runtime_h,
    w.ambiguous_gal,
    w.manual_or_unattributed_gal,
    w.unsupported_path_gal,
    w.command_only_runs,
    w.resource_quality,
    w.available_for_scoring
   FROM daily_summary ds
     JOIN v_water_attribution_daily w ON w.date = ds.date AND w.greenhouse_id = ds.greenhouse_id;
v_water_budget.name: v_water_budget

v_water_daily.definition:
SELECT day,
    round(sum(used_gal)::numeric, 3)::double precision AS used_gal,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_and(available_for_scoring) THEN 'ok'::text
            WHEN bool_or(quality = 'discontinuous'::text) THEN 'discontinuous'::text
            WHEN bool_or(quality = 'ledger_incomplete'::text) THEN 'ledger_incomplete'::text
            WHEN bool_or(quality = 'incomplete'::text) THEN 'incomplete'::text
            WHEN bool_or(quality = 'partial_day'::text) THEN 'partial_day'::text
            ELSE 'unavailable'::text
        END AS quality,
    bool_and(available_for_scoring) AS available_for_scoring,
    sum(raw_sample_count)::bigint AS raw_sample_count,
    sum(gap_events)::bigint AS gap_events,
    sum(reset_events)::bigint AS reset_events
   FROM v_water_meter_daily
  GROUP BY day
  ORDER BY day DESC;
v_water_daily.name: v_water_daily

v_water_efficiency.definition:
SELECT ds.date,
    ds.water_used_gal,
    d.crop_dli_mol_m2_day AS dli_final,
        CASE
            WHEN d.crop_dli_mol_m2_day > 0::double precision THEN round((ds.water_used_gal / d.crop_dli_mol_m2_day)::numeric, 3)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS gal_per_mol_dli,
    d.availability AS dli_availability,
    d.unavailable_reason AS dli_unavailable_reason,
    d.provenance AS dli_provenance,
    d.validity_revision AS dli_validity_revision,
    d.valid_from AS dli_valid_from,
    d.valid_to AS dli_valid_to
   FROM daily_summary ds
     LEFT JOIN v_dli_daily d ON d.date = ds.date AND d.greenhouse_id = COALESCE(ds.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)
  WHERE ds.water_used_gal IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ds.date;
v_water_efficiency.name: v_water_efficiency

v_water_event_attribution.definition:
SELECT id AS water_event_id,
    greenhouse_id,
    meter_id,
    ts,
    prior_ts,
    delta_gal,
    COALESCE(candidate_run_count, cardinality(COALESCE(candidate_relays, ARRAY[]::text[])))::bigint AS candidate_run_count,
    COALESCE(candidate_relays, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS candidate_relays,
        CASE
            WHEN attributed_scope IS NULL THEN ARRAY[]::text[]
            ELSE ARRAY[attributed_scope]
        END AS candidate_scopes,
    COALESCE(attribution_class, 'manual_or_unattributed'::text) AS attribution_class,
    attributed_scope,
    COALESCE(attribution_quality, 'legacy_missing_interval'::text) AS attribution_quality
   FROM water_meter_events e
  WHERE event_type = 'delta'::text AND quality_flag = 'ok'::text;
v_water_event_attribution.name: v_water_event_attribution

v_water_ledger_health.definition:
WITH houses AS (
         SELECT g_1.id AS greenhouse_id
           FROM greenhouses g_1
        ), raw AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(c.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) AS greenhouse_id,
            max(c.ts) FILTER (WHERE c.water_total_gal IS NOT NULL) AS raw_latest_ts
           FROM climate c
          GROUP BY (COALESCE(c.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text))
        ), recent_discontinuity AS (
         SELECT e.greenhouse_id,
            max(e.ts) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'gap'::text) AS latest_gap_ts,
            max(e.ts) AS latest_discontinuity_ts
           FROM water_meter_events e
          WHERE e.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND ((e.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['gap'::text, 'reset'::text, 'phantom_zero'::text, 'source_conflict'::text])) OR e.quality_flag <> 'ok'::text)
          GROUP BY e.greenhouse_id
        )
 SELECT h.greenhouse_id,
    r.raw_latest_ts,
    s.last_source_ts AS materialized_through_ts,
    round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - r.raw_latest_ts), 1) AS raw_age_seconds,
    round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM r.raw_latest_ts - s.last_source_ts), 1) AS materializer_lag_seconds,
    s.last_total_gal,
    s.last_event_quality,
    g.latest_gap_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN r.raw_latest_ts IS NULL OR s.last_source_ts IS NULL THEN 'unavailable'::text
            WHEN r.raw_latest_ts < (now() - '00:10:00'::interval) THEN 'stale'::text
            WHEN s.last_source_ts < (r.raw_latest_ts - '00:05:00'::interval) THEN 'stale'::text
            WHEN s.last_event_quality = ANY (ARRAY['source_gap'::text, 'high_delta'::text, 'conflicting_source_samples'::text, 'counter_reset'::text, 'phantom_zero'::text]) THEN 'discontinuous'::text
            WHEN g.latest_discontinuity_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 'discontinuous'::text
            ELSE 'fresh'::text
        END AS ledger_status,
    r.raw_latest_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.last_source_ts >= (r.raw_latest_ts - '00:05:00'::interval) AND r.raw_latest_ts >= (now() - '00:10:00'::interval) AND (s.last_event_quality <> ALL (ARRAY['source_gap'::text, 'high_delta'::text, 'conflicting_source_samples'::text, 'counter_reset'::text, 'phantom_zero'::text])) AND g.latest_discontinuity_ts IS NULL AS available_for_scoring,
    g.latest_discontinuity_ts
   FROM houses h
     LEFT JOIN raw r ON r.greenhouse_id = h.greenhouse_id
     LEFT JOIN water_meter_materializer_state s ON s.greenhouse_id = h.greenhouse_id AND s.source = 'climate.water_total_gal'::text AND s.meter_id = 'main_pulse'::text
     LEFT JOIN recent_discontinuity g ON g.greenhouse_id = h.greenhouse_id;
v_water_ledger_health.name: v_water_ledger_health

v_water_meter_daily.definition:
WITH raw_ordered AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(c_1.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) AS greenhouse_id,
            c_1.ts,
            lag(c_1.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY (COALESCE(c_1.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)), ((c_1.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date) ORDER BY c_1.ts) AS prior_ts
           FROM climate c_1
          WHERE c_1.water_total_gal IS NOT NULL
        ), raw_daily AS (
         SELECT ((raw_ordered.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS day,
            raw_ordered.greenhouse_id,
            count(*) AS raw_sample_count,
            min(raw_ordered.ts) AS first_raw_ts,
            max(raw_ordered.ts) AS last_raw_ts,
            max(EXTRACT(epoch FROM raw_ordered.ts - raw_ordered.prior_ts))::double precision AS max_raw_gap_seconds
           FROM raw_ordered
          GROUP BY (((raw_ordered.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)), raw_ordered.greenhouse_id
        ), event_daily AS (
         SELECT ((e.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text) AS day,
            e.greenhouse_id,
            e.meter_id,
            round(COALESCE(sum(e.delta_gal) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'delta'::text AND e.quality_flag = 'ok'::text), 0::double precision)::numeric, 3)::double precision AS used_gal,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'delta'::text AND e.quality_flag = 'ok'::text) AS delta_events,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'reset'::text) AS reset_events,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'phantom_zero'::text) AS phantom_zero_events,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.quality_flag <> 'ok'::text) AS quality_events,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'gap'::text) AS gap_events,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'delta'::text AND e.prior_ts IS NULL) AS missing_interval_events
           FROM water_meter_events e
          GROUP BY (((e.ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)), e.greenhouse_id, e.meter_id
        ), combined AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(e.day, r.day) AS day,
            COALESCE(e.greenhouse_id, r.greenhouse_id) AS greenhouse_id,
            COALESCE(e.meter_id, 'main_pulse'::text) AS meter_id,
            COALESCE(e.used_gal, 0::double precision) AS used_gal,
            COALESCE(e.delta_events, 0::bigint) AS delta_events,
            COALESCE(e.reset_events, 0::bigint) AS reset_events,
            COALESCE(e.phantom_zero_events, 0::bigint) AS phantom_zero_events,
            COALESCE(e.quality_events, 0::bigint) AS quality_events,
            COALESCE(e.gap_events, 0::bigint) AS gap_events,
            COALESCE(e.missing_interval_events, 0::bigint) AS missing_interval_events,
            COALESCE(r.raw_sample_count, 0::bigint) AS raw_sample_count,
            r.first_raw_ts,
            r.last_raw_ts,
            r.max_raw_gap_seconds
           FROM event_daily e
             FULL JOIN raw_daily r USING (day, greenhouse_id)
        )
 SELECT c.day,
    c.greenhouse_id,
    c.meter_id,
    c.used_gal,
    c.delta_events,
    c.reset_events,
    c.phantom_zero_events,
    c.quality_events,
    c.gap_events,
    c.raw_sample_count,
    c.first_raw_ts,
    c.last_raw_ts,
    c.max_raw_gap_seconds,
    c.missing_interval_events,
    c.day::date < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AND c.first_raw_ts <= (c.day + '00:10:00'::interval) AND c.last_raw_ts >= (c.day + '1 day'::interval - '00:10:00'::interval) AND COALESCE(c.max_raw_gap_seconds, 0::double precision) <= 300::double precision AND s.last_source_ts >= c.last_raw_ts AS is_complete_day,
        CASE
            WHEN c.day::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date THEN 'partial_day'::text
            WHEN c.raw_sample_count = 0 THEN 'unavailable'::text
            WHEN s.last_source_ts IS NULL OR s.last_source_ts < c.last_raw_ts THEN 'ledger_incomplete'::text
            WHEN c.gap_events > 0 OR COALESCE(c.max_raw_gap_seconds, 0::double precision) > 300::double precision OR c.quality_events > 0 OR c.missing_interval_events > 0 THEN 'discontinuous'::text
            WHEN c.first_raw_ts > (c.day + '00:10:00'::interval) OR c.last_raw_ts < (c.day + '1 day'::interval - '00:10:00'::interval) THEN 'incomplete'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS quality,
    c.day::date < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'::text)::date AND c.first_raw_ts <= (c.day + '00:10:00'::interval) AND c.last_raw_ts >= (c.day + '1 day'::interval - '00:10:00'::interval) AND COALESCE(c.max_raw_gap_seconds, 0::double precision) <= 300::double precision AND s.last_source_ts >= c.last_raw_ts AND c.quality_events = 0 AND c.missing_interval_events = 0 AS available_for_scoring,
    s.last_source_ts AS materialized_through_ts,
    s.last_source_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.last_source_ts >= c.last_raw_ts AS ledger_covers_day
   FROM combined c
     LEFT JOIN water_meter_materializer_state s ON s.greenhouse_id = c.greenhouse_id AND s.source = 'climate.water_total_gal'::text AND s.meter_id = c.meter_id
  ORDER BY c.day DESC;
v_water_meter_daily.name: v_water_meter_daily

v_water_relay_runs.definition:
WITH observed AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(es.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text) AS greenhouse_id,
            es.equipment AS relay_slug,
            es.ts,
            bool_or(es.state) AS state,
            count(DISTINCT es.state) > 1 AS conflicting_state
           FROM equipment_state es
          WHERE es.equipment = ANY (ARRAY['fog'::text, 'mister_center'::text, 'mister_south'::text, 'mister_west'::text, 'drip_wall'::text, 'drip_center'::text, 'drip_wall_fert'::text, 'drip_center_fert'::text, 'mister_south_fert'::text, 'mister_west_fert'::text])
          GROUP BY (COALESCE(es.greenhouse_id, 'vallery'::text)), es.equipment, es.ts
        ), changed AS (
         SELECT x.greenhouse_id,
            x.relay_slug,
            x.ts,
            x.state,
            x.conflicting_state,
            x.prior_state
           FROM ( SELECT o.greenhouse_id,
                    o.relay_slug,
                    o.ts,
                    o.state,
                    o.conflicting_state,
                    lag(o.state) OVER (PARTITION BY o.greenhouse_id, o.relay_slug ORDER BY o.ts) AS prior_state
                   FROM observed o) x
          WHERE x.prior_state IS DISTINCT FROM x.state OR x.prior_state IS NULL OR x.conflicting_state
        ), intervals AS (
         SELECT c.greenhouse_id,
            c.relay_slug,
            c.ts,
            c.state,
            c.conflicting_state,
            c.prior_state,
            lead(c.ts, 1, now()) OVER (PARTITION BY c.greenhouse_id, c.relay_slug ORDER BY c.ts) AS run_end
           FROM changed c
        )
 SELECT md5(concat_ws('|'::text, greenhouse_id, relay_slug, ts::text)) AS run_id,
    greenhouse_id,
    relay_slug,
        CASE
            WHEN relay_slug = ANY (ARRAY['fog'::text, 'mister_center'::text, 'mister_south'::text, 'mister_west'::text]) THEN 'climate_wetting'::text
            WHEN relay_slug = 'drip_wall'::text THEN 'wall_irrigation'::text
            WHEN relay_slug = 'drip_wall_fert'::text THEN 'wall_fertigation'::text
            ELSE 'unsupported_path'::text
        END AS delivery_scope,
    ts AS run_start,
    run_end,
    round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM run_end - ts) / 60.0, 3)::double precision AS runtime_minutes,
        CASE
            WHEN conflicting_state THEN 'conflicting_start'::text
            ELSE 'observed_relay'::text
        END AS evidence_quality
   FROM intervals
  WHERE state IS TRUE AND run_end > ts;
v_water_relay_runs.name: v_water_relay_runs

v_water_run_accounting.definition:
SELECT r.run_id,
    r.greenhouse_id,
    r.relay_slug,
    r.delivery_scope,
    r.run_start,
    r.run_end,
    r.runtime_minutes,
        CASE
            WHEN e.event_count = 0 THEN 'command_only'::text
            WHEN e.has_ambiguous_overlap THEN 'ambiguous_overlap'::text
            ELSE 'meter_attributed'::text
        END AS run_classification,
        CASE
            WHEN e.event_count = 0 THEN NULL::double precision
            ELSE round(COALESCE(e.meter_attributed_gal, 0::double precision)::numeric, 3)::double precision
        END AS meter_attributed_gal,
    e.event_count AS overlapping_meter_events,
    r.evidence_quality
   FROM v_water_relay_runs r
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS event_count,
            COALESCE(bool_or(a.attribution_class = 'ambiguous_overlap'::text), false) AS has_ambiguous_overlap,
            sum(a.delta_gal) FILTER (WHERE a.attribution_class = 'meter_attributed'::text) AS meter_attributed_gal
           FROM v_water_event_attribution a
          WHERE a.greenhouse_id = r.greenhouse_id AND a.ts > r.run_start AND a.prior_ts < r.run_end) e ON true;
v_water_run_accounting.name: v_water_run_accounting

v_weekly_summary.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS week_start,
    (date_trunc('week'::text, date::timestamp with time zone) + '6 days'::interval)::date AS week_end,
    count(*) AS days,
    round(avg(temp_avg)::numeric, 1) AS temp_avg,
    round(min(temp_min)::numeric, 1) AS temp_min,
    round(max(temp_max)::numeric, 1) AS temp_max,
    round(avg(rh_avg)::numeric, 1) AS rh_avg,
    round(min(rh_min)::numeric, 1) AS rh_min,
    round(max(rh_max)::numeric, 1) AS rh_max,
    round(avg(vpd_avg)::numeric, 2) AS vpd_avg,
    round(min(vpd_min)::numeric, 2) AS vpd_min,
    round(max(vpd_max)::numeric, 2) AS vpd_max,
    NULL::numeric AS dli_avg,
    round(avg(co2_avg)::numeric, 0) AS co2_avg,
    round(min(outdoor_temp_min)::numeric, 1) AS outdoor_temp_min,
    round(max(outdoor_temp_max)::numeric, 1) AS outdoor_temp_max,
    round(sum(COALESCE(stress_hours_heat, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS stress_hours_heat,
    round(sum(COALESCE(stress_hours_cold, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS stress_hours_cold,
    round(sum(COALESCE(stress_hours_vpd_high, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS stress_hours_vpd_high,
    round(sum(COALESCE(stress_hours_vpd_low, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS stress_hours_vpd_low,
    round(sum(COALESCE(water_used_gal, 0::double precision))::numeric, 0) AS total_water_gal,
    round(sum(COALESCE(mister_water_gal, 0::double precision))::numeric, 0) AS mister_water_gal,
    round(sum(COALESCE(kwh_total, kwh_estimated, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS kwh_total,
    round(sum(COALESCE(therms_estimated, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS therms_total,
    round(max(COALESCE(peak_kw, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS peak_kw,
    round(sum(COALESCE(cost_electric, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS cost_electric,
    round(sum(COALESCE(cost_gas, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS cost_gas,
    round(sum(COALESCE(cost_water, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS cost_water,
    round(sum(COALESCE(cost_total, 0::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS total_cost,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_heat1_min, 0::double precision))::numeric / 60::numeric, 1) AS runtime_heat1_h,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_heat2_min, 0::double precision))::numeric / 60::numeric, 1) AS runtime_heat2_h,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_fan1_min + runtime_fan2_min, 0::double precision))::numeric / 60::numeric, 1) AS runtime_fans_h,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_fog_min, 0::double precision))::numeric / 60::numeric, 1) AS runtime_fog_h,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_vent_min, 0::double precision))::numeric / 60::numeric, 1) AS runtime_vent_h,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_grow_light_min, 0::double precision))::numeric / 60::numeric, 1) AS runtime_grow_light_h,
    round(sum(COALESCE(runtime_mister_south_h + runtime_mister_west_h + runtime_mister_center_h, 0::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS runtime_misters_h,
    sum(COALESCE(cycles_heat1, 0) + COALESCE(cycles_heat2, 0)) AS cycles_heat,
    sum(COALESCE(cycles_fan1, 0) + COALESCE(cycles_fan2, 0)) AS cycles_fans,
    sum(COALESCE(cycles_fog, 0)) AS cycles_fog,
    sum(COALESCE(cycles_vent, 0)) AS cycles_vent
   FROM daily_summary
  WHERE temp_avg IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, date::timestamp with time zone))
  ORDER BY (date_trunc('week'::text, date::timestamp with time zone)::date);
v_weekly_summary.name: v_weekly_summary

v_zone_band.definition:
SELECT b.zone,
    b.temp_low,
    b.temp_high,
    b.temp_stress_low,
    b.temp_stress_high,
    b.vpd_low,
    b.vpd_high,
    b.vpd_stress_low,
    b.vpd_stress_high,
    b.crop_basis,
    b.is_proxy
   FROM ( VALUES ('center'::text), ('east'::text), ('north'::text), ('south'::text), ('west'::text)) z(zone)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL fn_zone_band(z.zone, now()) b(zone, temp_low, temp_high, temp_stress_low, temp_stress_high, vpd_low, vpd_high, vpd_stress_low, vpd_stress_high, crop_basis, is_proxy);
v_zone_band.name: v_zone_band

v_zone_disease_risk.definition:
WITH per_zone AS (
         SELECT c.ts,
            'center'::text AS zone,
            c.temp_avg AS temp_f,
            c.rh_avg AS rh_pct,
            c.vpd_avg AS vpd_kpa,
            true AS proxy_flag
           FROM climate c
          WHERE c.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND c.temp_avg IS NOT NULL AND c.rh_avg IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT c.ts,
            'east'::text AS text,
            c.temp_east,
            c.rh_east,
            c.vpd_east,
            false
           FROM climate c
          WHERE c.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND c.temp_east IS NOT NULL AND c.rh_east IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT c.ts,
            'north'::text AS text,
            c.temp_north,
            c.rh_north,
            c.vpd_north,
            false
           FROM climate c
          WHERE c.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND c.temp_north IS NOT NULL AND c.rh_north IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT c.ts,
            'south'::text AS text,
            c.temp_south,
            c.rh_south,
            c.vpd_south,
            false
           FROM climate c
          WHERE c.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND c.temp_south IS NOT NULL AND c.rh_south IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT c.ts,
            'west'::text AS text,
            c.temp_west,
            c.rh_west,
            c.vpd_west,
            false
           FROM climate c
          WHERE c.ts >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND c.temp_west IS NOT NULL AND c.rh_west IS NOT NULL
        ), flagged AS (
         SELECT pz.ts,
            pz.zone,
            pz.proxy_flag,
                CASE
                    WHEN pz.rh_pct > 85::double precision AND pz.temp_f >= 60::double precision AND pz.temp_f <= 80::double precision THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS botrytis_flag,
                CASE
                    WHEN pz.vpd_kpa < 0.4::double precision THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS condensation_flag,
                CASE
                    WHEN pz.temp_f > 85::double precision THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS heat_flag
           FROM per_zone pz
        )
 SELECT date_trunc('hour'::text, ts) AS hour,
    zone,
    bool_or(proxy_flag) AS proxy_flag,
    round(avg(botrytis_flag) * 100::numeric, 1) AS botrytis_risk_pct,
    round(avg(condensation_flag) * 100::numeric, 1) AS condensation_risk_pct,
    round(avg(heat_flag) * 100::numeric, 1) AS heat_risk_pct,
    round(sum(botrytis_flag)::numeric * 2.0 / 60.0, 2) AS botrytis_hours,
    round(sum(condensation_flag)::numeric * 2.0 / 60.0, 2) AS condensation_hours,
    round(sum(heat_flag)::numeric * 2.0 / 60.0, 2) AS heat_hours
   FROM flagged
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, ts)), zone
  ORDER BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, ts)) DESC, zone;
v_zone_disease_risk.name: v_zone_disease_risk

v_zone_full.definition:
SELECT id AS zone_id,
    greenhouse_id,
    slug AS zone_slug,
    name AS zone_name,
    orientation,
    sensor_modbus_addr,
    peak_temp_f,
    status AS zone_status,
    notes AS zone_notes,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', sh.id, 'slug', sh.slug, 'name', sh.name, 'kind', sh.kind, 'tier', sh.tier, 'position_scheme', sh.position_scheme) ORDER BY sh.tier, sh.slug) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM shelves sh
          WHERE sh.zone_id = z.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS shelves,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', s.id, 'slug', s.slug, 'kind', s.kind, 'protocol', s.protocol, 'model', s.model, 'modbus_addr', s.modbus_addr, 'source_table', s.source_table, 'source_column', s.source_column, 'unit', s.unit, 'is_active', s.is_active) ORDER BY s.slug) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM sensors s
          WHERE s.zone_id = z.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS sensors,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', e.id, 'slug', e.slug, 'kind', e.kind, 'name', e.name, 'model', e.model, 'watts', e.watts, 'cost_per_hour_usd', e.cost_per_hour_usd, 'is_active', e.is_active) ORDER BY e.kind, e.slug) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM equipment e
          WHERE e.zone_id = z.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS equipment,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', w.id, 'slug', w.slug, 'kind', w.kind, 'name', w.name, 'nozzle_count', w.nozzle_count, 'head_count', w.head_count, 'mount', w.mount, 'pressure_group_id', w.pressure_group_id, 'is_fert_path', w.is_fert_path) ORDER BY w.kind, w.slug) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM water_systems w
          WHERE w.zone_id = z.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS water_systems,
    ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS count
           FROM crops c
          WHERE c.zone_id = z.id AND c.is_active) AS active_crops_fk_count
   FROM zones z;
v_zone_full.name: v_zone_full

v_zone_temp_delta.definition:
SELECT ts,
    temp_north - temp_south AS zone_temp_delta
   FROM climate
  WHERE temp_north IS NOT NULL AND temp_south IS NOT NULL;
v_zone_temp_delta.name: v_zone_temp_delta
